programme.desc: For their final battle, Buddy and Duff create their own winter wonderlands; the teams construct arctic creatures and their habitats to decide the contest winner.

programme.title: Season's Meetings
programme.desc: At the Scout Elves' Enchanted Cottage, Duff Goldman asks the teams to create an edible shelf for their own Scout Elf; the bottom teams must impress judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt with their memory-filled snow globe showpieces.

programme.title: Celebrating the Season
programme.desc: The bakers help their Scout Elves take the perfect elfie selfies with edible backdrops for their photos; the bottom two teams design an edible holiday outfit for judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt's elf fashion show.

programme.title: 12 Days of Elf-mas
programme.desc: The Scout Elves want to play the "12 Days of Christmas" at their concert, but they mix up the lyrics; Duff Goldman tasks the teams with delivering a twisted-up "12 Days of Elfmas" showpiece.

programme.title: The Reason for the Season
programme.desc: The scout elves have some trouble tuning up Santa's sleigh, so Duff Goldman asks the teams to create a sleigh design that will wow Mr. Claus; two teams build inventive snow forts for a snowball fight between judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt.

programme.title: It's Not Goodbye Forever
programme.desc: The scout elves fly over their favorite places as they return to the North Pole, so Duff Goldman challenges the finalists to elf-ify a famous landmark; Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt award their Ambassadors of Confectionery Concoctions with $25,000.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season Open House
programme.desc: Autumn-inspired food, including chai chocolate truffles, white velvet soup, spicy cocktail puffs and jam cocktails.

programme.title: Classic Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Holiday dishes with a modern spin, including pumpkin Alfredo lasagna rolls, crispy truffled turkey and caramelized apple semifreddo cake.

programme.title: Friendsgiving Party
programme.desc: A cocktail-style Thanksgiving celebration with appetizer-sized versions of beloved holiday dishes, like stuffing arancini, turkey Waldorf bites, charred Brussels sprout crostini and a mulled cosmo cocktail.

programme.title: Santa's Grab Bag
programme.desc: Roasted fennel with Parmesan; creamy lobster pasta; chocolate almond cheesecake; citrus berry vermouth spritz.

programme.title: Holiday Desserts
programme.desc: Indulgent desserts and sparkling cocktails, including orange mousse with ginger snap crumble, peppermint patty sandwich cookies, hazelnut torte with chocolate espresso frosting and lemon hazelnut spritz cocktails.

programme.title: Kids' Gingerbread House Party
programme.desc: Giada treats her daughter Jade and friends to a party, where each guest makes their own gingerbread house; kid-friendly treats like s'mores popcorn, pizza grilled cheese, veggie forest with Parmesan ranch dip and frozen hot chocolate affogatos.

programme.title: Christmas at Giada's
programme.desc: Giada hosts a Christmas dinner for family and friends; on the menu, tortellini in Parmesan brodo, risotto with clams, braised lamb shanks with escarole and radicchio and a chocolate candy cane tower.

programme.title: Halloween Open House
programme.desc: Giada hosts a Halloween open house for neighborhood trick-or-treaters and their parents; Giada creates a spooky menu for her guests which includes Coconut Bones, Spooky Chicken Finger Sammies, Witches' Brooms and Here's Looking at Boo Treats.

programme.title: Happy Hour
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis hosts a fancy, vintage-inspired cocktail party and serves throwback recipes with a modern twist like bacon onion dip, a spiked gelatin mold and a Korean shrimp cocktail.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Feast
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis asks her Thanksgiving guests to each bring something to add to a large antipasti platter; spicy turkey breast cacciatore; smoky candied carrots and walnut gremolata; simple wilted greens; chocolate chunk hazelnut pie.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Brunch
programme.desc: The morning after Thanksgiving, Giada De Laurentiis feeds her guests with a brunch made from Thanksgiving leftovers; crispy turkey bites; cheesy root vegetable bake; sweet potato puffs; rye-spiked chai lattes.

programme.title: Christmas Sing-Along
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis throws a pre-Christmas party for the kids; holiday sing-along; cheesy chicken flautas; veggie voodle salad; chocolate-covered chips; apple pie soda à la mode.

programme.title: Christmas Dinner at Giada's
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis' family members exchange Secret Santa gifts; stuffed tricolore pork loin; roasted acorn squash agrodolce; chopped romaine and radicchio salad; black and white brownie ice cream cake.

programme.title: Chicken and Pie Party
programme.desc: One of Trisha Yearwood's favorite spots in Nashville is The Loveless Cafe; she spends the day putting a spin on her favorite dishes from the restaurant with recipes like cheesy angel biscuits and cornbread crusted fried pork chops.

programme.title: Giada's Turkey Day Feast
programme.desc: Giada has a step-by-step approach for planning and executing Thanksgiving; lemon and pea Alfredo; sweet and savory kale salad; prosciutto-wrapped turkey; for dessert, mascarpone cannoli cheesecake.

programme.title: That's a Wrap! Party
programme.desc: It's the day after Thanksgiving, and that usually means three things: college football, Christmas shopping and Thanksgiving leftovers; Giada marks the official start of the Christmas season with wrapping gifts and delicious food.

programme.title: Christmas Cocktails
programme.desc: A Christmas cocktail party and silly Santa gift exchange; holiday appetizers and favorite karaoke tunes; spinach artichoke panini bites; warm citrus marinated olives; chocolate coconut cake and burnt citrus cocktails.

programme.title: Santa's Cookies
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter Jade host a Christmas party for Jade and her friends; Giada prepares a batch of holiday cutout sugar cookies that the kids can decorate using a variety of fun toppings and frosting.

programme.title: Night Before Christmas Party
programme.desc: In Italy, the night before Christmas is celebrated with the Feast of the Seven Fishes, and Giada De Laurentiis hosts a family Christmas Eve dinner that honors this tradition.

programme.title: Holiday Kick-Off Brunch
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis kicks off the season with a buffet brunch that features the flavors of autumn; bacon cranberry scones with citrus basil butter; sweet potato; kale Spanish frittata; smoked salmon waffles with waffle bar; apple raspberry sangrias.

programme.title: Giada's Italian Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A look back at some great game day and tailgating recipes; jalapeno-stuffed curly dogs, buffalo pierogies, baked chicken tenders with cheese cracker breading and no-bake rocky road bars.

programme.title: Small Bites Pot-Luck Party
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis hosts an open house and makes a variety of Italian-themed appetizers; goat cheese-stuffed baby peppers; crispy chicken meatballs; shrimp fra diavolo bites; chocolate Christmas tree brownies; a whiskey spritz cocktail.

programme.title: Name That Holiday Tune Party
programme.desc: Giada hosts a party where guests are asked to come dressed as their favorite holiday song; guests enjoy Giada's festive menu that includes a mozzarella bar, chicken piccata skewers, slow-roasted mustard salmon and a Sparkling Cosmo Punch.

programme.title: Winter Wonderland Party
programme.desc: Giada hosts a holiday party for kids and transforms the house into a winter wonderland; guests get to make their own snow globes and enjoy a menu of creamy tomato soup, triple chocolate hot cocoa, crispy chicken sandwiches and Italian flag cookies.

programme.title: Family Christmas Dinner
programme.desc: Giada hosts family Christmas dinner and pulls out all the stops with a fun gift exchange and an elegant menu; she makes a simple standing rib roast, Blistered Baby Pepper Salad, cavatelli with Gorgonzola and tomatoes and a panettone trifle.

programme.title: Giada's Fall Festival
programme.desc: Giada hosts a harvest-themed festival for her neighbors; the feast includes roasted squash and Gorgonzola pizza, made with Giada's own pizza dough, complemented with Italian carrot salad and spiced apple cake.

programme.title: Friends Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Giada asks each family member to invite a friend and provides a personalized welcome message, the guests enjoy a menu of braised turkey braciole, bacon stuffing with radicchio and chestnuts, Brussels sprouts agrodolce and Parmesan Apple Pie.

programme.title: Thankful for You
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter, Jade, host a holiday party for friends; Jade helps prepare the menu, prep for the party and plan the activity of making homemade Christmas gifts for a teacher; the menu is a gourmet twist on kid favorites.

programme.title: Giada's Holiday Challenge
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis invites her cousins to bring an appetizer over for a Christmas party, and surprise guest Aunt Raffy judges which is the best; after the highly competitive game, Giada and her guests dine on a festive buffet-style meal.

programme.title: Giada and Raffy's Miracle
programme.desc: Giada is on a mission to recreate a family holiday recipe called miracle rice with her Aunt Raffy; the dish reflects generations of stories and memories; they also create a simple sorbet before ending the night with a grab-bag gift exchange.

programme.title: Italian Christmas Brunch
programme.desc: Giada hosts a formal brunch for her family on Christmas day, with a California twist; her menu includes beef tenderloin with scallion salsa verde, a crab and artichoke frittata, olive biscuits and a decadent chocolate panettone sformato for dessert.

programme.title: Live Well Party
programme.desc: Giada helps her girlfriends jump-start the new year with a fun gathering that focuses on wellness and self-care; she serves a buffet menu of her healthy wedge salad, broiled salmon with fennel salad, and herb de Provence roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Tricked-Out Turkey
programme.desc: A giant edible skating rink with fondant figurines for a surprise party; a non-profit organization requests a unique way to get kids excited about seasonal fruits and veggies for an upcoming cooking class.

programme.title: Main Street Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: A company commissions a five-foot replica of their local town Main Street decked out as a winter wonderland for their Christmas party; touring Reptile Company wants their company mascot, an Asian water monitor lizard, made for their holiday party.

programme.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
programme.desc: Brenda and Alisha create a larger-than-life-sized Nutcracker for a local dance academy's performance of the eponymous ballet; a non-profit organization commissions a turn-of-the-century house in Haiti for their annual fundraiser auction.

programme.title: Slam-Dunking Santa
programme.desc: The Osmond family asks Brenda and Alisha to build a replica of their 150-year-old log cabin for a fundraiser to benefit the National Multiple Sclerosis Society; Alisha's relatives surprise their son with a basketball-themed Santa Claus cookie.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol Creation
programme.desc: Hale Centre Theatre in Salt Lake City is launching its 34th season of "A Christmas Carol," and Brenda and Alisha are asked to create their grandest build yet; a build to thank a local firehouse.

programme.title: Countdown to Cookie
programme.desc: Brenda and Alisha use a drone to help them design a shortbread replica of the City County Clock Tower and its Romanesque architecture; a replica of an English cottage-style home as the centerpiece for a holiday brunch.

programme.title: Naughty or Nice
programme.desc: Bakers vie to create the definitive gingerbread showpiece; they receive a competition curveball mid-challenge that requires them to switch gears from assembling gingerbread to creating holiday treats to act as functional parts of their final pieces.

programme.title: Santa's Most Incredible Workshop
programme.desc: Three bakers race to create their take on a gingerbread North Pole; the judges hand out some praise and some cold critiques while trying to decide whose gingerbread piece is good enough to give its creator a trip to the grand finale.

programme.title: Ultimate Holiday Celebration
programme.desc: Three finalists create their biggest Ultimate Holiday Celebration scene; the competitor that wows the judges the most will win the grand prize and be featured in Food Network Magazine as the first Holiday Gingerbread Showdown Champion.

programme.title: If These Walls Could Talk
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Birthright
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Voice Of Reason
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: A Stitch In Time
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Unnatural Selection
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I Hear You Calling
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Beyond The Veil
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: First Anniversary
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Straight And Narrow
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: The Refuge
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Inconstant Moon
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: From Within
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Afterlife
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: The Deprogrammers
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: The Light Brigade
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Out Of Body
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: The Sentence
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Bits Of Love
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Second Thoughts
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Re-Generation
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical...it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Last Supper
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Stream Of Consciousness
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Dark Rain
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: The Camp
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Heart's Desire
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Tempests
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: New Lease
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Double Helix
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip...to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Dead Man's Switch
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Hearts And Minds
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Music Of The Spheres
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: In Another Life
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: The Revelations Of 'Becka Paulson
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Bodies Of Evidence
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Feasibility Study
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: A Special Edition
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: In The Zone
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Rite Of Passage
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Criminal Nature
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Relativity Theory
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn't trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Glyphic
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Identity Crisis
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: The Vaccine
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Fear Itself
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: The Joining
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: To Tell The Truth
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Mary 25
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Final Exam
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: The Origin Of Species
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Lithia
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He's welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Sarcophagus
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: The Balance Of Nature
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Phobos Rising
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Black Box
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: In Our Own Image
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He's emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Alien Radio
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Donor
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Small Friends
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: The Grell

programme.desc: In this thrilling creature feature, a young boy's life is turned upside-down when alien invaders intent on taking over the world land in his backyard!

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: When a beautiful alien hybrid (Natasha Henstridge) escapes from his lab, a scientist (Ben Kingsley) hires a team of experts to find her before she is able to mate and produce offspring. It's a desperate battle and the fate of humanity is at stake!

programme.title: Species II
programme.desc: When an astronaut morphs into an alien entity, impregnating women with deadly results, a clone of Eve (Natasha Henstridge) is sent to hunt him down. But they underestimate Eve's maternal drive...and now only the strongest species will survive!

programme.title: Lifeforce
programme.desc: Steve Railsback stars in this frightening journey into the unknown as a mission to investigate Halley's Comet discovers an alien craft whose seductive leader begins a terrifying campaign to drain the lifeforce of everyone she encounters!

programme.title: Strange Invaders
programme.desc: Unaware the entire citizenry has been replaced by aliens, a professor arrives in a Midwestern town looking for his ex-wife who vanished.

programme.title: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programme.desc: In this cult-classic, a driven scientist discovers that his x-ray vision formula brings with it incredible powers...and incredible temptations.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its ownand is controlling him through telepathic messages!

programme.title: Yongary: Monster From The Deep
programme.desc: In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!

programme.title: Reptilicus
programme.desc: Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

programme.title: Ghoulies
programme.desc: It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

programme.title: Ghoulies II
programme.desc: The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: Lady In White
programme.desc: When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

programme.title: Dead Of Winter
programme.desc: Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Most moms are wonderful cooks, this one...likes it raw! Something's been eating Clay Dwyer. His mom! Once a sweet lovable lady, she's been bitten by and transformed into a flesheater, turning her into a hungry creature with a knack for good old homestyle cooking. What is Clay to do? To everyone else she's a monster that must be destroyed. But to him she's still MOM.

programme.title: Blood And Chocolate
programme.desc: A young teenage werewolf (Bruckner) is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man (Dancy).

programme.title: The Town That Dreaded Sundown (2014)
programme.desc: 65 years after a serial killer terrorized the town of Texarkana, the so-called 'moonlight murders' begin again. Is it a copycat or something even more sinister? A lonely high school girl, with dark secrets of her own, may be the key to catching him.

programme.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
programme.desc: Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

programme.title: Audrey Rose
programme.desc: Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.

programme.title: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)
programme.desc: For the Ushers, their house is more than just a home...it's their tomb...as Vincent Price goes to ghastly lengths to end his family's bloodline forever.

programme.title: Pit And The Pendulum
programme.desc: Happily-ever-after goes under the knife in this horror classic, a saga of murder, madness and forbidden desire.

programme.title: The Premature Burial
programme.desc: In this ghoulish tale, Ray Milland stars as a painter whose obsessive fear of being buried alive compels him to build himself a tomb with a view!

programme.title: Tales Of Terror
programme.desc: Three short stories based on the works of Edgar Allan Poe, with Vincent Price in the starring roles and directed by the great Roger Corman.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: Scream legends Vincent Price, Peter Lorre and Boris Karloff are three rival sorcerers whose paths cross when one is turned into a raven by another!

programme.title: The Haunted Palace
programme.desc: A century after a warlock was burned alive, his descendant (Vincent Price) inherits the family estate and the horrors of the past return to haunt him.

programme.title: The Masque Of The Red Death (1964)
programme.desc: Death and debauchery reign in the castle of Price Prospero (Vincent Price)...and when it reigns it pours...in this lavish Edgar Allan Poe adaptation.

programme.title: The Tomb Of Ligeia
programme.desc: Vincent Price's deceased first wife, Ligeia, casts a long shadow over his ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia's spirit returns.

programme.title: Dr. Phibes Rises Again!
programme.desc: The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!

programme.title: The Show Must Go Ozz
programme.desc: Sharon faces pressure from the powers that be at her talk show.

programme.title: Hawaii Five Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

programme.title: Kelly Interupted
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: Number One Fan
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.title: Born Bad
programme.desc: Defense attorneys for a foster child who killed argue that he was genetically predisposed to violence.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan's (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigation into a man's death leads them to a Russian mail-order bride (guest star Natalya Negoda). With Michael Moriarty.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: An emaciated elderly woman is found dead of an apparent heart attack; her granddaughter is charged with neglect and grave indifference to human life.

programme.title: Snatched
programme.desc: Kidnappers abduct the son of Schiff's friend and entomb him in the basement of an abandoned building.

programme.title: Breeder
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan help a young mother who claims her newborn baby was stolen from her after she gave birth in a taxi on the way to the hospital.

programme.title: Censure
programme.desc: Stone faces a tough court battle when a judge is placed on trial and claims the case against him is the vendetta of a former lover.

programme.title: Kids
programme.desc: Briscoe finds it difficult to arrest the son of his former partner when the teen is charged with the murder of a boy in a drive-by shooting.

programme.title: Big Bang
programme.desc: A physicist is linked to a package delivered through the mail that exploded and killed a rival's wife.

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigate five homicides in one chaotic day at the 27th Precinct. Guest stars: Alice Drummond, Victor Colicchio.

programme.title: Wager
programme.desc: The detectives investigate the death of a famous baseball player's father, who gambled his son's earnings on sporting events.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Racial tensions explode into violence after a middle-aged Jewish man leaves the scene of an accident involving a 12-year-old African-American boy.

programme.title: Nurture
programme.desc: A 10-year-old disappears after being taken from her alcoholic mother and placed with an abusive couple.

programme.title: Doubles
programme.desc: An investigation reveals a strange plot when a professional tennis player's wrist is broken after she finishes a practice session with a former rival.

programme.title: Old Friends
programme.desc: Stone contemplates resigning when the mob retaliates against his prosecution of a member of a notorious crime family.

programme.title: Second Opinion
programme.desc: A doctor is charged with murder for prescribing a treatment that caused toxic fumes to emit from a breast-cancer patient's body.

programme.title: Coma
programme.desc: Kincaid and McCoy have to decide whether to risk killing a comatose woman to recover the bullet they need as evidence.

programme.title: Blue Bamboo
programme.desc: A young actress claiming to have been the victim of a white slavery ring becomes the prime suspect when a wealthy Japanese businessman is murdered.

programme.title: Family Values
programme.desc: After the body of a wealthy woman is found in the East River, her daughter and her husband become murder suspects.

programme.title: White Rabbit
programme.desc: A safe-deposit-box company eventually exposes a political activist who went underground 20 years earlier to avoid a murder charge.

programme.title: Competence
programme.desc: Briscoe, Logan, McCoy and Kincaid try to clear Van Buren's name after she shoots a pair of young men who accost her at an automated teller machine.

programme.title: Precious
programme.desc: A girl found dead in a cooler may have been the victim of parents suffering from an unusual psychological illness.

programme.title: Virtue
programme.desc: McCoy and Kincaid find themselves in a unique situation when a high-powered city attorney accuses a city councilman of sexual harassment.

programme.title: Scoundrels
programme.desc: A corporate raider is linked to the murder of a sleazy lawyer who planned a class action suit against him.

programme.title: House Counsel
programme.desc: A juror bribed to throw the trial of a crime boss is murdered; the mobster's attorney is arrested for the crime.

programme.title: Guardian
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite's estranged daughter is killed, the detectives are led to the accountant responsible for the young woman's trust fund.

programme.title: Progeny
programme.desc: Kincaid and McCoy are determined to convict both the man who shot an abortion doctor and the activist whose rhetoric may have encouraged the incident.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: The probe of a Wall Street executive's murder leads to a top broker who has a history of criminal behavior.

programme.title: Performance
programme.desc: The investigation of a pornographer leads to a gang of teens who videotape their sexual exploits with female classmates.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Cerreta is shot when his cover is blown during his investigation of a South American gun-smuggling operation.

programme.title: Point of View
programme.desc: Two police officers have different points of view after witnessing what appears to be a nonviolent discussion by a couple outside a bar.

programme.title: Consultation
programme.desc: A smuggler dies when a heroin packet bursts in her stomach; officials accuse her diplomat boss of murder.

programme.title: Extended Family
programme.desc: When a Broadway director is accused of molesting his 5-year-old daughter, a social welfare activist abducts the child under the guise of protecting her.

programme.title: Seed
programme.desc: The probe of a woman's attempt on her husband's life leads to a fertility doctor with a high rate of success.

programme.title: Wannabe
programme.desc: Expelled from an exclusive boys school, an underprivileged youth, a gifted student, is suspected of a trustee's murder.

programme.title: Act of God
programme.desc: When an explosion at a construction site kills a boy, McCoy and Kincaid try to exonerate a demolitions expert wrongly convicted of the crime.

programme.title: Privileged
programme.desc: The stabbing murder of a husband and wife prompts Briscoe and Logan to investigate Steven Bartlett, an alcoholic who was abused as a child.

programme.title: Cruel and Unusual
programme.desc: After learning controversial therapy may have caused an autistic's death, McCoy must discredit the main witness.

programme.title: Bad Faith
programme.desc: The death of a fellow detective and childhood friend forces Logan to deal with repressed memories about the school he attended.

programme.title: Purple Heart
programme.desc: The investigations of seemingly unrelated murders of a cab driver and a hit man lead Briscoe and Logan to the cabbie's wife.

programme.title: Switch
programme.desc: The detectives arrest the father of a woman with multiple personalities for the murder of a psychiatrist.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: A newly elected, gay councilman's companion and his ousted opponent are suspects in the politician's murder.

programme.title: Bitter Fruit
programme.desc: A murder victim's mother fatally wounds the prime suspect in the case; then evidence suggests the woman hired her daughter's assailant.

programme.title: Rebels
programme.desc: Curtis seeks someone on the Internet with information about a wealthy collegian's murder in a biker bar.

programme.title: Savages
programme.desc: When McCoy and Kincaid disagree, Schiff must decide whether to ask for the death penalty in the murder of an undercover drug agent.

programme.title: Jeopardy
programme.desc: When a triple murder case ends with the suspect's acquittal, McCoy and Kincaid investigate the judge assigned to the trial.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit
programme.desc: When Briscoe and Curtis capture a couple after a violent crime spree, the woman claims she was forced to commit the crimes against her will.

programme.title: Paranoia
programme.desc: Briscoe and his new partner investigate murder at a college; McCoy risks a lawyer's disbarment to win a case.

programme.title: Humiliation
programme.desc: Kincaid prosecutes a case alone when she is certain that a prominent plastic surgeon who is accused of murdering a prostitute is guilty.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: The detectives investigate a kidnapping case involving a woman's claim that her infant vanished from a church while she was in the confessional.

programme.title: Blood Libel
programme.desc: An art teacher's murder leads the detectives to an anti-Semitic student and exposure of a pay-for-grades scandal.

programme.title: Remand
programme.desc: An arson suspect, hoping to make a deal, feeds detectives false information that may lead to the release of a convicted rapist.

programme.title: Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: Curtis and Briscoe's investigation into the death of a horse leads to a killer who may target more than animals.

programme.title: Trophy
programme.desc: Detectives link the murders of two male teens to a case that occurred five years earlier; McCoy fears he convicted the wrong man for the earlier murders.

programme.title: Charm City
programme.desc: A subway-station bombing prompts the squad to seek help from detectives in Baltimore where their prime suspect is wanted.

programme.title: Custody
programme.desc: Paul Robinette returns as a defense attorney representing a crack-addicted black woman accused of kidnapping her son from his adoptive parents.

programme.title: Right to Counsel
programme.desc: When a wealthy older woman is found dead in her apartment, Briscoe and Logan determine she was the victim of a lover's quarrel with her younger boyfriend.

programme.title: Night and Fog
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan investigate the death of a Holocaust survivor who discovered the man she married was accused of war crimes against fellow Jews in Poland.

programme.title: Promises to Keep
programme.desc: Briscoe and Logan investigate the murder of a woman whose troubled fiancé confesses to the crime, but insists his therapist forced him to do it.

programme.title: Mother Love
programme.desc: Stone is forced to bring a mother to court after she is charged with murdering her drug-addicted daughter.

programme.title: Encore
programme.desc: Michael Dobson, a sleazy nightclub owner, crosses the detectives' path again when his second wife is killed.

programme.title: Savior
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis' investigation of the murders of a mother and son leads to the father, but Kincaid uncovers the real killer.

programme.title: Deceit
programme.desc: The investigation of a gay man's murder leads the detectives to his former employer who sexually harassed him.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: A model's death seems to be an open-and-shut case until the prime suspect claims he suffered an extreme emotional disturbance and that he loved the victim.

programme.title: Slave
programme.desc: A shooting incident leads Briscoe and Curtis to a teen who had been given to a drug dealer to settle his mother's drug debts.

programme.title: Girlfriends
programme.desc: A father and daughter running a prostitution ring become prime suspects when Briscoe and Curtis investigate the death of a college student.

programme.title: Pro Se
programme.desc: Multiple murders lead detectives to a homeless schizophrenic who has been off medication for some time.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis (Jerry Orbach, Benjamin Bratt) investigate the poisoning of an infant in a wealthy neighborhood.

programme.title: Aftershock
programme.desc: Briscoe, Curtis, McCoy and Kincaid witness an execution and try to come to terms with their roles in the killing of another human being.

programme.title: Causa Mortis
programme.desc: McCoy and his new partner, D.A. Jamie Ross, handle a difficult case involving a carjacking and murder.

programme.title: I.D.
programme.desc: The detectives investigate a case involving a woman who was killed for her identity by her own sister.

programme.title: Good Girl
programme.desc: A young woman of Italian descent changes her story when her fingerprints turn up at the apartment of a murdered black college student.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: In a twisting, turning whodunit, Briscoe and Curtis (Jerry Orbach, Benjamin Bratt) investigate the murder of a rare-coin dealer. With Sam Waterston, Carey Lowell, S. Epatha Merkerson and Steven Hill.

programme.title: Corruption
programme.desc: A crooked cop testifies against Briscoe after the detectives are involved in a botched drug-bust leading to a drug-dealer's death.

programme.title: Double Blind
programme.desc: A mentally ill college student participating in experimental drug research becomes a suspect in a janitor's murder.

programme.title: Deadbeat
programme.desc: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the murder of an underhanded used-car salesman who was wanted for unpaid child support.

programme.title: Angels and Aliens
programme.desc: Investigating whether angels might really be travelers visiting Earth from distant planets.

programme.title: Aliens and Monsters
programme.desc: Theorists speculate that a flying creature described by Hindu scripture may have been an alien craft; researchers wonder whether centaurs and other fabled creatures were the result of extraterrestrial transplantation procedures.

programme.title: Aliens and the Secret Code
programme.desc: People consider whether ancient man's spectacular structures were built by humans alone or with otherworldly visitors.

programme.title: The Mayan Conspiracy
programme.desc: Extraterrestrial visitors may have influenced Mayan culture and helped ancient Mayans make striking advances in science, mathematics, time keeping, and astronomy.

programme.title: Alien Power Plants
programme.desc: Ancient alien theorists speculate about the depiction of light bulbs in Egyptian hieroglyphs and the batteries discovered among Mesopotamian artifacts and whether extraterrestrials introduced electricity to ancient peoples.

programme.title: Beyond Nazca
programme.desc: Hundreds of gigantic lines extend for miles throughout the Peruvian desert; scholars are divided as to who built them, and why; experts say Nazca may have been a mining operation for advanced beings.

programme.title: Alien Devastations
programme.desc: The story of the Great Flood; extraterrestrial battles that caused wide-scale destruction; reports of UFOs lurking in the shadows of recent natural disasters; The Book of Revelations and the Dead Sea Scrolls.

programme.title: Columbo Goes to the Guillotine
programme.desc: An egocentric psychic murders his old mentor, a magician charged to expose him as fraud, by beheading him while he's rehearsing his guillotine trick.

programme.title: Murder, Smoke and Shadows
programme.desc: A Hollywood director tries to fool Columbo when a studio becomes a murder scene.

programme.title: Sex and the Married Detective
programme.desc: The disheveled detective gets some free advice from a world-famous sex therapist.

programme.title: Grand Deceptions
programme.desc: The detective is called in to investigate the death of a sergeant major at a training camp.

programme.title: Murder, a Self Portrait
programme.desc: Homicide detective Lieutenant Columbo investigates the murder of a famous painter's ex-wife.

programme.title: Columbo Cries Wolf
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the disappearance of the director of a men's magazine.

programme.title: Agenda for Murder
programme.desc: The disheveled detective investigates the apparent suicide of a notorious racketeer who was facing an indictment.

programme.title: Rest in Peace, Mrs. Columbo
programme.desc: When a crooked estate agent dies in prison, his widow vows to exact her revenge on the two men that put him there. After killing her husband's informing boss, she sets her sights on Lieutenant Columbo.

programme.title: Uneasy Lies the Crown
programme.desc: A dentist frames his wife for a murder in order to keep up his image and expensive lifestyle.

programme.title: Murder in Malibu
programme.desc: A famous romance novelist is shot dead in the course of what looks like a robbery.

programme.title: Columbo Goes to College
programme.desc: The rumpled lieutenant is invited to give a college lecture on criminology but ends up investigating the murder of one of the institution's professors.

programme.title: Caution: Murder Can Be Hazardous to Your Health
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the murder of a crime show host's rival with incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Columbo and the Murder of a Rock Star
programme.desc: Columbo is put to the test against an equally brilliant, criminal defense lawyer who murders his rock star girlfriend.

programme.title: Death Hits the Jackpot
programme.desc: A police detective questions a jewelry-store owner whose late nephew had a winning lottery ticket.

programme.title: No Time to Die
programme.desc: Columbo attends his nephew's wedding and as the couple get ready to leave on their honeymoon, the bride disappears; Columbo investigates and suspects his nephew may have made a few enemies on the police force.

programme.title: A Bird in the Hand...
programme.desc: Columbo investigates a hit-and-run, followed by a car explosion.

programme.title: It's All in the Game
programme.desc: Two women kill their two-timing lover but have solid alibis; one of the women tries to seduce Columbo to keep him off her trail.

programme.title: Butterfly in Shades of Grey
programme.desc: Columbo investigates a case involving argumentative radio talk show host Fielding Chase.

programme.title: Undercover
programme.desc: The disheveled detective sets out to solve an unusual double murder in which two men have apparently killed each other.

programme.title: Strange Bedfellows
programme.desc: The detective is put on the case of a man who murders his brother.

programme.title: A Trace of Murder
programme.desc: Columbo matches wits with a forensics specialist, helping his girlfriend to frame her husband for a stockbroker's murder.

programme.title: Ashes to Ashes
programme.desc: The inimitable cop must prove that a flamboyant Hollywood gossip reporter was murdered by her former lover.

programme.title: Murder With Too Many Notes
programme.desc: A Hollywood film composer and conductor murders a talented, young musician out of jealousy.

programme.title: Columbo Likes the Nightlife
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the apparent suicide of a tabloid reporter in the Los Angeles rave scene.

programme.title: Prescription: Murder
programme.desc: Dr. Ray Flemming (Gene Barry) is a psychologist with a wealthy wife (Nina Foch). One night, at the couple's anniversary party, Ray receives a call from his patient and mistress, Joan (Katherine Justice). Ray's wife suspects that the two are having an affair and threatens to divorce him. Ray and Joan conspire to kill Ray's wife, with Joan providing the alibi. The pair are sure they've gotten away with their crime until Lt. Columbo (Peter Falk) starts sniffing around.

programme.title: Ransom for a Dead Man
programme.desc: Lt. Columbo (Peter Falk) outwits a lawyer (Lee Grant) who has killed her husband but made it look like a kidnapping.

programme.title: Murder by the Book
programme.desc: A blackmailer interferes with a mystery writer's scheme to kill his former partner in a perfect crime.

programme.title: Death Lends a Hand
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the case of an unfaithful wife who was murdered when she refused to be blackmailed.

programme.title: Dead Weight
programme.desc: No body, no weapon and a witness courted by the war hero she thinks committed murder, complicate a case.

programme.title: Suitable for Framing
programme.desc: Columbo is caught in a case of stolen art and murder with evidence pointing to an innocent woman.

programme.title: Lady in Waiting
programme.desc: A competition between bitter siblings for ownership of a family-owned corporation, after their father's untimely death, escalates into murder.

programme.title: Short Fuse
programme.desc: An explosion kills an executive as he calls his wife from a car phone, and suspicion falls on a company attorney.

programme.title: Blueprint for Murder
programme.desc: Columbo excavates the area surrounding the newly poured foundation of a building to search for a corpse.

programme.title: The Greenhouse Jungle
programme.desc: A botanical collector involves his nephew in a kidnapping to break a trust fund, then murders him to finance his hobby.

programme.title: Étude in Black
programme.desc: The mistress of a conductor becomes a target for murder after threatening to tell all to her lover's wife.

programme.title: The Most Crucial Game
programme.desc: A football-team manager (Robert Culp) establishes an electronic alibi for the murder of the team owner (Dean Stockwell) during a game; guests Valerie Harper, Susan Howard, James Gregory, Dean Jagger.

programme.title: Dagger of the Mind
programme.desc: Columbo journeys to London to observe Scotland Yard, but winds up investigating murders committed by two Shakespearean actors.

programme.title: Requiem for a Falling Star
programme.desc: The ongoing feud between an out-of-favor Hollywood actress and a gossip columnist results in murder. Guest star: Anne Baxter.

programme.title: A Stitch in Crime
programme.desc: A surgeon kills a nurse who suspects him of intentionally botching the heart surgery of his colleague, a cardiac expert.

programme.title: The Most Dangerous Match
programme.desc: An American chess champion plays a private match with his challenger and kills him because the man is a better player.

programme.title: Double Shock
programme.desc: Twins (Martin Landau in a dual role) kill their wealthy uncle just before his marriage to a younger woman.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.
