programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: Christmas in Compton
programme.desc: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

programme.title: A Family Matters Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.

programme.title: My One Christmas Wish
programme.desc: Feeling alone during the holidays, a college student (Amber Riley) places an ad to find a family to spend time with her on Christmas.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

programme.title: My One Christmas Wish
programme.desc: Feeling alone during the holidays, a college student (Amber Riley) places an ad to find a family to spend time with her on Christmas.

programme.title: Hope Street Holiday
programme.desc: Afro-Latina attorney Galia Garcia returns to her small hometown after being dumped days before Christmas. With the help of a 5-year-old orphan, her crazy aunties and the magic of the season, Galia heals from past trauma, rediscovers her self-worth and falls in love all over again.

programme.title: Christmas in Compton
programme.desc: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

programme.title: Greyson Family Christmas
programme.desc: An ambitious African-American law student returns home for Christmas with her boyfriend. The family is unsettled because the boyfriend is white.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: All About You
programme.desc: A woman (Renee Goldsberry) falls in love with her former boyfriend's brother (Terron Brooks) while living with him.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?
programme.desc: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: American Violet
programme.desc: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton).

programme.title: From the Rough
programme.desc: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team and subsequently guides her misfit players to an all-time-record championship season.

programme.title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
programme.desc: The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. There is a tagger who discovers that not all gangsters die hard, a foolish Texas oil fortune heir who kills for money but can't afford to stay living, and a huge rap star who uncovers a few skeletons in his dressing room that try to kick down his door.

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Zoe Reynard (Sharon Leal) seems to have a charmed life. She has a wonderful, loving husband (Boris Kodjoe), two beautiful children and a thriving career. However, as perfect as her life might look to other people, Zoe is secretly tormented by nymphomania. Her need for constant sexual gratification leads her into a secretive existence -- one that, ultimately, may put her family, career and life on the line. Based on a novel by Zane.

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: Jonathan Fisher (Christopher Reeve) is a reporter struggling to keep his job at a magazine. Assigned to write a real-life prostitution exposé, he fails to gain information from his subjects and decides to make up his own story about a pimp. The piece revives his career, but his fictional character turns out to be strangely similar to Fast Black (Morgan Freeman), an actual pimp, who is outraged and demands that Jonathan spill his sources. When the police get involved, matters get even uglier.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, a high-school basketball player, his sister and their older brother face life-changing decisions as they struggle to make something of themselves.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: Dragged Across Concrete
programme.desc: Police partners descend into the criminal underworld after they are suspended for assaulting a suspect on video.

programme.title: Dig
programme.desc: Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Coriolanus
programme.desc: Caius Martius, aka Coriolanus (Ralph Fiennes), is an arrogant and fearsome general who has built a career on protecting Rome from its enemies. Pushed by his ambitious mother (Vanessa Redgrave) to seek the position of consul, Coriolanus is at odds with the masses and unpopular with certain colleagues (James Nesbitt, Paul Jesson). When a riot results in his expulsion from Rome, Coriolanus seeks out his sworn enemy, Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler). Together, the pair vow to destroy the great city.

programme.title: Fatale
programme.desc: After a wild one-night stand, a successful sports agent watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is a determined police detective who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he desperately tries to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.title: Fatale
programme.desc: After a wild one-night stand, a successful sports agent watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is a determined police detective who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he desperately tries to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. Joined by a Swedish businessman (Joel Kinnaman), the youths emerge from hiding days later and must somehow fight back against a nearly invisible enemy that could find and disintegrate them at any moment.

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.desc: Danny is abducted and badly wounded by Wo Fat's wife, who is after the cypher Steve's mother left him; Steve finally solves the case his father left for him 10 years ago.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: Unmarried yuppies Patty (Melanie Griffith) and Drake (Matthew Modine) move into an expensive dream home in a high-end neighborhood in San Francisco. As they renovate the house, they look for a tenant for the first floor of their house. Carter Hayes (Michael Keaton) seems like a great fit at first, but it transpires that he is a con artist who plans to swindle them out of their real estate. As Hayes tries to drive them out of their own home, the couple must take drastic measures to fight back.

programme.title: Among Wolves
programme.desc: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

programme.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
programme.desc: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

programme.title: Eat My Dust!
programme.desc: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

programme.title: Eat My Dust!
programme.desc: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

programme.title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
programme.desc: Julien Temple's film is a fitting tribute to one of Britain's most influential and best-loved musicians, best known as the frontman of The Clash, who mellowed in later life into fronting his new band, the Mescaleros. Temple's advantage is that as a chronicler of punk from its earliest days, he could call on his own archive footage as well as that shot by others over the years.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Luv
programme.desc: Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

programme.title: Homegrown
programme.desc: Marijuana growers Jack (Billy Bob Thornton), Carter (Hank Azaria) and Harlan (Ryan Phillippe) are looking at a big payoff for their crop -- until head honcho Malcolm (John Lithgow) is murdered. Wanting a bigger piece of the proverbial pie, the three men decide to keep Malcolm's demise a secret, selling the stash themselves and pocketing all the profits. But, when they get involved with some very dangerous characters in the drug industry, the men start to question the wisdom of their scheme.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Dawg
programme.desc: After a lifetime of wooing, bedding and then leaving women without giving them a second thought, the self-centered Douglas Munford (Denis Leary) finds himself having to reflect on the hurt he has caused -- that is, if he wants a big inheritance from his late grandmother. According to Anna (Elizabeth Hurley), the estate's executor, Douglas must find 12 of the women he mistreated and get their forgiveness. Thus, the man who earned the nickname "Dawg" begins his journey of redemption.

programme.title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
programme.desc: Called to a French monastery following the appearance of a dead body, Detective Pierre Niemans (Jean Reno) finds himself investigating what appears to be a radical cult killing that's based on obscure passages from the Bible. When fellow detective Reda (Benoît Magimel) shows up, his own murder investigation intertwining with Niemans', it becomes clear that a grand conspiracy is underway, one that spans the globe and reaches all the way back to World War II.

programme.title: Down by Law
programme.desc: A disc jockey (Tom Waits), a pimp (John Lurie) and an Italian tourist (Roberto Benigni) escape from jail in New Orleans.

programme.title: Glengarry Glen Ross
programme.desc: When an office full of New York City real estate salesmen is given the news that all but the top two will be fired at the end of the week, the atmosphere begins to heat up. Shelley Levene (Jack Lemmon), who has a sick daughter, does everything in his power to get better leads from his boss, John Williamson (Kevin Spacey), but to no avail. When his coworker Dave Moss (Ed Harris) comes up with a plan to steal the leads, things get complicated for the tough-talking salesmen.

programme.title: Class of 1984
programme.desc: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: A kung-fu student avenges the slaying of his master, with help from his master's clan.

programme.title: Night of the Demons
programme.desc: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As he wanders in the desert, Jesus Christ (Ewan McGregor) tangles with Satan (also McGregor) for the souls of a nomad (Ciarán Hinds) and his family.

programme.title: Living in Oblivion
programme.desc: Independent film director Nick Reve is making his first feature. Everything that can go wrong does: the rebellious catering crew refuses to replace spoiled milk, his actors are flaky and getting an unspoiled take is nearly impossible. Tension between lead actress Nicole and actor Chad, who have just slept together, contributes to the many problems on set. As money and time run out, Nick struggles to complete his film.

programme.title: Midnight Sun
programme.desc: Sheltered since childhood, 17-year-old Katie Price lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight. Her world opens up after dark when she ventures out to play her guitar for random travelers. One night, Katie encounters Charlie, a young man she's secretly admired for years. As fate leads to a budding romance, Katie desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

programme.title: House
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: Fitzcarraldo
programme.desc: Opera-loving European Brian Fitzgerald lives in a small Peruvian city. Better known as Fitzcarraldo, this foreigner is obsessed with building an opera house in his town and decides that to make his dream a reality he needs to make a killing in the rubber business. In order to become a successful rubber baron, Fitzcarraldo hatches an elaborate plan that calls for a particularly impressive feat -- bringing a massive boat over a mountain with the help of a band of natives.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: They won't stay dead! They keep coming back in a bloodthirsty lust for human flesh! Pits the dead against the living in a struggle for survival!

programme.title: My Sassy Girl
programme.desc: A guy (Jesse Bradford) has his life planned out, until he is wooed, groomed and then dumped by an elusive woman (Elisha Cuthbert).

programme.title: Kingslayer
programme.desc: Soon to be crowned king of England, Richard the Lionheart has an attempted courtship turn quickly into a race for survival. Ambushed during a romantic encounter, Richard and his stable maid Lea fight for their lives.

programme.title: On Golden Pond
programme.desc: Cantankerous retiree Norman Thayer (Henry Fonda) and his conciliatory wife, Ethel (Katharine Hepburn), spend summers at their New England vacation home on the shores of idyllic Golden Pond. This year, their adult daughter, Chelsea (Jane Fonda), visits with her new fiancée and his teenage son, Billy (Doug McKeon) on their way to Europe. After leaving Billy behind to bond with Norman, Chelsea returns, attempting to repair the long-strained relationship with her aging father before it's too late.

programme.title: Nightbreed: Director's Cut
programme.desc: Aaron Boone (Craig Sheffer) is haunted by terrifying nightmares of a city of monsters. He goes to see a psychiatrist, Dr. Decker (David Cronenberg), for help. But what Boone doesn't know is that Decker is really a serial killer. Decker frames Boone to take the fall for his murders, and Boone is killed by the police. But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Legionnaire
programme.desc: When ambitious boxer Alain LeFevre refuses to accept a mobster's bribe, he ends up with a price on his head. A marked man, LeFevre takes refuge by enlisting in the French Foreign Legion. After traveling to a remote Moroccan outpost, LeFevre and his regiment suffer repeated attacks at the hands of the Berber rebel army. As he struggles to survive his tenure as a legionnaire, LeFevre dreams of returning to France to find his lady love, Katrina.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: Project Struck Out / 69 GTO Part 1
programme.desc: As Tommy and Peyton resume work on their 1966 Chevy Nova, they suddenly learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out. With that, they switch gears into another historic muscle car, 1969 Pontiac GTO.

programme.title: Resurrecting A '67 Camaro From Nightmare To Dream Car
programme.desc: We pay it forward helping to resurrect a Camaro that is more than just a car for its owner. And we'll head to Las Vegas to meet some Matco Tools merchants who believe in making a living through giving.

programme.title: FErocious Ford Part 1
programme.desc: We bring back our beloved 1965 Ford flatbed shop truck and drop in a naturally aspirated 586 HP FE old-school V8 built by Engine Power.

programme.title: Tacoma Trail Rig Transformation
programme.desc: To build a Trail Rig, you've gotta tear it down before you can build it up! The XOR Tacoma goes to center stage for suspension and drivetrain upgrades.

programme.title: OBS Pro Touring Chevy Heads to the C10 Nationals and Hits the Track
programme.desc: We add the final touches to our OBS Pro Touring Chevy C1500 and take it to the C10 Nationals where we put it to the test at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: Carcass Off-Road Excursion
programme.desc: The Carcass crew invites a few friends out for a day on the trails. We put our Jeep JK to the test and flex it in the hills of East Tennessee.

programme.title: Dodge Gets a Serious Horsepower Boost
programme.desc: The Dodge got a serious HP boost. Now, it gets the suspension, brakes, and tires it needs to succeed on the track!

programme.title: Super Street 427ci SBC Part 1
programme.desc: We kick off a ground up build based around Summit's brand new, specially designed Small Block Chevy engine block. Featuring a large bore and stroke equaling 427ci, this robust platform will become the foundation for a high horsepower, pump gas, street dominator.

programme.title: Installing Tacoma Suspension Upgrades
programme.desc: Our Tacoma get suspension upgrades for our Straight Axle Toyota. Plus, our Pre-Runner Ranger gets alignment ready.

programme.title: Upgraded Induction and Valvetrain Makes Great Power on our Small Block Mopar
programme.desc: Our 410ci Magnum gets supporting upgrades, including a bigger camshaft, better cylinder heads, and high-flowing induction.

programme.title: '74 Bronco Chills with Aftermarket Air Conditioning
programme.desc: We wrap up the assembly of our Bronco as it gets a fuel system, exhaust, brakes, trim, gauges, and new air conditioning.

programme.title: How to Build a 1000HP Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make 1000 Horsepower starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: Tearing Down A 1974 Bronco
programme.desc: We kick off an exciting new build! We'll drive, teardown, and media blast a 1974 Bronco to uncover what lies beneath 40+ years of abuse.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 3
programme.desc: Driving a monster truck isn't easy, but Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live host, Tommy Kane, shows you how, when he gets behind the wheel of a legendary monster truck. Don't miss the action and the behind the scenes look of our Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live trucks!

programme.title: Tearing Down a Duramax to Prep for 1000 HP
programme.desc: We take apart our 6.6L Duramax from our '11 Denali HD for an upgrade to 1000HP. Plus, we meet a diesel junkie who built a Cummins powered Ford Ranger pocket rocket for the dragstrip.

programme.title: First Gen Bronco Gets a Modern Suspension
programme.desc: Our '74 Bronco build is getting a suspension overhaul plus new axles, brakes, wheels and tires! And John Kramen from Mecum Auctions stops by to check on the progress.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 2
programme.desc: With Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live returning to the big screen, see our Designer Round Table and learn about the design process in making a toy monster truck. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live gives you an under the hood look at the iconic cars that call the Hot Wheels garage home.

programme.title: Starting the Transformation of a 1972 Camaro Split Bumper Into A Full Tilt Race Car
programme.desc: The Carcass crew starts a new project, taking a rough around the edges 1972 Camaro Split Bumper and turning into a powerhouse race car. We tear this car down to make room for a set of mini wheel tubs and a new fuel cell.

programme.title: Bringing Back To Life '65 Chevy C10
programme.desc: LT and Austin pull a '65 C10 project off the rollback and make plans for its revival.

programme.title: Over 13:1 on Pump Gas! Chevy 350 Dyno Mule - Part 1
programme.desc: Last year we built a 350 ci Small Block Chevy in the parking lot. This year it comes inside for some well-deserved upgrades to the short block assembly.

programme.title: Tune & Tone
programme.desc: Is custom exhaust worth it on a budget build? The age-old question - does tone matter when dollars do? Will our custom exhaust take our Lexus IS250 up a notch, or will we have to cut back to finish our build.

programme.title: Fuel Fiasco - Project UnSanctioned Part 3
programme.desc: The Carcass guys continue the build of their grassroots BMW race car. Addressing some problems with the factory fuel system that could hinder their performance on the track. Plus, they install vital components to get UnSanctioned fired up.

programme.title: Junkmail Jeep's Big Tires Means More Body Clearance
programme.desc: The guys make room on Junk Mail for bigger wheels and tires with a few body modifications. We make some custom bumpers and add a roll cage. Then we get the body of the frame for final welding and paint

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 6 Some Assembly Required
programme.desc: The MCT shop has the chassis back from powder coat. We start putting all of the pieces together, and install some of the vital components to get our sport truck up and running.

programme.title: Reviving a High Mileage '69 Camaro
programme.desc: Destination "fun-town," Marc and Tommy are taking a '69 Chevy Camaro RS/SS to the next level! With performance, handling, and appearance upgrades, it's time to revive this ultra-cool muscle car giveaway ride.

programme.title: Caddy Hearse Hits The Drag Strip To Prove Its Power
programme.desc: We take our hefty hearse down the eighth mile with a little help from some throttle in the bottle ... Plus, some old school tech that may hit home.

programme.title: A 632 Big Block Chevy Is the Perfect Fit For This '77 Tow Truck Sleeper
programme.desc: We build a 632 big block Chevy to power an unusual hot rod project for the Carcass shop.

programme.title: Bringing A 1964 Ford F350 Flatbed Back From The Dead
programme.desc: We rescue a 1964 Ford F350 flatbed that hasn't run in 5 years. If we can get it started in the field we'll haul it back to the shop to make it safe and driveable again. It might even become our new shop truck!

programme.title: 632ci EFI BBC Part 1
programme.desc: Pat and Frankie kick off a new season with an old favorite: their 632 cubic inch Big Block Chevy. Used as a test bed for several different configurations over the years, this big inch bullet gets torn down for a refresh and an update to get it ready for a very special street rod project! A bump in compression, custom hydraulic roller cam, trick new EFI system, and a make-over are on the to-do list as they start the final iteration of this pump-gas powerplant.

programme.title: Jeep Wagoneer Transformed: "TrashHawk" Hits The Track
programme.desc: After completing final work on our TrackHawk inspired 1986 Jeep Wagoneer we call TrashHawk, it's time for some high performance fun at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park track.

programme.title: Boosting A Crown Vic Police Interceptor 160 Horsepower
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc almost double the horsepower on a 2008 Ford 4.6L Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor. The solution for more power is adding a small tailpipe turbo, exhaust and fuel mods. Then the dyno don't lie! From 200HP to 368HP, this Vic is ready for high pursuit!

programme.title: Ford F-100 Down to the Wire
programme.desc: Inching ever closer to putting Clint Black's Ford F-100 project to bed, Eric and Joel scrap all the old wood, refresh some essentials, and wire the engine to fire.

programme.title: Ram SRT-10 and F150 Get Lowering Kits: Muscle Trux Build-Off Suspension
programme.desc: Dropping it down for better traction, our SRT-10 Ram and EcoBoost F150 get new lowering kits. Plus, installing Detroit Truetrac limited slips, locks in more grab and go!

programme.title: Ram SRT-10 and F150 Get Engine Mods: Muscle Trux Build-Off: Drivetrain
programme.desc: Will the EcoBoost's larger turbos and a high flow exhaust mean bigger improvements over the Viper's top end mods? Let the build-up begin!

programme.title: Turning a '76 Cadillac Hearse Into A Torque Monster
programme.desc: We take a '76 Cadillac Hearse and start turning it into a torque monster that will scream down the track starting with the drivetrain.

programme.title: Hard Charger - Rear Suspension
programme.desc: Our 1969 Dodge Charger gets an all-new rear suspension and an upgraded dash.

programme.title: High Tech Slant Six Gets Boosted
programme.desc: We give our Slant Six a huge induction upgrade, a custom EFI system, and a turbocharger. Then we put it under pressure in the dyno cell.

programme.title: Machine Shop
programme.desc: Our shop's latest addition is a cylinder hone that'll make quick work of custom engines.

programme.title: Hard Charger - Interior and Out Back
programme.desc: We get the seats covered on Hard Charger, and she gets a fresh look from the rear.

programme.title: Stopping this Old C10 From Spewing Fuel and Fire
programme.desc: The tuner aftermarket for Jeeps is thriving! A supercharged JK makes some impressive power gains on the dyno, thanks to HP Tuners.

programme.title: Worn Out Ride to Rejuvenated Retro Rocket: Hurst Olds Part 4
programme.desc: We wire up and cool off our legendary Mondello big-block Olds engine to take the Hurst's performance from worst to first. Plus we'll refresh the interior to jive with its 80s vibe.

programme.title: Becoming Legendary: Road Burner Hits the Hot Wheels Legends Tour Part 7
programme.desc: Forget everything you think know about patina cars, because we are going to school you on how mother nature's handiwork, combined with some elbow grease, can create a masterpiece worthy of a Hot Wheel.

programme.title: 440ci Motown LS Race Engine: Part II
programme.desc: We finish the assembly of our 440 with a conventional SBC bottom end and LS induction. Then we put it on the dyno and see how many ponies it puts out!

programme.title: Tackling The Worn Out Road Runner Interior - Part 4
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel give the '69 Road Runner's interior a much-needed makeover. We'll restore the dash and give the seats and headliner some much needed attention.

programme.title: Drifting Trailblazer SS Gets a New Carbon Fiber Hood
programme.desc: From Stock, to powerful... Our Trailblazer SS gets a refresh in the power department, and some style points with a carbon Fiber Hood.

programme.title: C10 Teardown and K1500 Goes Rally Racing
programme.desc: LT and Austin start the teardown process and make some upgrade decisions for Project Lo 'n Slo.

programme.title: SEMA Trucks 2019: Joey Logano's 850 Horsepower NASCAR/Street Rod Fusion Truck
programme.desc: PowerNation invites you for the lifted, lowered, overlanders, Jeeps and SUVs, plus drifting with Joey Logano at the 2019 SEMA show in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Hot Rod Godzilla
programme.desc: We get our hands on Ford's new 7.3 liter pushrod V-8 Godzilla engine and see how it stacks up against the other BIG 3 swap engines. After doing a baseline test, we'll make some modifications by throwing the Engine Power touch on it and see what this beast lays down in the dyno cell.

programme.title: Twin Big Blocks Dyno'd Together Part 2
programme.desc: Today, it's do or die. We connect TWO 496 Big Block Chevy engines to the dyno to find out exactly how much power two of the same engine will make running in tandem!

programme.title: Project Fat Stack - Part 12
programme.desc: Interior Decorated - Tommy and Joel cut a rug and freshen up the rest of Fat Stack's interior to match the flashy exterior of their 1971 Chevy Caprice.

programme.title: 632 ci Big Block Chevy Build for Project Wild & Willys
programme.desc: A high-compression 632 ci Big Block Chevy provides massive power for XOR's Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Tacoma Trailblazing
programme.desc: Our 2001 straight axle Tacoma goes exploring at Adventure Off-Road Park.

programme.title: Tacoma Topper
programme.desc: Our 2001 Toyota Tacoma gets a canvas topper, plus Jeremy and Eliza help a young couple with their restoration of a 1978 Chevy K10.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 5: Tunnel Vision
programme.desc: The MCT Crew takes our '72 Super Cheyenne, Project Cream Puff, and tackles the challenge of building a custom transmission tunnel to make room for the new automatic trans. Plus, we'll cut and shape our fenders to install new wheel tubs for a cleaner look and accommodate our lowered stance.

programme.title: Tension Prevention With New Suspension For The '71 Caprice -Fat Stack Part 3
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit the powder room to freshen up the frame on Fat Stack, a 1971 Chevy Caprice, while upgrading their suspension in disbelief.

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: Help for a '79 F100
programme.desc: Helping a viewer it's time to breath some life into a 1979 Ford F100. From spark to fuel we find some problems and we've got some solutions to get his ride back on the road!

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 445 FE Gets Modern EFI
programme.desc: Our 445 FE is back, a modern EFI system, along with a time-tested tunnel wedge intake made for drivability.

programme.title: Will the Ford 300 Inline Six Start After Sitting for 20 Years?
programme.desc: From freeway to farmyard, this rugged straight six was everywhere! It's the subject of our latest build.

programme.title: Rebuild or Buy: Pros and Cons of a Powerstroke Failure
programme.desc: Rebuild or buy? This is Austin's diesel dilemma after his daily driver breaks down in the driveway. Plus Dragonali, our '11 Denali HD gets traction bars and fender clearance for bigger wheels & tires.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 4 Taking Shape
programme.desc: Our Silverado is still in the shop getting a few more modifications. We'll add our fuel and brake lines, plus fabricate our double duty exhaust on our frame. We'll strip down the cab inside and out. Then, we'll work on the truck bed to make way for some custom touches like a roll pan and a DIY bed cover.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Custom Paint
programme.desc: After months of prep, the '89 Blazer hits the paint booth for a custom mix of color. And to accompany the panels will be a color-matched bedliner.

programme.title: Time for our Supercharged EBC Mustang To Burn Rubber at the Track
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle team goes all in to reveal their supercharged ground-pounding pony at SEMA 2021 in Vegas.

programme.title: 1980s Mustang Cobra Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: This hissing Cobra gets dialed in with final touches, taking it from concept to coiled and ready to strike! Strap in for Project Sydewinder's first track day!

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 1
programme.desc: As Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live rolls into Edinburgh, TX, grab a behind the scenes look and meet the legendary monster trucks, including Bone Shaker and Tiger Shark. Get a sneak peek of our superstar freestyle motocross riders and the car-eating, fire-breathing robot, Megasaurus.

programme.title: Ford vs Chevy: Small Displacement Showdown
programme.desc: The TIMELESS Debate is on. Ford vs. Chevy. We start with a stock 305 Chevy and a 302 Ford. After an initial baseline, we see how they stack up against each other with the same mild upgrades. We find out, dollar for horsepower, who comes out on top.

programme.title: 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco Is Ready To Roll
programme.desc: Today we finish the final assembly of our 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco with the installation of the interior.

programme.title: 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod Gets Improved Suspension
programme.desc: We upgrade our 280Z's suspension to give it better handling. We also take a look at what new products NISMO has designed and developed for customizing your Nissan project.

programme.title: Strengthening The Chassis Of The 1972 Camaro Split Bumper
programme.desc: Our 1972 Camaro gets outfitted with a custom roll cage to help strengthen the chassis. Plus, we strip down the front subframe prepping it for cleanup.

programme.title: Bolt-On 100+ Horsepower in a Day
programme.desc: Power upgrades are great especially if you can bolt-on big performance in a day. Mike and Pat grab some wrenches to install a ProCharger supercharger on a 2019 Challenger ProCharger.

programme.title: Abandoned Chevy Silverado Gets A Junkyard Motor Refresh - Part 2
programme.desc: We work on a forgotten Chevy project, a 1996 Chevy Silverado. We head out to the junkyard to source a drivetrain, then we're back in the shop to make them roadworthy again.

programme.title: Assembling a 410 Mopar with High Flow Induction
programme.desc: Mopar fans rejoice! Chrysler's venerable muscle car powerplant gets a big cubic inch increase and the induction package you've been asking for.

programme.title: Modern 410ci Stroker Windsor with Custom EFI & Coil-Near-Plug Conversion - Part 1
programme.desc: This Small Block Ford receives big power upgrades, including a forged rotating assembly, competition-ported cylinder heads, and a supremely accurate crank trigger system.

programme.title: Project Shell Shock - Brakes, Wiring & More!
programme.desc: This week on our '56 Chevy 210 Gasser, we're checking a few more things off the list. We'll install new brake pads, drop in some fresh taillights, and show you a few wiring tips to help keep things clean and simple. We're also adding power windows for a little extra comfort, and giving our interior trim panels a quick facelift with some fresh paint. It's all about knocking out the details that make this classic that much better.

programme.title: Dually Draggin' a Ram 3500 Cummins Turbo Diesel
programme.desc: Judgement day for our Ram dually on both the dyno and dragstrip.

programme.title: Singing Lessons
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Charger gets its voice on this episode, as Tommy installs the exhaust and suspension that'll make this mopar sing!

programme.title: Freeing Clint Black's Flooded F-100
programme.desc: Eric and Joel unearth a piece of country music history as they kick off the new season with Clint Black's fabled 1960 Ford F-100 from the "Killing Time" video.

programme.title: Dropping A 350 Chevy Into The Junkyard Square Body
programme.desc: We pump up the power on our Junkyard Find Tow Truck. Plus a rusted-out floor in the cab has made it a danger to drive.

programme.title: Cruisin' Caprice Wagon
programme.desc: The Carcass builders bring in an old 1984 Chevrolet Land Yacht to give it some custom touches for some family fun. They will tear down and clean up 40 years of dirt, then start replacing worn out suspension parts to get this wagon road worthy.

programme.title: Project Fat Stack: Restoring The 1971 Chevy Caprice Front Grille
programme.desc: Face Value - For their 1971 Chevrolet Caprice, the guys restore a hard-to-find grille and finish the fuel system to fully power the supercharged LS.

programme.title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 2 LS Tear Down & Front-End Rebuild
programme.desc: The 6.2-liter V8 engine of our Chevy Avalance, project DragAlanche, is stripped down and prepped for machine work as the foundation is laid for future performance upgrades. Then, the front suspension gets a major overhaul, replacing worn factory components with fresh parts to deliver the stance, adjustability, and performance needed for both street driving and drag strip action.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 4: Making The Bed
programme.desc: The MCT Crew have the frame shortened on Project Cream Puff and it's ready for its new bed. The guys give you a couple of options on how to tackle a short bed conversion, then start assembling their new one. Plus, get a little help with choosing what kind of floor we want for our custom C-10.

programme.title: Compression Obsession: A Bigger Block
programme.desc: Our Small Block Chevy cracked during a cold snap. So we're going to take its guts, put them in a bigger 406ci block, and prep it for bigger power!

programme.title: 1977 F-150 Gets Some Much Needed Upgrades
programme.desc: We open the mailbox and answer some long-awaited viewer questions. We'll also hit the road to rescue a 1977 Ford F150 in need of repair.

programme.title: Camaro Test Drive and English Drag Racing
programme.desc: The guys take a test spin in the Valvoline Giveaway Camaro, and swing by the last remaining drag strip in England for a day of hot passes.

programme.title: Will The Overlanding Toyota 4Runner Upgrades Hold Up On The Trail? - Part 4
programme.desc: Our Overlanding Toyota 4Runner gets a new exhaust and a few creature comforts to help us while exploring the wild. Then the guys head out to Mother Nature's playground to see how it all performs.

programme.title: Custom Race Inspired Fuel System for a Buick Regal
programme.desc: With a nod to the Grand National we're giving our Buick Regal more Go Go. Fabricating a race inspired fuel system gets us one step closer to our '85 Buick Regal launch.

programme.title: Style Over Substance: Muscle Trux Build-Off
programme.desc: With power taken care off, improvements in the good-looks department include cowl hood, custom wheels, plus tips on restoring old paint

programme.title: '96 Chevy Tahoe Gets Fresh Suspension & Steering
programme.desc: We bring a 96' Chevy Tahoe into the shop and show you what trouble areas to look for when buying a project. Then we teardown the front end and freshen up our suspension and steering components making our SUV roadworthy.

programme.title: A Pair of New Horseshoes
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton get to work on their 1990 Mustang. They install a new front and rear suspension in Project Fast Lane Fox Body to handle its new engine.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 4 Steering Upgrades
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are adding a custom steering setup to their 2002 Ford Pre-Runner Ranger!

programme.title: Ram Diesel Fuel System Upgrades
programme.desc: We've up'd the horsepower of our 2016 Ram dually with the air side of things, now onto fuel. A 2nd generation fuel system is installed with new injection & lift pumps to support 770 HP.

programme.title: Disguising a High Revving 347 for our Sleeper Granada
programme.desc: Our Granada has plenty of Seventies Style, but precious little power. This sounds like a good candidate for a sleeper build!

programme.title: Lift & Shift
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: 318 LA Resurrection
programme.desc: We're bringing our 318 back for redemption as we tear this wounded small block down and see what went wrong. We find the culprit, repair the damage, and get it back on the Dyno to finally see what this custom Mopar makes at its full potential.

programme.title: This Camaro Drives Like a Bulldozer, But Not After Swapping in a Low Buck Vortec
programme.desc: Part 1 of the Autocross Camaro Build. We introduce the Camaro that we'll transform into an autocross machine, and it all starts with an engine swap.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets 1-Ton Dana 60 Axles
programme.desc: The transformation continues on this clean '85 K-10 square body. We remove the cab and axles, then tear it down to the bare chassis. We'll unveil some exciting upgrades to give this '80s TV show knockoff a modern day appeal.

programme.title: Ditching The Chevy S-10's Leaf Spring Setup In Favor Of A 5-Link Kit
programme.desc: We tear into our Low-Fi S-10 project and the rear suspension is our focus. We remove the bed & suspension and leave it frameless. Then we put it all back together and lower it to the ground. Plus, we give you some great welding and plasma cutting tips.

programme.title: Supercharging Our Drift Trailblazer To Push It Past the 500 HP Threshold
programme.desc: Part 4 of the Drifting Trailblazer. Jeremy and Jimmy wear out some tires with their drifting Trailblazer SS, after pushing it past 500HP on the dyno.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 7: Powertrain to Pipework
programme.desc: We mate the engine and transmission in the '72 Chevy C-10 Project Cream Puff for a flawless drivetrain setup, then dive into making our own brake lines with tips for safety and precision. Then we tackle the exhaust, fabricating a system that is clean and simple.

programme.title: Back to Basics Part IV
programme.desc: We bring you straightforward information and tips to make your next engine build go quicker and easier!

programme.title: New Chains
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Land Cruiser LQ4
programme.desc: The guys at Dirt & Trails task us with finishing out an engine for their latest weekend wheeling rig, a 1987 Toyota Land Cruiser. We customize and dyno tune a hopped up LQ4 to make their off-roader dead reliable and have over triple the power.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 7 Carbon Fiber Installation and Rear Assembly
programme.desc: Our '72 Camaro is in the shop to start shedding some weight. We'll build our carbon fiber quarter panels. We also fabricate a new fuel fill system to accommodate our relocated tank.

programme.title: 66 Pontiac Convertible Interior Overhaul
programme.desc: Marc and Tommy finish up the interior of our '66 Pontiac convertible. Plus we head out on another Driveway Rescue helping a viewer with their '69 Cutlass project.

programme.title: Drifting Trailblazer SS Is Ready for the Track After Suspension Upgrades

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue
programme.desc: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it's swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they're targets of the CIA! Crikey!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Set against the wondrous backdrop of the Great Pyramids, "Stargate" tells the story of two very different men (Kurt Russell, James Spader) who join forces to unravel the mystery of a curious artifact which could reveal the origin of civilization.

programme.title: State Of Grace
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: When a drifter falls in love with two women, he finds himself trapped in a web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this genre collision of biker, heist, buddy flick and sci-fi pic!

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programme.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
programme.desc: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

programme.title: The Born Losers
programme.desc: When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: 52 Pick-Up
programme.desc: In this tense thriller, Roy Scheider has it all until a trio of pornographers shows up with a video of him in bed with his mistress. When he tries to pit one blackmailer against the other, the tension mounts - as does the possibility of murder.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: Cherry 2000
programme.desc: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents' brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.
