programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Moon Over Parador
programme.desc: When the iron-fisted ruler of a small African nation dies, his top aide, Roberto Strausmann (Raul Julia), will do anything to avoid a regime change, so he recruits struggling film actor Jack Noah (Richard Dreyfuss) to pose as the deceased political leader. Jack looks just like the man he's portraying, and, with Strausmann's expert instruction, he successfully fools the world. But as Jack falls for ravishing humanitarian Madonna Mendez (Sônia Braga), he decides to use his influence for good.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Sipping Gin in Sapa
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: The Highland Fling
programme.desc: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: The Three Amigos
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: San Fran Summer of Love
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

programme.title: Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

programme.title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

programme.desc: Krasis, High Priest of Atlantis has been summoned by the Master to help him find the crystal of Kronos. The Master uses TOMTIT to summon threats from the past to attack UNIT.

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: As UNIT approaches, the Master leaves for Atlantis in his TARDIS. However, the Doctor is not far behind and in the time vortex, the two Time Lords confront each other.

programme.title: Part Five
programme.desc: Arriving in Atlantis, the Master seduces the beautiful Queen Galleia so that he might possess the crystal of Kronos. But it is protected by a guardian who is half man, half beast.

programme.title: Part Six
programme.desc: With the crystal of Kronos in his possession, the Master prepares to release the Chronovore. The Doctor is powerless to stop his nemesis as the end of Atlantis approaches.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: Nurse
programme.desc: A young nurse (Katrina Bowden) begins to suspect that a sexy colleague (Paz de la Huerta) is responsible for murdering a string of unfaithful men.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Separated from their father (Michael Kelly), two teenage sisters (Sofia Black-D'Elia, Analiegh Tipton) try to survive an apocalyptic viral outbreak that leads to a quarantine.

programme.title: Iron Mask
programme.desc: To save his homeland from certain doom, a kung fu master must escape from the maniacal James Hook in order to send his daughter a secret talisman that will allow her to control a massive and mythical dragon.

programme.title: Hirokin
programme.desc: A warrior (Wes Bentley) leads an uprising against the ruler (Julian Sands) of a planet.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Highlander II: Renegade Version
programme.desc: In this sci-fi/fantasy sequel, Connor MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) has become an elderly man after losing his immortality. Living in a bleak future where the world is protected from solar radiation by a massive shield, MacLeod regains his youth when he kills two assassins from his home planet. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: While battling a trio of rampaging giants, the legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters Nimue the Blood Queen, an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

programme.desc: Two best buddies (James Corden, Mathew Horne) encounter a nest of beautiful Sapphic bloodsuckers.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes."

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: Sorry to Bother You
programme.desc: In an alternate reality of present-day Oakland, Calif., telemarketer Cassius Green finds himself in a macabre universe after he discovers a magical key that leads to material glory. As Green's career begins to take off, his friends and co-workers organize a protest against corporate oppression. Cassius soon falls under the spell of Steve Lift, a cocaine-snorting CEO who offers him a salary beyond his wildest dreams.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4

programme.desc: Love goes awry when Bill tries to stop Cissy from marrying Gregg. Bill takes Cissy to a party to distract her. Cissy meets a man named Steve and realizes she is not in love with Gregg.

programme.title: Stamp of Approval
programme.desc: Bill and Jody try to get on the good side of female friends in order to get something they want. Bill wants a job at her company, and Jody wants a stamp for his collection.

programme.title: And Baby Makes Eight
programme.desc: Cissy's friend Kathy is pregnant, and her husband is out of town.

programme.title: Say Uncle
programme.desc: Jody and a classmate taunt each other with claims of "my father can beat your father," but the parents refuse to fight each other.

programme.title: Class Clown
programme.desc: Laughter is the best medicine but not for every date. Bill goes out with a female comedian who seems to always be performing her act.

programme.title: The Unsinkable Mr. French

programme.title: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: The family goes on vacation to Indiana, where Cissy, Buffy, and Jody grew up. Bill wants them to touch base with the relatives still living there and to see their hometown.

programme.title: Feat of Clay
programme.desc: Buffy and Jody accidentally break a small statue originally from Columbia and try to fix it before Uncle Bill finds out about it.

programme.title: Heroes Are Born
programme.desc: Jody's newest hero figure is a football superstar who is Uncle Ken to one of Jody's friend. When Jody finds out that Ken is suspended from the team for placing bets, Jody is disillusioned.

programme.title: Nobody Here But Us Uncles
programme.desc: The twins play matchmaker for Uncle Bill so he has someone in his life when they get older and move out.

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Struggling actor Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) dreams of landing a role, but soon learns you have to "dream" up your own roles. Keenen Ivory Wayans and Anne-Marie Johnson also star.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

programme.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
programme.desc: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: A boxer on-the-rise is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Bucktown
programme.desc: Fred Williamson and Pam Grier star in this tense action drama about a man who comes to Bucktown to bury his slain brother.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is a professional killer. Now, on the eve of his retirement, he must make a deadly decision.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two New York detectives suddenly find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in the world's most notorious prison colony, two tougher-than-nails inmates enact the ultimate jail break.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: A photojournalist Friday Foster (Pam Grier) witnesses the attempted assassination of a prominent African-American figure. Now she is a target!

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: A prison psychiatrist (the legendary Sidney Poitier) is charged with treating a hate-filled young man (Bobby Darin).

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier stars as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: Duel At Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) discovers that he's the only one who believes that his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Salt & Pepper
programme.desc: Legendary Rat-Packers Sammy Davis, Jr., and Peter Lawford star as London's hippest nightclub owners who take on England's craziest criminals!

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Fed up with patriarch Mr. John Henry Brooks Jr.'s tyrannical rule, Mrs. Brooks and the kids are fighting back!

programme.title: Amazing Grace (1974)
programme.desc: Pious, church-going widow and grandma Grace (Jackie "Moms" Mabley) has a mouth that could take on the devil himself and the resolve to smack down an even bigger evil: politics!

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Old Truck, Old Frame, New Game
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a well-worn '59 Chevy Apache pickup and shows how to approach a project, whether you are keeping it original or planning on modifying it.

programme.title: Making the Bed on a Classic Truck
programme.desc: Stacey digs into building a brand-new bed for the '59 Apache right beside the old one!

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Long Train Running
programme.desc: Stacey goes out on the rails to take a look at the restoration of the Legendary 576 Steam Locomotive.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Swamp Spryte Axles and Tracks and McLaren M6GT Chassis Testing
programme.desc: Swamp Sprite Axles and Tracks and McLaren M6GT Chassis Testing.

programme.title: The Dirt Bird
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the Joe Dirt side of things and how an old, beat up Daytona made it cool to drive old, rusty junk; after that, he shows what it takes to make a high-end replica of a down-and-dirty car.

programme.title: The Face Off
programme.desc: Stacey demonstrates how to change a four-headlight classic Chevy truck into a two-headlight classic Chevy truck, just by changing some sheet metal. Is it as easy as it looks, or are there some hidden challenges waiting to bite you?

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ -- Mustang Transmission Swap
programme.desc: Stacey takes an old, beat-up '66 Mustang and puts some pep back in its step; he shows you how to replace an old automatic transmission with a quick-shifting Tremec T5 5-speed and how to lift an old cab or body off a frame without destroying it.

programme.title: Show Truck With a Diesel Twist and Capping a Gladiator
programme.desc: Stacey looks at a new twist on tool storage and sets up a Jeep Gladiator for your outdoor adventure needs!

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Prepping for surgery; the Level 4 project.
programme.desc: Stacey walks through the challenges of taking a new frame and components, fitting it to an old, vintage body and all the things to think about while doing it.

programme.title: The Hot Rod Coupe: Fitting Body and Sheet Metal - Mighty Mite
programme.desc: Stacey continues to fit the old '40 Chevy body on the new replacement frame; he rolls in the "Mighty Mite" for some simple fuel system upgrades.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Jeepster: Moving on up to a level 2 Restoration
programme.desc: Stacey kicks it up a notch and moves on to a level two restoration, including mechanical and cosmetic, on an old Jeepster.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: The Shining
programme.desc: Stacey shows how to assess the condition of the paint and body on a project and lays out some of the factors involved in deciding between restoring old paint, or completely re-painting the vehicle.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Sasquatch or Swamp Sprite
programme.desc: Stacey manages to find a Thiokol Swamp Spryte, a rare all-terrain vehicle with a distinct footprint, and rolls it into the shop.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Swamp Spryte: Making Tracks
programme.desc: The Thiokol Swamp Spryte is back in the shop for some much-needed restoration, and replacing the aluminum skin so she will float again; Stacey rolls in the Lil' Red Wagon for some new suspension and 50 years of Skyjacker history.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: The Painless Wiring Way
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the unique story of Painless Performance and how they went from making wiring harnesses in a garage to one of the most influential companies in the automotive aftermarket.

programme.title: The McLaren M6GT Story and Building Your Own Replica
programme.desc: Stacey takes a look at the supercar, McLaren M6GT; with only a handful made, the originals are collectors' items; Stacey reveals the new M6GT component car that can be built from Retroformance.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: McLaren Mid-Engine Madness and a Bundle of Snakes
programme.desc: The M6GT replica is back in the shop, and it gets serious as Stacey stuffs a 600+ HP Kaase engine into the aluminum monocoque and layers it with an exquisite bundle of snakes exhaust system from GP Headers. If you've ever dreamed of owning a modern mid-engine car with the look of a classic McLaren, this kit is for you!

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: Getting the perfect project picture and making your stereo KICK!
programme.desc: Showing people how to take the ultimate picture of their project; Stacey sits down with KICKER to look at how the audio world has changed.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ: The Li'l Red Wagon; Can You Hemi?
programme.desc: Stacey tackles the tired old engine and transmission of the 1999 Dodge Li'l Red Wagon truck.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Whether it's an impossible dream build or installing the latest in aftermarket parts, Gearz host Stacey David can design, fabricate and put it together while helping you learn how to do it yourself.

programme.title: Night Under Fire - Getting by With a Little Help From Your Friends
programme.desc: Stacey and crew take everyone to one of the most amazing drag racing events in the country, the "Night Under Fire" in Norwalk, Ohio.

programme.title: Power Wagon - A New Day Dawning...The Rist of the M6GT
programme.desc: The M6GT is back, but now she's a running, driving car, and a prototype of the car that is available from Retroformance; Stacey goes through the design, development and trial and error it takes to bring a new component car to the market.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ -- Mustang Transmission Swap
programme.desc: Stacey takes an old, beat-up '66 Mustang and puts some pep back in its step; he shows you how to replace an old automatic transmission with a quick-shifting Tremec T5 5-speed and how to lift an old cab or body off a frame without destroying it.

programme.title: Show Truck With a Diesel Twist and Capping a Gladiator
programme.desc: Stacey looks at a new twist on tool storage and sets up a Jeep Gladiator for your outdoor adventure needs!

programme.title: The Stunt Double Final Reveal
programme.desc: The Stunt Double is back in the shop for its reveal and payoff; inspired by the FALL GUY truck, the Stunt Double is a ground up, frame off build of a square body Chevy truck that pays tribute to the stunt world.

programme.title: The Mod Rod, Stripping and Prepping a Cab
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in one of the show cars of the 1970s, the Mod Rod; after that, he shows how to properly disassemble the cab or body of your project and pre-fit some new components at the same time.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Cornwell Tools and 20 Years of Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is not only showcasing 20 years of a how-to show, but also the tools that make it happen; he dives into the world of video games and pinball to show where they started, where they went and where they are now.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Stripping Paint and Restoring Panels and Parts
programme.desc: Ins and outs of stripping paint and what you might expect to see once it's done; next, Stacey walks through the steps of restoring headlight buckets.

programme.title: The Power Wagon Rules
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the unique history of how a WWII vehicle became the first mass-produced civilian 4x4 truck; he upgrades the electrical and fuel systems on a '49 Power Wagon, so you can drive it safely.

programme.title: The National Museum of Military Vehicles
programme.desc: Stacey visits the National Museum of Military Vehicles to check out the gear that shaped history and some of the veteran outreach programs that people can get involved with.

programme.title: The Great Crate Debate
programme.desc: Crate engine or old school; Stacey walks you through how to choose the right components to put together a special drivetrain that performs or looks the way you want it to; he drops one in his '59 Apache pickup!

programme.title: Bivalves: Oysters and Mussels

programme.desc: Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

programme.title: Rustic Meets Refined
programme.desc: Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

programme.title: The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
programme.desc: Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

programme.title: Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
programme.desc: Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

programme.title: This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
programme.desc: Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

programme.title: Festive Thresholds & Holiday Styling Secrets
programme.desc: Designer Ashley Childers kicks off the festive season by transforming her front porch into a classic Christmas showpiece; step-by-step, Ashley reveals how to hang and layer lush garlands; she unpacks her top eight holiday styling secrets.

programme.title: Holiday Hosting Made Simple: Christmas Brunch & DIY Decor
programme.desc: Designer Ashley Childers shares holiday entertaining ideas and DIYs; watch as she builds a snack bar and sets a cozy Christmas brunch table; learn how to prepare her signature mulled wine alongside budget-friendly holiday DIY projects.

programme.title: Hocking Hills Hideaways
programme.desc: Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

programme.title: Innovation and Inlets
programme.desc: Levi explores the Sunshine State to find unique stays; he starts in Orlando at the Micro House, the state's first 3D-printed micro home; then, he heads to Key Largo to board Stay Ombi, a floating bungalow anchored in Buttonwood Sound.

programme.title: Ridge-Top Rituals and Riverfront Rejuvenation
programme.desc: In Rockbridge, Ohio, Levi tours The Pine at Dunlap Ridge which features a wall of windows that overlooks towering pines and farmland; then in Newry, Maine, Levi discovers The Cabin at Bear River, a luxurious escape inspired by Japandi design.

programme.title: Geometric Gems and Storybook Stays
programme.desc: Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale; he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome; then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

programme.title: One-of-a-Kind Cotton Mill Loft
programme.desc: Robert MacNeill opens the doors to his one-of-a-kind home-a converted loft inside an 1892 cotton mill that's anything but ordinary; with towering ceilings and massive factory windows, it's a stunning blend of historic charm and modern vision.

programme.title: It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
programme.desc: Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

programme.title: New England Modern Coastal Reno
programme.desc: Leia Ward transforms a traditional colonial home into a getaway with a fresh, coastal vibe.

programme.title: Artful & Eclectic Designer Dwelling
programme.desc: Andrea Schumacher shows her Colorado home which captures the essence of her adventures.

programme.title: Fran & Theresa's Family-Friendly Haven
programme.desc: Fran and Theresa's brand-new home is bustling - especially with 13 grandkids; their mission is to create a safe, family-friendly haven; with a long list of upgrades and no idea where to start, they need a hand.

programme.title: Eduardo & Gabriela's Guest Retreat
programme.desc: Eduardo and Gabriela's "little" home projects have piled up; with their grown son's room ready to become a guest retreat, an unfinished wallpaper job in the laundry room, and shades waiting to be hung, they're ready for Drew's help.

programme.title: Jack & Tyler's Colorful Curb Appeal
programme.desc: Jack and Tyler found their dream home with the perfect yard; they've made the inside picture-perfect, but now it's time for the exterior to shine; Drew helps repaint the fence, upgrade the front door, and add a few final touches indoors.

programme.title: Trimming the Tree
programme.desc: Dillon and Patra put their personal flair on an over-the-top tree topper and trim the tree from tip to toe.

programme.title: Winter Break Baking

programme.title: Modern Classic Christmas & Merry Modern Farmhouse

programme.title: Norman Fenton: The Art of Latin Flavors

programme.desc: Watch a Tea Time movie with Carol Wayne. Plus Doris Day has a bad neck, Rodney Dangerfield performs and Burt Mustin discusses his first visit to Hollywood in 1925.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Diane Keaton (12/28/72)
programme.desc: Diane Keaton talks about Christmas in her childhood. Gene Hackman also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Ricardo Montalban (8/1/73)
programme.desc: Remember Ricardo Montalban's "rich Corinthian leather?" The king of kitsch (Fantasy Island, 3 Planet of the Apes movies and Star Trek tv series and movie) reveals his obsession with bullfighting!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (10/2/73)
programme.desc: No one rocks a polyester leisure suit like sex god Burt Reynolds. Comic Buddy Hackett's orgasm-sneeze makes for really compelling TV. Master complainer Don Rickles rounds out the show.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (10/5/73)
programme.desc: Catch a rack of iconic rumpled raincoats worn by 4-time Emmy winner Peter Falk in his detective show Columbo. Dallas star Victoria Principal chats about quitting booze and cigarettes.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Gene Hackman (3/21/74)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Gene Hackman shows a watery clip from ocean liner disaster flick Poseidon Adventure. Also on this episode is Diane Keaton

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Jim Henson (5/24/74)
programme.desc: Even celebs like Suzanne Pleshette go to the dentist and suffer with ordinary phobias. Of course, Jim Henson's Muppets are the exception; they have perfect teeth!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (9/26/74)
programme.desc: Decked out in head-to-toe leather, Burt Reynolds shares a clip from The Longest Yard. Comic genius Dom DeLuise discusses his dog's issues and Honeymooners star Art Carney plays "September Song."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lilly Tomlin (2/20/75)
programme.desc: Lily Tomlin describes her Detroit childhood, creating a character by working a check-out counter and her career as a shoplifter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Michael Caine (12/5/75)
programme.desc: Oscar clubbers Michael Caine and Sean Connery share a clip from their movie The Man who would be King. Connery announces he's retiring from James Bond movies and Caine says he's now a wine merchant.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/2/77)
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds shows his vacation videos and talks about moving in next door to Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/30/77)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Bruce Dern talks about getting his big break and his neighbor Robert Redford. Psychiatrist Sam Dunkell analyzes dreams and sleep positions. `

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (5/20/77)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Mark Hamill (11/29/77)
programme.desc: Luke Skywalker, a.k.a. Mark Hamill, chats about the making of the iconic movie Star Wars and working with the legendary Alec Guiness.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Cloris Leachman (2/1/78)
programme.desc: Who's racked up more Emmys than anyone except Julia Louis Dreyfuss and Carl Reiner? Cloris Leachman. She talks to Johnny about growing up in Des Moines and doing live TV.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Goldie Hawn (2/22/78)
programme.desc: The bikini'd star of Laugh-in and Oscar winner Goldie Hawn talks about giving birth. And what's the big deal with King Tut? Buck Henry, who created Get Smart and wrote The Graduate has some thoughts.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/2/78)
programme.desc: Even stars get stiffed. Ask Bruce Dern. Comedian Robert Klein reports on making a movie with Burt Reynolds, and Dr. Carl Sagan bashes Star Wars for strangling science.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (8/2/78)
programme.desc: Pin up guy Burt Reynolds grouses about look-a-likes who impersonate him at public functions. Susan Sarandon demos relaxation techniques and reads Johnny's palm.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (4/4/79)
programme.desc: Rat pack darling Angie Dickinson chats about self defense training. Johnny practices the Heimlich maneuver on her with coaching from its developer, Dr. Henry Heimlich.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (6/21/79)
programme.desc: Celebrities at the pump; Burt Reynolds talks about waiting his turn. He also fesses up to coveting an Oscar. Jimmy Carter's mom, Miss Lillian, admits she doesn't like sleeping at the White House.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (12/20/79)
programme.desc: Acting icon Bruce Dern talks about working with Ann-Margret on Middle Age Crazy, and David Letterman scores laughs describing his visit to a nude beach and his dog's love life.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (12/30/80)
programme.desc: Actress Angie Dickinson, who's made over 50 films, chats about New Year's Eve parties, New Year's resolutions, her first date and coping with depression.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Alan Alda (5/19/81)
programme.desc: M*A*S*H* star Alan Alda discusses his career and the impact of celebrity on his life. Comedian David Brenner riffs on health food, controlling his weight and eating in New York.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bo Derek (7/24/81)
programme.desc: TV star Michael Landon gets sentimental over Bonanza; watching episodes dubbed in Japanese and promoting the show at county fairs. Actress Bo Derek talks about vine-swinging for Tarzan, the Ape Man.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (7/31/81)
programme.desc: Show biz veteran Angie Dickinson talks about men who whistle at women, Tommy Lasorda chats about losing weight, and Dom DeLuise dishes on doing an off-Broadway play with Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - John Travolta (8/6/81)
programme.desc: Actor/pilot John Travolta on flying lessons, dropping out of high school and getting his first part. Humorist Erma Bombeck complains that "housewives" on commercials don't look like housewives.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (2/11/82)
programme.desc: Heartthrob Burt Reynolds chats about his Cosmo centerfold and comedian Richard Lewis jokes about his dandruff, driving in LA and growing up in New Jersey.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Miss Piggy (7/12/84)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Fonda (1/4/85)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Candice Bergen (3/21/85)
programme.desc: Soon-to-be star of Murphy Brown, Candice Bergen chats about her marriage and how rude the French are. Comic actor Tim Reid says he was fired from show for not being "black enough."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Gary Busey (8/23/85)
programme.desc: Oscar nom'd for playing the title role in The Buddy Holly Story, Gary Busey has acted in over 150 movies. He talks about his early rocker days playing in a band at Disneyland and Knott's Berry Farm.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (1/2/86)
programme.desc: Catch outrageous flirting as Angie Dickinson denies rumors about her and singer Julio Iglesias. Then she gets all sweet and cozy on Johnny. "We are not strangers," she tells the audience.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (11/5/86)
programme.desc: The always virile Burt Reynolds reflects on his 1973 Cosmo poster, and his five-year romance with actress Loni Anderson. The maturing boy-toy-turned-movie-star is penning his autobiography.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - George C. Scott (11/3/87)
programme.desc: The first actor to refuse an Oscar, George C. Scott for the title role in Patton, chats about his love of theatre, the many bombs in which he's appeared and turning 60 years old.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (2/25/88)
programme.desc: Taking up the pen, Burt Reynolds discusses his work on his autobiography. He comments on his streak of box office flops. Burt warmly welcomes Eddy Edwards, Britain's one-man Olympic Ski Jumping team.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Cybill Shepherd (6/8/89)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Leonard Nimoy (4/3/91)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Sylvester Stallone (5/2/91)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - George Segal (11/8/91)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/12/92)
programme.desc: Whipped cream anyone? Burt Reynolds shows a clip of him squirting whipped cream down Johnny's trousers. Burt then shoves a can in his own pants and sprays his crotch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lily Tomlin (12/3/75)
programme.desc: Comic actress Lily Tomlin talks about her family's reaction to her one-woman concert and recounts her brother's arrest in Detroit for being in a car with a black woman.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Sylvester Stallone (5/21/82)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Tony Randall (6/21/77)

programme.desc: Lety escucha los planes de Fernando y Omar para conquistarla. Marcia regresa de Alemania. Tomás Mora y Fernando se conocen.

programme.desc: Lety comienza su venganza contra Don Fernando. Con el dinero de Filmo Imagen, Tomás y Lety compran un automóvil último modelo. Fernando está celoso.

programme.title: Por un chocolate
programme.desc: Lety le da celos a Fernando con Tomás. Fernando descubre que Lety utilizó dinero de Filmo Imagen para comprar el auto último modelo.

programme.title: Fiel como un novio
programme.desc: Lety le reclama a Tomás ser tan coqueto con Jazmín y le pide ser fiel con ella ante las del cuartel; Fernando ve a Lety y a Tomás entrando a casa de Lety, pero Julieta le niega todo por orden de Lety.

programme.title: El coche de la discordia
programme.desc: Lety llega a Conceptos en su auto último modelo y causa muchas sospechas. Omar le echa la culpa a Fernando de que Lety ya no esté enamorada.

programme.title: Él paga la cuenta
programme.desc: Lety invita a las del cuartel a comer a un restaurante fino. Omar cuestiona a Lola sobre la bolsa roja que estaba en su escritorio.

programme.title: Fidelidad
programme.desc: Luigi se asombra cuando Celso le dice que el novio de Lety le prestó ese automóvil; Fernando le dice a Omar que no ha tenido relaciones con Marcia desde que estuvo con Lety.

programme.title: La cita
programme.desc: Lety escucha a Omar darle ideas a Fernando para seguir conquistándola y decide que es el momento para vengarse de él.

programme.title: Más premoniciones
programme.desc: Jorge Flores le dice a Fernando que Lety va a perjudicarlo más que ayudarlo, y que mientras siga pensando que la empresa es lo más importante, estará perdido; Tomás convence a Lety de quedarse en el restaurante con Fernando.

programme.title: Morir de deseo
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Fernando que no quiere pasar la noche con él y huye en un taxi. Tomás se lleva el dinero de la caja chica para su cita con Alicia.

programme.title: Tan cerca y tan lejos
programme.desc: Fernando le escribe una carta a Lety y le pregunta si van a seguir juntos. Todos están esperanzados por la nominación de Conceptos en Cannes.

programme.title: Tomás y Alicia
programme.desc: Marcia le enseña las invitaciones de boda a Fernando y le pide a Lety que se haga cargo de repartirlas.

programme.title: De remate
programme.desc: Fernando y Omar escuchan a Lety reclamándole a Tomás por haber tenido una cita con Alicia, quien recibe la noticia de que van a rematar su automóvil y no puede hacer nada para recuperarlo.

programme.title: Mucho trabajo que hacer
programme.desc: Alicia escucha que Tomás está enamorado de Lety y le preocupa que la deje plantada. Luigi amenaza a Jazmín con despedirla si no sigue ensayando, y no deja salir a Irmita porque tienen mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El celoso
programme.desc: Fernando está muerto de celos, sigue a Lety y Tomás en su cita. Por otra parte, Alicia intenta seducir al novio de su peor enemiga.

programme.title: No los conoces
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Tomás sobre sus problemas económicos y él promete ayudarla; Ariel comienza a investigar todo lo relacionado con la empresa fantasma de Lety.

programme.title: ¿Cancelada?
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lety que cancelará su boda con Marcia, pero la novia todavía no se entera. Por otra parte, Fernando escucha a Alicia quejándose de la apariencia de Tomás. Teresita llega a Conceptos. Lety ve a Marcia con su vestido de novia.

programme.title: Preocupaciones
programme.desc: Irma se siente mal en una prueba de vestuario de Luigi y el diseñador le pide disculpas. Fernando y Omar empiezan a preocuparse por el balance que tiene que hacer Lety. Carolina se da cuenta de que entre Lety y Fernando hay algo más que amistad.

programme.title: Sufre por ella
programme.desc: Irma se recupera rápido gracias a sus amigas del cuartel y a Luigi. Por otro lado, Tomás sufre por estar lejos de Alicia y ella sigue lidiando con sus problemas económicos.

programme.title: Vida solitaria
programme.desc: Irma conmueve a las mujeres del cuartel y a Luigi cuando les cuenta sobre su vida solitaria. Después de su pleito con Fernando, Tomás sale con Alicia, quien lo hace olvidar el dolor.

programme.title: Rafael
programme.desc: Fernando le declara su amor a Lety, pero ella sigue dudando de él; Irma recibe la visita de Rafael, el hombre que la abandonó años atrás, y ella le cuenta todo lo que se perdió.

programme.title: Caminos separados
programme.desc: Lety decide aceptar la oferta de trabajo de Carolina. Don Humberto y Teresita le dicen a Marcia y Fernando que les darán una casa de regalo de bodas.

programme.title: La última
programme.desc: Lety no sabe si hacer o no el balance para la junta del consejo; Luigi termina de preparar la última presentación para Conceptos mientras cuida que Irma no se canse mucho.

programme.title: Celebración
programme.desc: Marcia hace todo lo posible para averiguar la identidad de la amante de Fernando; el equipo celebra el premio obtenido en Cannes; Ana Leticia intenta enamorar al Borrego Nava.

programme.title: Reencuentro
programme.desc: Ariel se entera de todos los problemas financieros de Conceptos; Fernando y Lety celebran el premio de Cannes; Alicia le prepara una cena romántica a Tomás.

programme.title: Primera noche
programme.desc: Alicia hace todo lo posible para que Tomás le dé el dinero que necesita; Lety y Fernando están muy nerviosos por la próxima junta de consejo.

programme.title: Se acabó el cheque en blanco
programme.desc: Cuando Lety se entera de los gastos de Tomás, decide quitarle la chequera de la empresa; Ariel hace todo lo posible para comprobar el verdadero estado financiero de Conceptos.

programme.title: La carta
programme.desc: Lety lee la carta de Omar donde describe todo el plan para no perder Conceptos conquistando a Lety. La junta de consejo, Lety y Marcia tienen un fuerte desacuerdo.

programme.title: Junta de consejo
programme.desc: Toda la verdad sale a la luz en la junta de consejo; Lety presenta el balance, Ariel revela el tema del embargo y Fernando se ve obligado a explicar al comité cómo fue que se endeudó y para qué creó Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: Vergonzosa despedida
programme.desc: Lety se despide de sus amigas del cuartel; Marcia le exige que le muestre lo que se lleva y descubre todas las tarjetas que Fernando le escribió.

programme.title: Sin amor
programme.desc: Teresita intenta tranquilizar a Marcia diciéndole que nada de lo que Fernando hizo con Lety fue por amor; Fernando le dice a Omar por qué piensa que Lety los delató.

programme.title: Lágrimas al mar
programme.desc: Marcia le informa a Carolina sobre la cancelación de la boda; Lety las escucha y se culpa por todo lo que está pasando.

programme.title: La miserable
programme.desc: Irma busca pretextos para no regresar a casa, pero Luigi insiste en llevarla; Omar le dice a Fernando que no le gusta nada el hecho de que Lety haya desaparecido.

programme.title: Casarse con el mar
programme.desc: Luigi le pide a Irma que le cuente la historia de su vida con Rafael; Carolina se molesta con Lety porque le dice que quiere regresar a la ciudad; Lety se encuentra un anillo y hace un ritual con el mar.

programme.title: Espíritu intranquilo
programme.desc: Fernando mira con tristeza la oficina de Lety. Aldo le cuenta a Lety por qué se distanció de su padre y le dice que ve en ella un corazón con mucho dolor. Julieta se niega a darle a Fernando información sobre Lety.

programme.title: Con la muerte tan cerca
programme.desc: Irmita les da noticias a sus compañeros de trabajo: el doctor dice que Rafael puede morir en cualquier momento.

programme.title: Transformada
programme.desc: Aldo le dice a Carolina lo sorprendido que está con el cambio de Lety. Marcia se molesta al saber que Lety salió de la ciudad y se burla de Fernando, pero él le confirma que está enamorado de Leticia.

programme.title: Nuestra belleza
programme.desc: Fernando se molesta con Omar y le pide que deje de ponerle apodos denigrantes a Leticia; Lety ayuda a las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza a repasar sus conocimientos generales.

programme.title: Cuestión de confianza
programme.desc: Las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza le agradecen a Lety por darles confianza y Aldo la felicita por compartir lo que aprendió con él; Jorge le hace una visita a Rafael.

programme.title: No te rindas
programme.desc: Tomás se niega a decirle a Julieta por qué Lety abrió Filmo Imagen y embargó a Conceptos; Teresita le pide a Marcia no darse por vencida con Fernando.

programme.title: Ideales
programme.desc: Aldo le confiesa a Lety que su padre se molestó con él por convertirse en chef en lugar de ingeniero y ella le expresa su admiración por ser fiel a sus ideales; Fernando busca a Lety en el bar de un hotel.

programme.title: Sin ti
programme.desc: Fernando está desesperado sin Leticia; Lety le confiesa a Aldo que no puede dejar de pensar en Fernando.

programme.title: Nuevas experiencias
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Lety que Aldo está encantado con ella. Aldo lleva a Lety a bucear y navegar. Irma presenta a su familia en Conceptos. Rebeca le informa a Luigi que quiere llevarse a Irma a Estados Unidos. Tomás acude de nuevo a la junta de Comité.

programme.title: Ahogado en un bar
programme.desc: Mónica le cuenta a Marcia que vio a Fernando muy borracho en un bar y que el barman lo estaba mandando a su casa en taxi; Marcia, a su vez, se lo cuenta a Teresita y ella se aflige mucho.

programme.title: Paseo en moto
programme.desc: Jessica le dice a Carolina que su miedo desapareció gracias a los consejos de Lety. Marcia le cuenta a Alicia que Fernando confesó estar enamorado de Lety. Aldo lleva a Lety en motocicleta por el puerto de Acapulco.

programme.title: Alianza femenina
programme.desc: Fernando le llama la atención a Alicia por no pasarle las llamadas y la molesta por la relación que tuvo con Tomás; Teresita le propone a Marcia una alianza para sacar adelante Conceptos.

programme.title: El dueño
programme.desc: Omar le dice a Teresita quién es el dueño de Conceptos; Simón le dice a Teresita y Marcia que Fernando salió de la empresa en muy malas condiciones; Fernando se estaciona enfrente de la lancha de Aldo.

programme.title: Golpeado en un bar
programme.desc: Fernando es sacado de un bar todo golpeado, pero logra volver a entrar; Lety interviene entre Aldo y Fausto para que se reconcilien; Fausto le entrega a Aldo una carta.

programme.title: Una oportunidad
programme.desc: Lety le cuenta a Carolina que pasó toda la noche con Aldo y se dieron un beso, por lo que ya no quiere volverlo a ver; Carolina le aconseja darse una oportunidad con Aldo.

programme.title: Cocinando juntos
programme.desc: Aldo le pide ayuda a Lety para cocinar para las concursantes del certamen Nuestra Belleza; Lety le pide no hablar de lo que pasó entre ellos; Fernando le confiesa a Omar haber ido a Acapulco para que lo mataran.

programme.title: El día del certamen
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando hablan a la casa de la familia Padilla, pero Julieta les cuelga; las del cuartel, en compañía de Paco, Celso, Simón y Raúl, ven el certamen Nuestra Belleza por televisión.

programme.title: Fórmula mágica
programme.desc: Fernando llega a la residencia de Jorge Flores, quien le da una fórmula para eliminar la tristeza y las angustias, con el fin de volver a ser el mismo de antes, en armonía.

programme.title: Acuerdo
programme.desc: En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.

programme.title: Sánchez y Rosales
programme.desc: Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.

programme.title: Perdonar
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.

programme.title: Cancelación
programme.desc: Marcia se disculpa con Fernando y le promete dejar de insistir en el tema de Lety. Por otra parte, Lety le comparte a Tomás lo que aprendió con Aldo.

programme.title: Desencuentros
programme.desc: Celso no deja a Lety entrar a Conceptos; Paula María se molesta al enterarse de que Simón llevó a Alicia a su casa en la motocicleta; Lola se niega a conciliar con Efrén por la presencia de Jazmín.

programme.title: Lety está de vuelta
programme.desc: Teresita le pide a Marcia que se presente en la sala de juntas; las del cuartel comentan la reacción de Marcia al ver a Lety.

programme.title: Un posible futuro
programme.desc: Aldo sigue a Lety hasta un autobús y se sube detrás de ella; Fernando se encuentra al vidente en un restaurante y recibe premoniciones sobre Lety y Marcia.

programme.title: Los licenciados
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez acepta darle seguimiento al divorcio de Lola; Alicia le coquetea al licenciado Santa María, pero no logra salir con él porque Rosales insiste en salir con ella.

programme.title: Relación laboral
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando reconquistar a Lety para que no se queden en la calle; Alicia se porta muy raro con Leticia, quien le pide a Marcia poner en claro su relación laboral.

programme.title: Vicepresidente
programme.desc: Luigi les cuenta a Carolina y Aldo por qué don Humberto nombró a Lety presidenta de Conceptos; Lety nombra a Tomás vicepresidente financiero de la empresa.

programme.title: Corajes
programme.desc: Fernando y Simón llegan al bar donde están las del cuartel; Simón hace corajes porque Paula María baila con otro y Fernando se molesta porque hay un hombre junto a Leticia.

programme.title: Ultimátum
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que les contó a las del cuartel que ya no son novios; el juez concede a Conceptos seis meses para liquidar su adeudo a Filmo Imagen antes de entrar a remate.

programme.title: Nuevo proyecto
programme.desc: Luigi presenta a Aldo con Marcia y le dice que trabajará con él en un proyecto ajeno a Conceptos; Alicia ofende a los pasajeros del autobús antes de bajar.

programme.title: Nuevas oficinas
programme.desc: Raúl instala a Tomás en la antigua oficina de Olarte y, al ver a Alicia hablar con Aldo, piensa que hay algo entre ellos; Lety toma su lugar en la que fue oficina de Fernando; Aldo y Fernando se conocen.

programme.title: Cizaña
programme.desc: Leti le pide a Alicia que cite a Marcia en la sala de juntas y Alicia aprovecha la oportunidad para meter cizaña.

programme.title: Plan de rescate
programme.desc: Marcia le ordena a Luigi presentarse en la junta; Lety informa al consejo sobre las concesiones que dictó el juez y propone el proyecto que pensó con Aldo para reunir el dinero.

programme.title: Reorganizando la empresa
programme.desc: Luigi anuncia que renunciará a Conceptos al terminar la inauguración de la feria gastronómica y pide que contraten a Jazmín.

programme.title: Los dos galanes
programme.desc: Alicia le expresa a Marcia su desacuerdo sobre ser su secretaria; Marcia le pide su renuncia y Alicia se retracta; Aldo le pide a Fernando hablar a solas para conocerse.
