programme.title: The Made to Measure Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. When Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate - and the village starts to reveal its secrets.

programme.title: The Sword of Guillaume
programme.desc: Barnaby joins a trip from Midsomer Parva to Brighton because he's suspicious about a deal to buy coastal land for holiday chalets by Causton's mayor. Also against the proposal is Lady Matilda William, a descendant of a French knight Sir Richard Guillaume, whose son Richard will be the last of the line because of brain damage sustained in an attack 20 years ago.

programme.title: Blood on the Saddle
programme.desc: Trouble seems to be brewing in the pretty village of Ford Florey when a tract of waste ground dubbed 'the Swamp' becomes the focus of a land dispute between two old agricultural families and a band of travellers. Things get nasty at the town's annual fair when a woman is shot for real during a shoot-out reconstruction at the Wild West show. Barnaby and Jones uncover a series of seething grudges within the village.

programme.title: The Silent Land
programme.desc: After Joyce Barnaby swerves off the road into a ditch, believing she has hit someone, the body of a librarian is found in a nearby cemetery. Amid stories of ghosts and haunted buildings, can DCI Tom Barnaby convince his wife that she is not to blame - and at the same time identify the real killer on the loose in March Magna?

programme.title: Master Class
programme.desc: During a masterclass for talented young musicians held by famous pianist Sir Michael Fielding, prodigy Zoe Stock is shocked to witness a woman drowning in the river, leaving a baby on the bank. When police arrive, however, there is no sign of the woman or her child. DCI Tom Barnaby is struck by the similarity of the reported drowning to a mysterious case from 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Noble Art
programme.desc: Betrayal, infidelity and blackmail fester as plans to re-enact a Victorian prizefight turn nasty - and even DCI Barnaby finds his judgement clouded by an old friend. Midsomer Morchard welcomes back local boxer John Kinsella from his world title fight victory in New York. Meanwhile, Kinsella's ruthless and controlling promoter Frank Bishop goes to see solicitor Giles Braithwaite, only to find the lawyer dead.

programme.title: Not in My Backyard
programme.desc: A planning dispute turns to murder after a leading light in the Midsomer Conservation Society suspects her neighbours are involved in a money-making development scam. Political wrangling, burglaries and sexual liaisons abound in picturesque Great Pelfe - but why is someone driven to start killing? Barnaby and Jones investigate.

programme.title: Fit for Murder
programme.desc: With his birthday approaching, Barnaby reluctantly accompanies Joyce on a spa weekend to Swavely Manor, but as he attempts to relax, a woman is found dead in the flotation chamber. Abandoning the treatment to investigate, Barnaby uncovers a feud between neighbours, money wrangles and the mystery of a half-written novel. After another gruesome discovery, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: Habeas Corpus
programme.desc: When wealthy landowner Gregory Lancaster's body goes missing on the night of his death, a sinister web of secrets and lies is exposed in the village of Little Malton as Barnaby, Nelson and Kam Karimore are drawn into a world of body-snatching.

programme.title: The Incident at Cooper Hill
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen in the sky over famous UFO hot-spot Cooper Hill. When a local forest ranger suffers a strange death, the visiting UFO spotters are convinced aliens are responsible. DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson unearth suspicions, betrayals and long-buried secrets in their search for the truth.

programme.title: Breaking the Chain
programme.desc: An international cycling competition comes to the Midsomer village of Burwood Mantle. When the race leader is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson find themselves drawn into a ruthlessly competitive world of blackmail, bribery and bloodshed where winning comes at any cost.

programme.title: A Dying Art
programme.desc: Art comes to the picturesque Midsomer village of Angel's Rise with the opening of a new sculpture park. When its launch is marred by murder, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to get creative if they are to crack a case where art imitates death, and everything has a deeper meaning.

programme.title: Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village of Midsomer Cicely. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson soon realise that it is not only skeletons that have been long buried in the hallowed ground.

programme.title: Harvest of Souls
programme.desc: The annual harvest fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death arrive in Whitcombe Mallet; the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse.

programme.title: Things That Go Bump in the Night
programme.desc: Barnaby and Scott travel to a picturesque village to investigate the murder of an undertaker. There, they discover that the village is divided by the presence of a spiritualist church run by a medium.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Regatta is brought to a standstill when a body is found in the river. It turns out to be that of a noted ladies' man who had been previously seen arguing with friends. As Barnaby and Scott dig into the luxury lifestyles of the rowing set, they discover that money problems and sexual jealousy are rife.

programme.title: Orchis Fatalis
programme.desc: When one of the world's rarest orchids is smuggled illegally into Midsomer Malham, it triggers a catalogue of passion, jealousy and death. Barnaby and Troy must find both the flower and the person prepared to commit murder in order to get their hands on it.

programme.title: Bantling Boy
programme.desc: Barnaby and Scott enter the world of horse racing when the trainer of thoroughbred Bantling Boy is battered to death. Bruce Hartley was an alcoholic who had vowed to expose the reason why his father bequeathed the horse to four Midsomer villagers. The other members of the syndicate come under suspicion, but the killing continues - then Bantling Boy falls ill.

programme.desc: Blair Herter tours the motor homes of racer Kevin Harvick, Barenaked Ladies and Heart. programme.title: Labours of Love
programme.desc: The success of a garden is often down to one person with a singular vision, and a will to see it through to completion.

programme.title: Hold Your Horses
programme.desc: After two successful renovations, Rachel and Jeff compete to name the next project. Business calls and Rachel is off to Dallas, leaving Jeff in charge of the renovation process.

programme.title: Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen is internationally renowned for its food, culture and quality of life, and keen to explore its spectacular city centre, Rory opts for a canal tour.

programme.title: Nantes
programme.desc: Nantes is a city famous for its fantastic food, culture and gardens, and so it's the perfect destination for Rory.

programme.title: Nicaragua: Untouched
programme.desc: Delicia Silva shows you why Aqua Wellness Resort and Spa in Nicaragua is a prime location to kick back, relax, and let life go up in smoke.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Ultimate Estates
programme.desc: Matthew heads to Beverly Hills, the pinnacle of A-List living, where the home tours include jetliner views from a zero-edge pool, a primary suite fit for royalty, and two incredible home theaters.

programme.title: Hidden Hills Equestrian Enclave
programme.desc: Matthew explores listings in the guard-gated equestrian community of Hidden Hills, just a gallop from Hollywood and overflowing with stars who have taken the reins on some pricey stables to call home.

programme.title: Epic Songs of '92
programme.desc: We're ranking epic songs that peaked in 1992. These songs shaped a generation, created relationships and defined musical styles. Find out which EPIC SONGS OF 92 make our list as rock experts like Mark McGrath, Wes Scantlin, Lita Ford and more count us down!

programme.title: Days of the Week Songs

programme.title: The Tri-Border Region

programme.title: Sololá and Santa Catarina Palopó (Part 1)
programme.desc: Traveling into Guatemala's western highlands, Jeff encounters rural families striving to create economic stability through entrepreneurship and traditional crafts.

programme.title: The World's Coolest Ruins
programme.desc: We're on the road to ruins - ancient ruins that is. Breathtaking, mysterious, and in every way awesome. From the Great Pyramid of Giza to the Great Wall of China, and from grand temples to dramatic dwellings.

programme.title: Coolest Animal Lover Vacation
programme.desc: If you love animals, and love taking vacations, saddle up because this one's for you. Tame the wild on a safari, get up close at iconic zoos, snap photos of endangered species, and dive deep into the ocean's underwater kingdom.

programme.title: Hanoi to Bangkok - Bon
programme.desc: Pamela and friends soak in a bit more of Hanoi prior to Pamela embarking to Bangkok, Thailand where an exquisite suite at the Avani+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel awaits her. What is there to experience in Bangkok? Pamela will show you the way.

programme.title: Governance
programme.desc: World Happiness Report studies are clear: the more women elected to a country's parliament, the higher the percentage of citizens who report being "happy."

programme.title: Skye And The Tybeans Of Tybee Island

programme.title: The A-Z Of Alpharetta
programme.desc: Learn what it takes to make the best shrimp & grits, red velvet cake, and deviled eggs in Alpharetta. Skye takes a creative spin on a favourite blueberry recipe with some help from a local.

programme.title: Dominican Republic: Caribbean Fire
programme.desc: This is your exclusive pass to three of the Dominican Republic's top cigar companies. Inside each factory, witness the meticulous work involved in making what are often considered to be among the best cigars on Earth.

programme.title: Nicaragua: Untouched
programme.desc: Delicia Silva shows you why Aqua Wellness Resort and Spa in Nicaragua is a prime location to kick back, relax, and let life go up in smoke.

programme.title: Nashville Brick Cottage: Southern Hospitality
programme.desc: Renovation of the 1920s brick cottage wraps up; touring the interior and new front yard; the next project location is revealed.

programme.title: London
programme.desc: Dermot hops across the Irish Sea to have the proverbial nosey around some amazing houses. Dermot has been to London many times. As a student in Hull studying architecture, he would make his way down to the capital and wander around the streets, taking in the architectural landscape. Now, he gets to go inside!

programme.title: Taipei
programme.desc: Taipei, the capital of Taiwan, is a young city undergoing rapid change and development within a fragile governmental framework; while the island boasts one of the highest economic growth rates in Asia, it maintains a tenuous relationship with China.

programme.title: Pikogan, Quebec

programme.title: Tiny Newlywed Nest

programme.title: Cold Front
programme.desc: Freeze out invading squirrels and cold drafts that a home inspector never found.

programme.desc: While Richard fights back against the FBI, ATF Agent Embry investigates a bomber terrorizing the Southeast.

programme.title: Run Rudolph Run
programme.desc: The FBI identifies serial bomber Eric Rudolph and gives chase, but Eric escapes into the wilderness.

programme.title: Land of the Noonday Sun
programme.desc: The FBI search for Eric spins out of control as anti-government locals and Eric's family push back.

programme.title: Army of God
programme.desc: Viewing him as a freedom fighter under siege, local militias rally around Eric and attack the FBI.

programme.title: Eric
programme.desc: Eric manipulates locals, militia, and FBI alike as he plans a major counterattack.

programme.title: Join or Die
programme.desc: FBI agent Brennan realizes he needs to change course radically to catch Eric, and allies with Embry to do so.

programme.title: Don't Tread on Me
programme.desc: Risking everything, Brennan and Embry appeal to a powerful local militia leader with the truth about Eric.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Eric, bereft of allies, is finally captured. But, he has a dangerous secret in store for law enforcement.

programme.title: Unabom
programme.desc: FBI profiler Jim "Fitz" Fitzgerald joins the Unabom Task Force. Fitz is tasked with confronting the Unabomber.

programme.title: Pure Wudder
programme.desc: When the elusive Unabomber threatens to blow up a jetliner, Fitz must determine if the threat is real.

programme.title: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
programme.desc: Linguist Natalie Rogers helps Fitz find clues about the Unabomber's identity in the Manifesto.

programme.title: Publish or Perish
programme.desc: The Unabomber will stop if his Manifesto is published. Fitz pushes for publication with S.A.C. Ackerman.

programme.title: Abri
programme.desc: Fitz receives linguistic proof that Ted is the Unabomber. He tracks down Ted's brother, David.

programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: Ted recounts the key events from his past that informed his decision to engage in terrorist activities.

programme.title: Lincoln
programme.desc: Fitz races to find a linguistic connection that will secure a warrant while the FBI closes in on Ted's cabin.

programme.title: Girl on a Train
programme.desc: Parents in Menton turn to the team to rescue their daughter who they fear has been sold into human trafficking

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: The team gets tangled in a possible insurance scam when hired by Nathalie to find valuable paintings.

programme.title: Leap of Faith
programme.desc: A gifted psychic (or a gifted conman) helps find the missing witness in an organized-crime case.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of an escort, the officers discover a pattern of missing women.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: The officers of 15 Division are forced to release a suspected predator for lack of evidence.

programme.title: Don't Poke the Bear
programme.desc: Alex and Charlie work on a couple who have been mauled by a bear.

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: When an organ delivery is delayed by a traffic jam, Alex races against the clock to find a replacement.

programme.title: Twinned Lambs
programme.desc: Alex treats an elderly patient whose unusual symptoms have her convinced she's living in a different era.

programme.title: Broken Hearts
programme.desc: Alex is diagnosed with an irregular heartbeat but must care for the Great Randall.

programme.title: Heaven Can Wait
programme.desc: Alex was stabbed in the chest and Charlie sees her as ghost. Alex realizes she saw her father hang himself.

programme.title: Sins of the Fathers
programme.desc: Forced to work at her estranged father's law firm, Abigail projects her family issues onto a client.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Abigail and Daniel represent a couple with Down syndrome who must prove they are fit to raise their child.

programme.title: Addicted to Love
programme.desc: Abigail and Daniel defend a mother who may lose custody of her kids due to a gaming addiction.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: When a pro hockey prospect goes down, Shade and Angie join forces to solve the mystery and save a life.

programme.title: Mise en Place
programme.desc: Shade and Angie investigate high-profile murder in a popular Toronto restaurant.

programme.title: The Money Shot
programme.desc: Shade and Angie search for a prized racehorse. Shade considers cheating on his P.I. exam.

programme.title: The Devil's Playground
programme.desc: Shade and Angie search for an arsonist in the Toronto Islands. Shade's ego grows with his new P.I. license.

programme.title: The Myrtle's Plantation
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Grafton & Cranston Case
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Deville's House & Brennan's Rest
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Mordecai House & USS North Carolina
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Bradley Playhouse & Harris Fire Station
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.

programme.title: Tanguay House & Sutcliffe House
programme.desc: Steve gets promoted to Tech Manager. TAPS takes on a case that has a personal connection for Kristyn, one of their members. A little boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells whenever she's in the basement. The team discovers high EMF readings and concludes this could be the cause of the dizzy spells since there carbon monoxide leaks weren't detected.

programme.title: Astor's Mansion & Roselle Park
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: TAPS Trainee & Asylum
programme.desc: TAPS welcomes an investigator in training, Dave Tango, from the NJ group. The team goes to a home in New Hampshire where the teenage boys are so afraid of the paranormal activity that they want to move. Grant gets attacked by a drum. TAPS heads the upstate NY to investigate a former insane asylum. They gather no evidence but run into some dive-bombing bats.

programme.title: Eastern State Revisited & Vacation Home
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Philadelphia's Eastern State Penitentiary to track down an apparition; the team investigates a haunted vacation home.

programme.title: Winchester House & Queen Mary
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Shawshank Prison & Lizzie Borden House
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghostly Soldier & Medium House
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Arkansas to investigate a haunted hotel. Dustin discovers that Grant's computer bag has mysteriously moved on its own. Jason and Grant capture an apparition, "the holy grail", on their thermal camera. The team is welcomed into a medium's home, the most haunted house in the town. Dustin and Dave check out the spooky hollow down the road but don't find anything paranormal. Grant captures some unusual activity on the thermal cam while recording the medium reading Jason.

programme.title: Haunted Sanatorium
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Child
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Home of 3 Ghosts
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Jason's hometown of Canandaigua, in upstate New York, to investigate two reported hauntings. A sinister force seems to be at work in the Leonard household. The homeowners have encountered various unsettling noises and events, including witnessing a full bodied apparition in their infant son's bedroom. Concern turned to panic when the homeowners discovered scratches on the back of their infant son's neck. TAPS arrives to uncover what is plaguing the home.

programme.title: Grey Lady Haunting
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Shadowy Figure
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Haunted Lighthouse
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Old Jail
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Toxic House
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Shining Hotel
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Tombstone, AZ
programme.desc: The season begins with the TAPS members traveling to Tombstone, Arizona to investigate the wild spirits of the old west. The group heads to the historic Birdcage Theatre, which in addition to housing performances, also served as a dancehall, saloon and casino after it opened in 1881.

programme.title: O.K. Corrall
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Shadow People
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Whispers & Voices
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Best of the Stanley Hotel
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Attack of the Irish Elemental
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Irish Ruins
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Hell Fire Caves
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Nightmare Noises
programme.desc: A local homeowner in need of emergency assistance visits the TAPS office after a series of bizarre incidents threaten the tranquility of her home. Lynn Tedeschi has the sense that something mysterious, and possibly dangerous, is present in her home. Her children are terrified by toys which inexplicably turn on and off. Strange sounds move through the home as if echoing from the distant past. TAPS spends the night to determine if a haunted house is lurking in their own backyard.

programme.title: Toys of Terror
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: U.S.S. Lexington
programme.desc: A battle scarred warship sets the stage for one of TAPS' largest investigations to date. Docked in Corpus Christi, Texas, the U.S.S. Lexington served in many missions during World War II. Over 300 people lost their lives while serving on the ship, and many witnesses claim these lost souls remain onboard. Countless visitors to the Lexington have seen apparitions dressed in military uniform.

programme.title: Mansion Murders
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Lost Souls
programme.desc: This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum, the Northern State Hospital. Jason and Grant meet the skeptical caretaker, who wishes to dispel the stories of ghostly activity, but when the team is confronted with strange sounds and shocking evidence, they are left to determine whether or not there might be a little truth to the local tales. Then TAPS heads to Seattle's Underground Tunnels, a subterranean labyrinth below the city streets.

programme.title: Spirits of San Francisco
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghostly Houseguest
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Houses of the Holy
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Salem
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Sanaturium Live Results
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Revelations
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Fort Miffin
programme.desc: In the first episode of a brand new season of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the historic battle field of Ft. Mifflin to uncover the truth behind some ghostly claims. Ft. Mifflin was once the site of bloody battles in both Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Today, visitors and employees tell chilling tales of their brushes with the afterlife. Some claim to have seen apparitions of soldiers, while others report hearing a woman's terrified scream coming from an empty room.

programme.title: Two to Tango
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Words From Beyond
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: The Fear Cage
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.title: Ghostly Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghostly Conversation
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Spirits of the Old West
programme.desc: On this episode, TAPS saddles up and heads west to investigate the legendary Goldfield Hotel in Goldfield, Nevada. This hotel from a bygone era is host to several stories of murder and tragedy. The horrific story of Elizabeth, a woman who was chained to radiator and left for dead, has left many to believe her troubled spirit still haunts the halls. While investigating the second floor, Jason and Grant pursue a solid black mass darting through doorways.

programme.title: Haunted Asylum
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the abandoned Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum. Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

programme.title: House of Spirits
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Widow's Watch
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Garden State Ghost
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Fort Delaware
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Iron Island
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Simsbury, CT to the old Pettibone Tavern to solve the legendary story of the ghost of Abigail. The tavern has been a stop off for George Washington, Harriett Beacher Stowe, John Adams. It was used as a stop off for slaves during the underground railroad. Pettibone's daughter Abigail, was married to a sailor.

programme.title: The Boy in the Brothel
programme.desc: TAPS heads to North Kingstown, Rhode Island to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a local restaurant. Linda, the skeptical owner of the Hoofinfeathers Carriage Inn, is hoping to uncover the truth behind the bizarre stories plaguing her establishment. The reports of disembodied voices and phantom-like apparitions have frightened some of her guests and terrorized her staff.

programme.title: Speaking with the Dead
programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

programme.title: Ghost of the Sunshine State
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

programme.title: Oak Alley Plantation
programme.desc: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

programme.title: Bottled Spirits
programme.desc: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

programme.title: Home Town Haunts
programme.desc: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

programme.title: U.S.S. Hornet
programme.desc: TAPS heads to The Bay area to investigate an aircraft carrier rumored to be the most haunted ship in the Navy, the USS Hornet. A person supposedly committed suicide in the room and a 75-pound wrench was moved by something not human. It is said; on the main hangar there is a helicopter that served in Vietnam. It is rumored that the pilot still walks out of it and then disappears. There are all types of paranormal activity throughout this ship.

programme.title: Live Halloween Results: Haunted Farmhouse
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse. The owner, Linda is afraid to sleep in her old home that she has raised 3 children in. In the attic, a hand touched Linda, and she fell down the stairs. Doors shut and lock by themselves trapping people. They yell for help, but know one hears them. During the investigation, Jason and Grant have hanger thrown at them twice.

programme.title: All Access
programme.desc: Fresh off the success of the 2008 live Halloween investigation of Fort Delaware, Josh Gates hosts the second roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS. Sitting in the Soldiers' Barracks of Fort Delaware, Josh revisits old shows and asks questions about the technology, techniques, and future of TAPS. Among many other things, we hear about Steve's penchant for touching anything he sees, Tango's inability to turn down a dare, and the correct way to operate a K2 meter.

programme.title: Recycled Souls
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Clovis, California to investigate a run down Sanitarium. Joining the team will be a fellow TAPS member from Northern California, Amy Bruni who has investigated here before. Reports of shadows appear to come right at you only to disappear. During renovations, 911 calls would mysteriously manifest from the home only to not have any phones to speak of in the whole building.

programme.title: Spirits on the Water
programme.desc: TAPS goes to the Maritime Museum of San Diego to investigate the oldest active ship in the world, the Star of India, and her slipmate, the steam ferryboat Berkeley. The Star of India was built back in 1863 on the Isle of Man, originally christened as the Euterpe. On her first voyage, to India, the iron windjammer suffered a collision and her crew mutinied. The second trip didn't go even that well - she was trapped in a cyclone and her first captain died at sea.

programme.title: Por la muestra se conoce el paño
programme.desc: Camila y Alexa son primas y su abuela tiene preferencia por una de ellas. Esto es culpa de sus madres, pues la madre de Camila le ha enseñado a ser presumida y grosera con su prima.

programme.title: Cuando sabes lo que siembras no le tienes miedo a la cosecha
programme.desc: Los padres de dos jóvenes sufren una accidente donde fallece su madre y su padre queda inválido. Uno de los jóvenes acepta la propuesta de su tío para robar y obtener dinero fácil, mientras que el otro comienza a trabajar en un taller.

programme.title: Para qué te metes de payaso si no aguantas las carcajadas
programme.desc: Chicharito tiene 15 años y lleva una doble vida, por la mañana va a la secundaria y por la tarde trabaja de payaso. Mena, niña de 15 años, casi es atropellada por mirar el celular. Chicharito se da cuenta y en una hábil maniobra la salva.

programme.title: El hábito no hace al monje, pero lo distingue
programme.desc: Una joven tiene que vivir con su padre y su madrastra tras la muerte de su madre, su actitud frente a la vida es de sufrimiento y opta por no estudiar, ni trabajar, pero al conocer un joven que perdió las ganas de vivir, logrará ver la realidad.

programme.title: Donde fuego se hace, humo sale
programme.desc: Por culpa de la vida sexual de su padre, la madre, el novio y una compañera de la escuela de Margarita terminan contagiados de SIDA.

programme.title: Al peligro con tiento y al remedio con tiempo
programme.desc: Lucía es una adolescente que vive con su mamá, pero ella es tan estricta que prefiere vivir con su papá. Sin embargo, no imagina que él aún está en el tiempo de la fiesta y las mujeres.

programme.title: A fácil perdón, frecuente ladrón
programme.desc: Una mujer sufre un asalto y su pareja le aconseja que vaya a poner una denuncia, pero ella teme hacerlo. La policía logra atrapar al ladrón que asaltó a la mujer, pero por falta de pruebas queda libre.

programme.title: Quien no cree a buena madre, cree a mala madrastra
programme.desc: Sonia es una mujer enamorada de Samuel; él decide tener una relación con Vania, una mujer vividora que solo lo quiere por su dinero y pretende robarle todo.

programme.title: Como pecas, pagas
programme.desc: Una mujer se encuentra en condiciones de extrema pobreza y decide abandonar a su hija en casa de su madre. Debido a su enfermedad, la abuela recurre a la tía de la niña para que la ayude a cuidarla, pero las cosas no salen como ellas esperan.

programme.title: El que mucho abarca, poco aprieta
programme.desc: Una joven ama jugar fútbol y es una excelente jugadora, pero es continuamente molestada por una de sus compañeras haciéndole creer que está gorda. La presión que sufre la joven debido a sus inseguridades hace que tome pastillas para bajar de peso.

programme.title: La vaca se olvida que fue ternero
programme.desc: Una joven se niega a dejar a su novio para mudarse de la ciudad con su familia, por lo que busca a su padre biológico para quedarse a vivir con él. La vida de la joven y de su padre cambiará y ambos aprenderán a conocerse.

programme.title: El que a buen árbol se arrima, buena sombra le cobija
programme.desc: Anselmo ha tenido que dejar sus estudios por problemas económicos, pero al ganar una beca gubernamental podrá continuar con ellos.

programme.title: Le salió el tiro por la culata
programme.desc: Dos niños son aficionados de las películas de suspenso y tienen un blog para evidenciar a los vecinos que hacen cosas incorrectas. Los niños son testigos de un delito por el cual uno de sus padres es injustamente llevado a la cárcel.

programme.title: En la guerra y en el amor todo se vale
programme.desc: Celos, envidia, venganza y amor se entrelazan después de que dos grupos de chicas se enfrenten en la secundaria.

programme.title: Al villano no hay que darle vara en mano
programme.desc: En la ciudad hay una ola de desapariciones de niños. Con la ayuda de una pequeña pista, una madre, comienza a sospechar que una familia, que se dedica a recolectar objetos usados, son los responsables de las desapariciones.

programme.title: Una caída más es una caída menos
programme.desc: Xitlali vive con su papá. En la escuela, algunos de sus compañeros le quieren enseñar a tomar y fumar, pero una maestra se da cuenta y la manda a que asista a clases de box. Sin embargo, a su padre no le parece bien que aprenda ese deporte.

programme.title: La vida es dura pero madura
programme.desc: Felipe es utilizado y explotado por su madre y Azul, una bailarina que conoce en un club de strippers, con quien se obsesiona.

programme.title: Los dichos de los viejitos, son evangelios chiquitos
programme.desc: Desde que murió su madre, Lili fue criada por su abuela, y por no escuchar sus consejos, se aprovecharán de su inocencia.

programme.title: La zorra nunca se ve su cola
programme.desc: Brandon y Kevin no pierden oportunidad de aprovecharse y burlarse de Brayan o de hacerlo quedar en ridículo. Además, Brandon quiere todo con Britany y la fiesta es el momento ideal para quitársela a Brayan.

programme.title: El que se casa, para su casa
programme.desc: La madre de Mariana se niega a perderla e inventa una mentira para que ella y su esposo se queden a vivir con ella.

programme.title: Para todos sale el sol, por más tarde que amanezca
programme.desc: Manuela debe lidiar con su primera menstruación sin ayuda de una madre que la oriente.

programme.title: Jaulas y cárceles ni para los ángeles
programme.desc: Una joven cumple su condena dentro de una prisión para mujeres, junto a su hijo de seis años. Debido a los lineamientos de la institución, la joven se ve obligada a pedirle a su comadre, que se haga cargo de su hijo.

programme.title: Ama a quien no te ama, responde a quien no te llama, y andarás carrera vana
programme.desc: Isa es una adolescente que está dispuesta a todo por amor, incluso a someterse al abuso y a la humillación. Ella se enamora de Gabriel, un chico irresponsable y grosero que la utiliza solo para que le haga sus trabajos de escuela.

programme.title: Aunque sean del mismo barro, no es lo mismo bacín que jarro
programme.desc: Arturo, un joven prometedor, se verá envuelto en el tráfico de drogas gracias a su hermano Norberto, quien además robó los ahorros de la familia.

programme.title: Liguria
programme.desc: Tucci visits the Italian Riviera famous for the glamor of Portofino and fishing villages of the Cinque Terre; he tries Genoese pesto and discovers how Ligurians have learned to adapt to life in the difficult landscape.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: Anthony explores Shanghai by sampling classic cuisine at restaurants Chun and Fuchun Xiaolong, while locals voice their insight on their booming economy and expanding global influence.

programme.title: The Bronx
programme.desc: Superstars Afrika Bambaataa, Melle Mel, and Baron Ambrosia help guide Anthony through the music, food and art of the often misunderstood, most northern part of NYC.

programme.title: Paraguay
programme.desc: Anthony is thrust into Paraguay by investigating his great, great, great, grandfather, Paraguayan émigré Jean Bourdain, while sampling savory local dishes that include Bife Koygua, Bori Bori, and Sopa Paraguaya.

programme.title: Vietnam
programme.desc: Anthony travels to his first love, Hue in central Vietnam, as he visits the Dong Ba market, Vinh Moc tunnels, the Duyen Anh restaurant and the Citadel.

programme.title: Tanzania
programme.desc: Bourdain comes face to face with lions, elephants, and the great migration in Zanzibar, Tanzania, a one-time slave trade hub, and samples mandazi, grilled seafood and the famous Zanzibari pizza.

programme.title: Iran
programme.desc: Bourdain and his crew take their long-awaited first trip to Iran, sampling Dizi, Fesenjan, Biryani, and Tahdig; tour guides include Washington Post reporter Jason Rezaian and his wife Yeganeh Salehi, who were detainees of the Iranian government.

programme.title: Massachusetts
programme.desc: Bourdain takes a very personal trip to Provincetown; we visit The Atlantic House and The Lobster Pot where he started his culinary career, and he candidly discusses his descent into heroin addiction, recovery and other nuggets of his past.

programme.title: Jamaica
programme.desc: Bourdain travels along the Northeast region of Jamaica and explores life in Port Antonio and Winnifred Beach where he meets Bob Marley's producer Chris Blackwell, and visits the home of author Ian Fleming.

programme.title: Korea
programme.desc: Following a long absence, Anthony travels to South Korea; the country has undergone significant development since his last visit; he tries kimchi, fried chicken and vintage army stew.

programme.title: Miami
programme.desc: After sampling cow foot soup in Little Haiti, Anthony tastes the Miami nightlife with Questlove, Willie Clark and Iggy Pop.

programme.title: Scotland
programme.desc: Deep-fried haggis, a knife defense lesson and a trip to the Scottish Highlands are on the menu in Glasgow.

programme.title: Budapest
programme.desc: Anthony explores Budapest's cuisine; he tastes chicken liver, fisherman's soup, blood sausage and goulash; he visits a butcher shop; he drinks at Café New York.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Bourdain visits the capital city of Madagascar, Tana and joins film director Darren Aronofsky for some Malagasy cuisine.

programme.title: New Jersey
programme.desc: Anthony joins his brother Chris to enjoy some fried hot dogs in his old New Jersey stomping grounds, then heads to Atlantic City for some food and fun.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: Anthony joins travel writer Paul Theroux and Chef Andrew Le for a meal at an ancient oceanside fishpond on a hidden side of Hawaii.

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: Anthony travels to "The Paris of the Middle East" known as Beirut; a city well known for its incredible cuisine and infamous nightlife.

programme.title: Naples and the Amalfi Coast
programme.desc: Feasting on pizza in Naples; finding the freshest mozzarella and the best San Marzano tomatoes; enjoying spaghetti and zucchini.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Stanley heads to Rome in search of the famous four pastas, orders rigatoni all'amatriciana, samples carbonara and tries a selection of cheeses and sausages made from the sheep and pigs farmed in the region.

programme.title: Bologna
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci explores Bologna, seen by many as the food capital of Italy; the region of Emilia-Romagna is home to globally renowned protected food products.

programme.title: Milan
programme.desc: In Milan, Stanley enjoys an aperitivo and makes pizzoccheri; classic Milanese veal chops and risotto.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: Stanley explores his former home of Tuscany; he participates in a wine bar crawl, celebrates the importance of the lowly loaf and samples dishes which use stale bread as the key ingredient.

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: In Sicily, Stanley tastes the grapes grown in the region's unique soils and reflects on Sicilian hospitality.

programme.title: Punjab
programme.desc: Anthony dives into the ever-changing state of Punjab with a trip to Amritsar, sampling cuisine at a roadside restaurant, a Sikh celebration and a free community vegetarian restaurant.

programme.title: Las Vegas
programme.desc: Anthony pals up with food author Michael Ruhlman as they visit the Huntridge Tavern and Jose Andres' restaurant é; Penn Jillette and former mayor Oscar Goodman are pokin' around.

programme.title: Lyon
programme.desc: Anthony and Daniel Boulud travel to Lyon, France, to visit the city's rich food culture and legendary chefs.

programme.title: Mexico
programme.desc: Anthony travels to Mexico City, Oaxaca, and Cuernavaca to talk with local residents who express their passion through food and later to journalist Anabel Hernandez on the drug trade-related violence's impact.

programme.title: Mississippi
programme.desc: Anthony explores Mississippi including the home of the "Pig Ear Sandwich," downtown Jackson's Big Apple Inn, also known as a Civil Rights Era gathering place; then on to an old sharecropper structure turned juke joint, Po' Monkey's Social Club.

programme.title: Thailand
programme.desc: Anthony treks to the Chiang Mai province of Northern Thailand where he catches up with celebrated chef Andy Ricker of Pok Pok restaurants fame to explore the country's diverse and various seasonal eating and drinking scene.

programme.title: Brazil
programme.desc: Visiting Bahia, the African heart of Brazil; the dance/martial art of Capoeira; legendary food vendors; Salvadoran fishing neighborhoods.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Stanley explores the city's fascinating food culture due to its aquatic environment, as well as the countless influences from around the world throughout its vast and storied history.

programme.title: Piedmont
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Piedmont which boasts a refined French heritage.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci visits Umbria, nicknamed "The Green Heart of Italy"; with the highest consumption of pork per capita, Umbria is a carnivore's dream; from wild boar hunts to black truffle farms, Stanley explores all Umbria has to offer.

programme.title: London
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci explores how Italian immigration transformed the food scene in his adopted hometown of London; London is a culinary mecca where Italian food from every region gets a chance to shine.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Tucci discovers the history of beautiful and troubled Calabria, Italy, as well as the history of his own family; joined by his parents and Italian relatives, he reflects on the inspiration people draw from Calabria and why those who leave return.

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Tucci visits the island of Sardinia, Italy, famous for its harsh, rugged landscape, crystal blue ocean, and passionately preserved traditions; Tucci learns how Sardinian food culture varies wildly throughout the island.

programme.title: Sardinia
programme.desc: Tucci visits Puglia, a region famous for its fragrant olive oil, beautiful vegetables, cheeses, and durum wheat; he discovers how the Pugliese own their past and embrace the future on their own terms.

programme.desc: Anthony explores Budapest's cuisine; he tastes chicken liver, fisherman's soup, blood sausage and goulash; he visits a butcher shop; he drinks at Café New York.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Bourdain visits the capital city of Madagascar, Tana and joins film director Darren Aronofsky for some Malagasy cuisine.

programme.title: New Jersey
programme.desc: Anthony joins his brother Chris to enjoy some fried hot dogs in his old New Jersey stomping grounds, then heads to Atlantic City for some food and fun.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: Anthony joins travel writer Paul Theroux and Chef Andrew Le for a meal at an ancient oceanside fishpond on a hidden side of Hawaii.

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: Anthony travels to "The Paris of the Middle East" known as Beirut; a city well known for its incredible cuisine and infamous nightlife.

programme.title: Naples and the Amalfi Coast
programme.desc: Feasting on pizza in Naples; finding the freshest mozzarella and the best San Marzano tomatoes; enjoying spaghetti and zucchini.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Stanley heads to Rome in search of the famous four pastas, orders rigatoni all'amatriciana, samples carbonara and tries a selection of cheeses and sausages made from the sheep and pigs farmed in the region.

programme.title: Bologna
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci explores Bologna, seen by many as the food capital of Italy; the region of Emilia-Romagna is home to globally renowned protected food products.

programme.title: Milan
programme.desc: In Milan, Stanley enjoys an aperitivo and makes pizzoccheri; classic Milanese veal chops and risotto.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: Stanley explores his former home of Tuscany; he participates in a wine bar crawl, celebrates the importance of the lowly loaf and samples dishes which use stale bread as the key ingredient.

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: In Sicily, Stanley tastes the grapes grown in the region's unique soils and reflects on Sicilian hospitality.

programme.title: Punjab
programme.desc: Anthony dives into the ever-changing state of Punjab with a trip to Amritsar, sampling cuisine at a roadside restaurant, a Sikh celebration and a free community vegetarian restaurant.

programme.title: Las Vegas
programme.desc: Anthony pals up with food author Michael Ruhlman as they visit the Huntridge Tavern and Jose Andres' restaurant é; Penn Jillette and former mayor Oscar Goodman are pokin' around.

programme.title: Lyon
programme.desc: Anthony and Daniel Boulud travel to Lyon, France, to visit the city's rich food culture and legendary chefs.

programme.title: Mexico

programme.desc: After success in North Africa the Allies returned to occupied Europe, first landing on Sicily before moving north into Italy under command of Montgomery, known fondly by his men as Monty. But as the Italians surrendered, the Germans occupied Rome.

In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

Helena's maternal grandfather Eduardo Propper de Callejón, a Spanish diplomat who defied his government's orders, helped Jewish people escape the Holocaust. Helena's paternal grandmother Lady Violet Bonham Carter volunteered as an air raid warden and campaigned for women's rights.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The ultimate test of tank technology is the battlefield. American tanks form the sharp end of the sword in Desert Storm. The U.S. marine corp was still using the older M-60 tank, although with some modifications.

This episode explores the swift and brutal tactics of Blitzkrieg, the political miscalculations of European leaders, and the failure of appeasement. Through rare footage and expert analysis, we witness how the seeds of global conflict were sown.

programme.title: The Graves
programme.desc: The armies of the Third Reich invaded the USSR on June 22, 1941. Mobile commandos, the Einsatzgruppen, were following their advance to Stalingrad with the mission of eliminating all Jews on the conquered territories.

programme.desc: This film was made by the U.S. Army and directed by George Stevens. As the Allies reached Germany, General Eisenhower ordered George Stevens to film the concentration camps. The camps are filmed and survivors interviewed. This film was evidence at the Nuremberg Trials.

programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: El onomástico de Toña
programme.desc: El cumpleaños de Toña parece una típica celebración hasta que, al calor de las copas, las cosas se salen de control y llega la policía.

programme.title: Cuando los hermanos se encuentran
programme.desc: Fran regresa de Nueva York y su peor pesadilla se hace realidad: se entera de que tiene un hermano.

programme.title: Lucha Interna
programme.desc: Le dan trato preferencial a Lucha y hasta un famoso narcotraficante se pone a sus órdenes porque cree que mató a un delincuente. Albertano se corta un mechón por el cual le dan mucho dinero. Lucha se enoja muchísimo al enterarse.

programme.title: Una patita de conejo fresca
programme.desc: Albertano le manda a María la llave de su cuarto para que saque sus cosas, pero ella entiende que le pide que se mude con él, con su llave tiene una pata de conejo de la buena suerte, pero al ensuciarse, María la tira y le compra una pata nueva.

programme.title: Sed de triunfo
programme.desc: Doña Lucha aprovecha el corte de agua en la colonia para vender unas cubetas que tenía apartadas. María se pone celosa de la nueva ayudante del equipo de fútbol, Citlali, mientras que Albertano se la pasa en la banca por ser mal jugador.

programme.title: Patadas de ahogada
programme.desc: Es el cumpleaños de Albertano y doña Lucha le organiza una fiesta, María se pinta el cabello y se pone su más lindo vestido para recuperar a Albertano, le dedica canciones compuestas por ella y le recita un poema. Doña Lucha se siente mal.

programme.title: Angeloterapeuta
programme.desc: Albertano le pide tiempo a María para pensar en el futuro de su relación y ella va con un brujo para pedirle ayuda. Doña Lucha intenta hablar con el chino sobre sexualidad, por lo que van a la fonda de Don Carmelo, donde ella termina ebria.

programme.title: Sexy calendario
programme.desc: A Doña Lucha se le ocurre hacer un calendario sexy con todas sus vecinas, pero no se vende como ella esperaba. María se pone colágeno en los labios para conquistar a Albertano.

programme.title: Ludoviquito es famoso
programme.desc: Un famoso productor de comerciales quiere contratar a Ludoviquito, Federica y Ludovico se pelean por ser el representante de su hijo para quedarse con el dinero que gane.

programme.title: Déjenme dormir
programme.desc: Don Camerino le da un ascenso a Ludovico y necesita estar bien descansado para cumplir sus nuevas obligaciones. Ludovico le pide a Federica que lo deje dormir. Al día siguiente, Ludovico se duerme en la oficina y no puede cumplir bien con su trabajo.

programme.title: Exsimio, exnovio de Excelsa
programme.desc: Eximio, el exnovio de Excelsa regresa a buscarla y quiere llevársela con él, pero Federica no quiere que se vaya y prefiere pedirle a Eximio que se quede a vivir en su casa.

programme.title: Flavio es Infiel
programme.desc: Martina le dice a Federica que Flavio la engañó, ella trata de animar a su amiga y le da consejos de cómo tratar a su marido. Ludovico felicita a Flavio y le aconseja cómo actuar con Martina.

programme.title: Vida de solteros
programme.desc: Federica y Ludovico reciben una notificación por correo donde les informan que su matrimonio no tiene validez. Los dos se emocionan mucho al saber que están solteros.

programme.title: Último día de vida de Federica
programme.desc: Ludovico recibe la noticia de que Federica tiene una enfermedad muy grave y que morirá en un día, él se dedica a consentirla.

programme.title: Visitas
programme.desc: Federica y Ludovico conocen a los jefes de la mesa directiva de sus hijos. Ludovico los invita a cenar haciendo de la noche un verdadero desastre.

programme.title: Big P.Luche
programme.desc: La Familia P. Luche entra a un famoso reality para ganar un millón de pesos. Ludovico gana el reality y el premio.

programme.title: Un mundo nos vigila
programme.desc: Los Héroes tienen que regresar por carretera a México. En el camino les roban la camioneta y los dejan tirados en el desierto donde son secuestrados por extraterrestres.

programme.title: La novia fea
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano tienen que alquilar su departamento para obtener dinero, pero no es suficiente para continuar con su estilo de vida. Vítor trata de convencer a Albertano de que se haga novio de Bertha, una chica fea, pero multimillonaria.

programme.title: Buscando casa
programme.desc: El Vítor lleva a su mamá a la central camionera porque se va a regresar a su pueblo. Albertano y el Vítor se conocen cuando van a ver un cuarto en renta y se pelean por él, pero Rosita, una de las inquilinas, les aconseja compartir la habitación.

programme.title: Los cinco puntos
programme.desc: Plácido sigue las recomendaciones de las cinco cosas que un padre debe enseñarle a su vástago para que llegue hacer un gran hijo.

programme.title: ¡Este cuerpo no es mío!
programme.desc: La banda tiene un grave problema, todos han cambiado de cuerpo y personalidad. Prisca presenta síntomas de embarazo.

programme.title: Chóferes de microbus
programme.desc: El Vítor solicita trabajo en la base de microbuses y Albertano le pide que le consiga trabajo. El Vítor contrata a Albertano como su ayudante. Albertano renuncia porque el Vítor se aprovechó de él y no le pagó bien.

programme.title: De payasos
programme.desc: Doña Cuca ve un anuncio en el periódico y les dice a Albertano y el Vítor que deberían trabajar de payasos para la fiesta de cumpleaños. Doña Cuca compra los disfraces de payasos y les propone a Albertano y el Vítor asociarse con ella.

programme.title: Votación
programme.desc: Adolfo se niega a ayudar con la manutención del hogar de la familia López y se lleva a La Nena a vivir a una comuna. La familia al extrañar a La Nena propone un acuerdo.

programme.title: La nueva dueña
programme.desc: Los López se preocupan porque la nueva dueña del edificio correrá a las familias que excedan de cuatro integrantes. Plácido le explica el porqué son 10.

programme.title: Mala suerte
programme.desc: La dueña del edificio comunica a los López que subirá la renta, pero Plácido por andar apostando, no tiene dinero para pagar. Los López consiguen dinero como pueden.

programme.desc: In the wake of Emilio's deportation, Jackie steps into the role of a paternal figure and creates a meticulous birth plan for Becky; Darlene is tangled in a complex love triangle with David and Ben; Harris is caught up in a problem of her own.

programme.desc: Desperate for more income, Becky seeks a bartending position at Casita Bonita, causing major concern for Dan due to her struggle with alcoholism; Darlene finally nears a decision between David and Ben; Harris' new friend, Odessa, means new trouble.

programme.title: Tempest in a Stew Pot

programme.title: Slappy Holidays
programme.desc: Chaos ensues when Dan finally gets the entire family together for Thanksgiving dinner; mixed feelings about the Lunch Box continue to build tension in the house; Harris makes an unexpected move.

programme.title: Lanford, Toilet of Sin
programme.desc: Jackie is faced with a difficult decision that brings the family and community together; Becky starts working a new late-night shift at Casita Bonita; Darlene goes to extreme measures to mend her relationship with Harris.

programme.title: Smoking Penguins and Santa on Santa Action
programme.desc: Dan is disappointed when everyone but Becky forgets about his birthday; Darlene faces another issue; Dan excludes Jackie from the family Christmas Santa photo for mistreating Louise.

programme.title: Throwing a Christian to a Bear
programme.desc: The Conners struggle to accept Becky's new boyfriend, a Green Bay Packers fan; Dan tries to impress upon Mark the importance of the family's die-hard loyalty to the Bears; Ben and Darlene try to get a loan for their new magazine.

programme.title: Mud Turtles, a Good Steak and One Man in a Tub
programme.desc: Becky thinks that Jackie's new friend, a restaurant supplier, is taking advantage of them; Darlene is thrilled when Harris gets into Central Illinois State, but Harris might have found a better offer; Dan finds himself in an embarrassing situation.

programme.title: Live From Lanford
programme.desc: The Conners share their differing takes on why they all think everyone should vote; Louise gets an opportunity that might send her away from Lanford, prompting the family to interfere in Dan's complicated relationship.

programme.title: Brothers, Babies and Breakdowns
programme.desc: Dan avoids coping with a death in the family, only to be confronted by it head-on; Ben and Darlene address Ben's baby fever; Dwight gets the jitters when he has to fill in for the chef who suffers an accident.

programme.title: Bad Dads and Grads
programme.desc: Dan starts to bond with his younger half brother, but he can't get over the fact that their father paid for Ed Jr.'s college education, something he refused to do for Dan; Jackie hits it off with a fun married couple.

programme.title: Beards, Thrupples and Robots

programme.title: Tats and Tias
