programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton, Peter Wright and their staff deal with more animal emergencies. This episode includes a dog facing an emergency operation to remove a tumour and a prolapsing sheep that has to be treated on the car park.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: When a complaint comes in about two skinny dogs, Inspector Herchy Boal is straight on the case. Staffie crosses Rocky and Bentley are both extremely underweight and in need of help, but is it just a decent meal these two need or is something else wrong?

programme.title: Australian Babies
programme.desc: Today we are in the wilds of Australia exploring the outback, the bush and even its beaches. Among the babies we see kangaroo joeys, platypuses and koalas.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: The largest abscess Julian's ever seen is on a bull's backside - a waterfall of pus is coming! Peter meets Thor the giant rabbit as well as North Yorkshire's best dressed dog. And, just a few hours old, a lamb is rushed into surgery.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn calf. There's a 'cuteness overload' when Julian meets Finlay and his beloved hamster, Christopher Nibbles. Bella, the much-loved rescue sausage dog, needs life-saving surgery. Can Peter save her? Julian visits an old friend, Dobby the lama - but Dobby may not be so pleased to see him. Peter pops in on elderly colourful farmers the Greens.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian rushes over to see worried and confused farmer Joe Holmes. He found one of his cows with afterbirth hanging out, so he thought she'd already calved. But there's no sign of a new arrival, so he suspects she's struggling to give birth.

programme.title: At The Great Yorkshire Show
programme.desc: The 159th Great Yorkshire Show, is the hottest date in the Yorkshire's farming calendar and one of the UK's biggest agricultural shows. Peter and Julian are called by farmers across the land to get their livestock into peak condition.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Asia
programme.desc: We head on an adventure through Asia, prowl around with some cheeky Amur Leopard cubs, go underwater to catch a baby Spinner Dolphin practice it's loops, plus watch some rare Giant Panda cubs grow up right before your eyes, via a den cam.

programme.title: More Winter Babies
programme.desc: We spend time chilling out with babies in the cold of winter. Shorter days and snow mean that the babies need their winter coats.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hunky Tom Rigby meets his match in Keira the kelpie. And will this be it for serial dater Lily the pug when she meets human Lily and her family in the meeting pen?

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Two babies' lives hang in the balance. Peter rushes into Skeldale on his day off to try and save Richard Bell's lamb, who was badly injured when he was born just a few hours ago. And at Suzanne Benson's trekking centre, Julian's treating a very poorly one-week old llama called Noah.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian is called out to a calf with a large lump, while other patients include a pair of pygmy goats, a farm full of feral cats and Fern, a sick spaniel. The staff also find time to spring a birthday surprise on Peter Wright.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Southeast Asia
programme.desc: Get set to monkey around with a bunch of baby Orangutans, hanging out comes naturally. Asian Elephant calves are keen to have some good clean fun in the mud, while a rare Red Shanked Douc is ready to ride the branches and show off its tree surfing skills.

programme.title: Baby Animals From North America
programme.desc: North America is the destination in this episode. Tag along with baby raccoons as they explore the woods. Have a need for speed? Then zoom along some mountain rapids with a Moose calf. And if you like non-stop action, simply hang out with baby Bears.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter is struggling to find his feet in his new practice. But when a farmer rushes in with a heavily pregnant sheep who's struggling to give birth, instinct takes over as Peter deals with the emergency.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter treats two very poorly newborn calves. Julian tires to remove a huge tumour from a sheepdog and a sparky Shetland pony gives the vets the runaround.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton treats a cow with a rare and complex problem. The cow's stomach has become displaced and moved to the wrong side of her body, causing pain and stopping her eating. Meanwhile in Thirsk, a baby roe deer is brought into the practice as it has stopped taking milk, and a dog has a large tumour removed in a tricky operation.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Matt delivers a calf, Peter removes a lump from a dog's eye, and Julian repairs a slipped patella on a cat and nips a sheep with a birth defect. Peter and Shona go 4-wheeling.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Julian needs as many extra pairs of hands as he can muster as he has to perform a caesarean section on a pregnant Great Dane. Later, young vet Matt marries his fiancee Katherine in front of all of his veterinary friends.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter gets an emergency call from Ivor Shaw. He's found one of his calves limping, and Peter suspects her little leg is broken. Julian is overwhelmed when 18 rats are brought onto the practice. A blind sheep and a stray dog are treated.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: A pet pig is brought to the practice to see Julian. Peter heads to see goat brothers because all isn't rosy in their garden. A German short-haired pointer requires surgery. A pregnant cow requires an emergency C-section.

programme.title: Wetland Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the wetlands of the world with cygnets and baby crocodiles among the babies featured.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter heads to see a worried farmer whose newborn calf can't stand up. If it's a serious joint problem, as the farmer suspects, he might not make it. Julian welcomes Exotic Joe to the practice. Joe normally brings in all kinds of weird and wonderful creatures.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Africa
programme.desc: We are going on safari through Africa. Catch some Jackal pups in action as they show off their best wrestling moves, be impressed at the way Gorilla babies put their own goofy spin on things.Don't miss the Cheetah cubs zipping around playing Tag.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: In the first of this 2 part special, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor gets down and dirty as she rescues 4 dogs from a squalid house. Three of the poor dogs are shut into separate rooms and living in their own waste. One is so traumatized that it has a seizure.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: The second of this 2 part special follows Inspector Lyndsey Taylor who last episode rescued four dogs from squalid conditions.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter comes to the aid of a cow that has suffered a prolapsed uterus. He also meets elderly cat Sawsa, while Julian helps farmer Chris artificially inseminate his pigs. Plus, owner Betty is concerned when her beloved lhasa apso Billy develops a lump on his tummy and a persistent eye infection.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Are happy new couple Tim and Fiona the right fit for the 'cloud on legs' Frosty? She's a plucky Pomeranian but, at 11, isn't getting any younger. And will kelpie Schnitzel find love this time around?

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A 4-week-old lamb is rushed in to see Peter. After being unwell recently, it suffered a prolapse, and Peter thinks the solution might just lie in the practice's kitchen. Julian attends to a dog that's been kicked in the face by a horse.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter Wright must battle a blizzard to reach a patient on a remote farm. Cynthia the pigmy goat is cute and loveable but has a problem. In an out-of-hours emergency, poorly cat Emily is unsteady on her paws, while Digz the dog is lucky to be alive after a hit-and-run. Peter is also called out to assist graduate vet Katie with an emergency caesarean.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Will gentle giant Tessa the Bull Arab, a cruelty case rescue, find love with the Doyle family? And are newlyweds Craig and Rodney the right fit for bonded pair Zoe and Buster?

programme.title: More Farm Babies
programme.desc: We revisit the farms to catch the antics of the babies in the country. Miniature horses, baby goats, piglets and lambs are featured among other more exotic farm animals.

programme.title: Special On Call
programme.desc: In The Yorkshire Vet - On Call, Peter and Julian catch up with old friends and find out how they're getting on. Previously, Peter saved a bullock with pneumonia. He feared the worst but the next day the bullock was doing well and Peter was both amazed and thrilled. Now, he's back at the Greensit Brothers farm on call to yet another emergency.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Is one-eyed Maltese Harlie the right remedy for Karin, who is looking for a furry friend after an accident left her mostly immobile? Could German shepherd Seth's size be too much for gentle Sheppy?

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A farmer fears his sheep has been shot. But has it suffered an attack by a dog or a fox? Peter's worried about a tawny owl whose eye he removed 18 months ago. Flynn now has a serious problem with his remaining eye, which means his life is in danger.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian races over to the llama trekking centre in the Dales, after one of the youngsters breaks his jaw in a freak accident. A goat with a painful foot condition is brought in to Peter. A bulldog is rushed in after eating some chewing gum.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter heads to a local farm where Bernie the boar is strangely off his food. Peter's worried that the problem could be serious, but examining a big boar who's not feeling well isn't easy.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Wendy the wallaby is struggling but can Peter to save her? Julian performs urgent surgery to save Griff the terrier. Peter's battles to save a mum-to-be and her unborn twin lambs. Julian pregnancy tests a pedigree herd which reveals Lawrence the bull might have a problem. An eye-watering test should reveal the truth.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Inspector Helen Smith saves Turner and Hooch, two Dogue de Bordeauxs found abandoned in a garden. Inspector Becky Bedson tracks down a dog that was spotted stranded in a flood relief channel. It's a freezing day so she needs to act fast. Shih Tzu Olive was found on a building site, heavily matted and in pain. And meet Pepper, the Dalmatian stealing hearts across Merseyside.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton, is called out to a local petting farm to help a bad-tempered goat with a suspected broken leg - but the goat is not keen on getting treatment! When Peter takes an emergency call from an anxious trainer, it could be the end of the line for a horse that has cut open its foot while grazing in a field.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: For the first time, presenter Alan Davies will be based at one of the country's busiest animal hospitals. He will experience first-hand just what life is like treating sick and injured canines in the cold December months, as he joins the team at RSPCA Putney.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's Autumn, and the start of what will prove to be the most punishing year of training for the students have ever faced. With places on the course more in-demand than Oxbridge, only the very best of over four thousand applicants have made it past the selection process, but now the lucky twenty-five must show they've got what it takes to go all the way.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, Julian treats a much-loved moggie with a badly swollen eye where surgery might be the only option. Head Nurse Sarah is extremely worried about her own dog, Copper, who is off his food, losing weight and going downhill fast. When Julian gets an emergency call out to a ewe struggling to deliver twin lambs, it is a race against time to save the lives of both mother and her babies.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: At Jackie Barlow's farm, Mako the alpaca has a lump on his face that's the size of half a football! And Mako is louder than a football crowd, with Julian admitting he's one of his noisiest patients ever.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter battles to deliver lambs who are jumbled up and stuck inside their mum, and he is shocked by what he finds. Julian has to contend with an angry parrot that has escaped in the surgery. A rescue dog is attacked by another dog.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian dashes to an emergency - Vet Matt needs an experienced pair of hands. A young heifer, Bonnie, is struggling to give birth naturally. Peter sees old pal Benji the bouncy border terrier who has been vomiting and is in grave danger.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Europe
programme.desc: Venturing through Europe, meeting the youngsters that live and play there.There's Brown Bear cubs messing around, a litter of scrappy Red Fox kits doing their best impression of a whirlwind as they play fight, plus a bunch of hungry St Bernard pups.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter turns shoemaker to try and save a lame cow. An unusual case of llama colic poses a problem for Julian, who also has a fight on his hands with Rocky the cat. A pioneering new treatment is tried at Skeldale. And a plucky parrot needs a pedicure.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Peter faces an emergency midnight lambing, Julian has to operate to remove his dog's tooth, Poppy the cat requires complex surgery on her badly broken leg. Peter, Julian and the Huddersfield vets meet up for a ramble on the moors.

programme.title: Grassland Babies
programme.desc: Today's episode takes place in the grasslands of the world. We see Lynx kittens, a wild foal, and baby mongooses among other animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Can big goofball Wolfie the Wolfhound win over a pair of terrified tots? Meanwhile, the tables are turned when vivacious Chez meets timid Mini Foxie Olive. Finally, will lovable Lab Chai be Laurel and Darrell's perfect pooch?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter has an emergency at the practice in Kirkbymoorside, when a local farming couple rush in their pregnant Texel ewe. Julian operates on a terrier suffering with bladder stones. Peter visits the Green's farm to see a lonely donkey.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: This week, Peter gets a scare when he tries to help a horse with some worrying cancerous growths. Julian meets a five-month-old cockapoo with a badly broken leg. Matt operates on a cow's tail and Shona enters a showjumping competition.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: The trainee RSPCA Inspectors' extraordinary year of training is drawing to a close. The students are out on the beat, working real-life cases by themselves and desperate to show they're ready to become full-time Inspectors. They are on probation and only those who consistently meet the standards expected of them by bosses will be offered a job. It's a race against time.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian is called to see cattle farmer Richard's cow, a young mum, who has a badly infected foot. Her condition is so bad that Julian may have to take drastic action... Will he be able to get mum back on her feet and reunited with her baby?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Shih Tzu crosses Alfonso and Lorenzo are the last of the five dogs who came into the shelter after their owner died. Their mother and siblings have found love, so it's finally their turn when they meet Carol.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: A rare-breed pony is in danger when she suffers a prolapsed uterus after giving birth. Julian has a plan to fix a Great Dane's debilitating knee injury. Peter treats a pig that lives in the back garden of the owner of the local chip shop.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian dashes to the scene of a freak accident - something he's never seen before. A young mum's life hangs in the balance. Can Julian save mum and will she ever be reunited with her little lamb who's been left alone out in the field?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Pete and Hernando are smitten with Tibetan spaniel mix Baxter. But will their picky chihuahua Bruno approve? Can doctor Patrick offer chill senior citizen Buster the red cattle dog a retirement home?

programme.title: More Summer Babies
programme.desc: We are having fun in the sun with an energetic bunch of maritime babies and their families, tree topping with Koalas, and spend time with young chipmunks carving up a storm.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Julian faces a massive challenge trying to save one of the biggest calves he's ever had to deliver. And farmer Rob, who lost a newborn two days ago, is fearing the worst.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Will Winnie's appetite for destruction get in the way of finding a happy new home? Simba has a chance at love from Jenny. However, his instant bond with her twin brother, John, could be an issue.

programme.title: Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Baby rock wallabies, gorillas, little wrestlers. This is the time that animals build up their food stores for the coming winter. The time is fun for the babies while their parents are busy.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Julian races to an emergency at a local farm where a cow is unable to stand up. She's suffering from a condition called milk fever, caused by calcium deficiency. It's classic, Herriot style vet work and Julian has to be extremely careful with his treatment.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: When 18-month-old JD is found tied to a radiator and left without food or water, inspector Anthony Pulfer is desperate to get him to the vet. In Yorkshire, inspector Keira Benham comes to the aid of Ruby, a Jack Russell with a nasty skin condition. We meet Ted, the Spaniel rescued from a squalid bedsit eager to become a police sniffer dog. And see what the right care and attention can do for Rex.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian must treat a pregnant heifer with a pelvis that may be too small to give birth, while a cat that lost a leg after being run over by a car suffers another injury in a road accident, but this time, no treatment may be possible.

programme.title: Deep Cover
programme.desc: David Jason (Jeff Goldblum) is the biggest drug dealer in Los Angeles, and Russell Stevens (Larry Fishburne) is an undercover cop who wants to bring him down. Posing as a dealer, Stevens begins to earn the trust of the L.A. drug underworld, eventually making his way to Jason himself. programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons
programme.desc: In the Kingdom of Izmer, wizards use their magic to rule the land. The young Empress Savina desires to use magic for good, but the evil Profion plans to utilize his powers to usurp the throne from Savina and subject the kingdom to totalitarian rule. Profion gains control of the kingdom's golden dragons, while Savina sets out to win control of the even more powerful red dragons, gaining the alliance of a motley group of individuals along the way.

programme.title: Kentucky 190-Inch Giant with Nathan
programme.desc: Nathan, who works 800 feet underground in a limestone mine, tells the story of the season's first big buck - a 190-inch Kentucky giant taken on just 147 acres.

programme.title: Spicing it Up
programme.desc: Spice lovers rejoice as daring heat and bold seasonings transform everyday dishes into fiery, unforgettable griddle creations.

programme.title: 8-Year Old takes 185" Whitetail in Kentucky
programme.desc: 8 year old Brantly takes a buck of a lifetime!

programme.title: Redemption Season: A DIY Public Land Elk Hunt
programme.desc: Eastmans' videographer Lindsay steps in front of the camera with an October public-land elk tag. Warm weather, fog and a high snow line keep the post-rut bulls in the timber, so she glasses new country solo off an onX waypoint, hunting for one more chance before the season runs out.

programme.title: Waterfowl Hunting: The Ultimate Mixed Bag Morning
programme.desc: The Wingmen crew and family hit a river goose spot on a warm, windy December morning. With mild weather keeping the birds scarce, it turns into a slow-burn hunt, as widgeon, a mallard and a rare gadwall hen fall over the decoys. Along the way, they explain how to tell a mature widgeon hen from a juvenile by its wing feathers.

programme.title: Would You Hunt with the 22 Creedmoor? Speed Test & Hornady Review
programme.desc: Can a .22-caliber rifle reach 1,500 yards? Todd Helms puts Hornady's 22 Creedmoor to the test with four loads: Precision Hunter, Match, V-Match and Superformance CX. He shoots groups and clocks velocities over the chronograph, and shares the Wyoming mule deer he took with the 80-grain ELD-X.

programme.title: Grit Pays Off! DIY Elk Bow Hunt with Brian Barney
programme.desc: Twelve days into a tough September elk season, Brian Barney and buddy Dylan Ness pack a lightweight spike camp into public-land bowls and glass for a mature six-point. With an hour of light left, they ditch their packs, sprint to the next ridge and use the terrain to stalk into bow range. Then comes the hard part: breaking down the bull and getting the meat off the mountain on no sleep.

programme.title: 3-Man Limit! River Duck Hunt with Wingmen
programme.desc: Crawl in the blind for a late-season waterfowl hunt on the river with the Wingmen crew. Todd Helms is joined by good friends Josh and Greg for some fellowship, and hopefully decoying a few ducks. Weather has been mild and the local birds are stale, but the guys manage to fill out a three-man limit on greenheads with some bonus geese in the mix.

programme.title: Sig Sauer Image Stabilizing Binoculars
programme.desc: Mike Eastman reviews Sig Sauer's Zulu6 HDX image-stabilizing binoculars. He shows how stabilization takes the shake out of glassing in the wind, why the 20-power model can replace a spotting scope in your pack, and how the upgraded HDX glass performs in low light.

programme.title: Public Land Beast! Bow Hunting Big Bulls with Brian Barney
programme.desc: Join Eastmans' Elevated podcast host Brian Barney on this Beyond the Grid episode to bow hunt elk in the rugged backcountry in pursuit of arrowing a bugling bull! This DIY bow hunt is packed with navigating new valleys, winter weather, and Brian's signature spot-and-stalk tactics. From glassing ridges at first light to heart-pounding moments with screaming bulls, this is elk hunting in the raw.

programme.title: Gnarly Iowa Archery Buck
programme.desc: Iowa Land Specialist Ben Harshyne chases an awesome buck on his Iowa farm with bow in hand. Followed up by Missouri Land Specialist Jeff Propst chasing a buck during the firearm season.

programme.title: Jacob Landry Tags a Tall-Tined Buck on the Yellowstone River in Montana
programme.desc: Every year, our Montana trips deliver - and this season was no exception. Usually, Jacob's tied up filming Swamp People for the History Channel and can't make it for archery season. But this year was different. With all his gator tags filled and a little time to spare, Jacob hit the banks of the Yellow Stone River in Montana for an unforgettable hunt. programme.title: The Journey Ahead
programme.desc: Cosmology takes the entire universe as its subject, not just its form, structure and contents, but also the manner of its birth and evolution; looking at the origin of cosmology in creation stories and its relation to the journey ahead.

programme.title: Denizens of the Universe
programme.desc: Introducing the hierarchy of structures in the universe; from planets to stars, galaxies, galaxy clusters and larger groupings of galaxies called the cosmic web; light travels at a finite speed, looking far away also means looking far back in time.

programme.title: Overall Cosmic Properties
programme.desc: Discussing cosmic properties; the universe is lumpy at the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters; at larger scales, it is smooth and similar in all directions; this property of homogeneity and isotropy is called the cosmological principle.

programme.title: The Stuff of the Universe
programme.desc: The most familiar constituents of the universe are atomic matter and light; neutrinos make up another component; 96 percent of the universe is dark energy and dark matter; the relative amounts of these constituents changes as the universe expands.

programme.title: Mineralogy and a New View of Earth
programme.desc: Beginning the study of Earth's history by voyaging backward in time; seeing how each crucial stage in the evolution of the planet depends on what comes before; previewing the role played by minerals, which coevolve with life.

programme.title: Origin and Evolution of the Early Universe
programme.desc: Earth exists for only a third of the history of the universe; what happens before the planet forms; journeying back to the Big Bang; how fundamental forces and particles freeze out of a homogeneous state in the initial moments of cosmic evolution.

programme.title: Willie, Paint it Black?
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it's time to address the elephant in the room. Mark's 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick's Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it's time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: The A100 Team
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it's iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Carbiturary: Cuda
programme.desc: When Mark get's started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don't worry, though, he can't talk forever right?

programme.title: Duster In The Wind
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks...again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing it's Dash installed as well as it's interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: B5: Before & After
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it's time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it's time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: The Last WS27R on Earth
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn't be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Emma's Car
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.desc: Obligan a su novia a abortar, ella se suicida. Fabiola participa en unos encuentros que organiza Alejandro, por su culpa termina casi violada y contagiada con hepatitis.

programme.desc: Quiere que le autoricen su regreso a Cuba, pero la madre prefiere que el sistema se haga cargo de su hija. Un niño da una serenata y le lanzan un objeto que le rompe la cabeza.

programme.title: Demasiados hijos
programme.desc: Emmanuel tiene 18 hijos de diferentes mujeres y distintas nacionalidades, algunas de ellas le exigen que se haga una vasectomía para que pare de traer al mundo niños que no puede mantener.

programme.title: La realidad de un secuestro; Caza depredadores
programme.desc: María Eugenia quiere que su esposo Armando pague el rescate que piden por su hijo secuestrado, pero su esposo no está dispuesto a arriesgar el capital que tienen porque no hay garantías. Tina se hizo unas fotos con Ángel, pero este nunca se las entregó. Ahora ella descubre que las fotografías fueron utilizadas como carnada para cazar a depredadores sexuales.

programme.title: Obligada a parir; El órgano-piano
programme.desc: Yennifer renta su vientre, pero tiene orden de deportación, Rey, el padre del bebé quiere que dé a luz antes de irse. El creador del "órgano-piano" desea patentarlo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Mi marido trans; Desalojo geriátrico
programme.desc: Andrés estaba felizmente casado con Roberto, pero se fue de viaje y regresó transformado en mujer. Eustacio es un octogenario que le alquiló su vivienda a Mildred y ahora quiere recuperarla.

programme.title: Dinero de menores; Boda iluminada
programme.desc: Andrea quiere que Juan Carlos la indemnice porque fue prostituida durante un viaje en barco. Rossi desea casarse con un vestido lleno de luces, su esposo tiene fotofobia y quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Mensaje fatal; El golazo
programme.desc: Lorena demanda a Claudia por tenderle una trampa que pone en peligro su asilo. Amanda se enamora del hijo de su amante, y tienen un bebé juntos, pero ahora la abuela no reconoce a su nieto.

programme.title: Muerte sin sentido; La miseria
programme.desc: Susana le pide una compensación a Alex, quien se interpuso en una discusión de pareja y provocó la muerte de su esposo. Geidy quiere divorciarse de Roberto, y que él y su ex desalojen la casa.

programme.title: Responsabilidad de vacaciones; Sangre gitana
programme.desc: Su marido muere por un malentendido, exige compensación. En la ceremonia del pañuelo comprueban que la novia no era virgen y se cancela la celebración, lo que provoca una deshonra a la familia.

programme.title: Mi hijo tiene satiriasis; Mujeres histéricas
programme.desc: El hijo de Martha tiene satiriasis, una enfermedad que provoca un desenfrenado deseo sexual. Milagros sufre histeria femenina y solo se calma con los masajes de su yerno, su hija está molesta.

programme.title: Chick Fight
programme.desc: When Anna joins an all-female, underground fight club to turn her mess of a life around, she soon discovers she's much more personally connected to the history of the club than she ever could have imagined.

programme.title: The Clapper
programme.desc: Eddie Krumble works as a paid audience member for infomercials and experiences a whirlwind of overnight fame after a late-night talk show host publicizes his frequent infomercial appearances.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Two high-school seniors make a pact to help each other lose their virginity before their prom, but their mission takes an unexpected turn when one announces that he's gay.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: One year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) heeds his friend's advice and begins dating again. He hurriedly proposes to a waitress (Isla Fisher), but she has issues of her own, including a pair of problematic parents (Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason).

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Vamps
programme.desc: Bloodsucking party girls find their destinies at stake when one falls for the son of a vampire hunter and the other encounters a long-ago love.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

programme.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
programme.desc: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: The Rage: Carrie 2
programme.desc: When her closest friend commits suicide after being manipulated by the popular crowd, quiet and bookish Rachel Lang (Emily Bergl) decides to get back at the guilty parties. Although Rachel falls for sensitive football player Jesse Ryan (Jason London), she remains determined to punish his callous friends. When Rachel discovers that she has superhuman abilities, it ups the stakes for her revenge, echoing a supernatural incident that occurred decades before.

programme.title: Down a Dark Hall
programme.desc: Five emotionally fragile teens are committed to Blackwood, a mysterious school for gifted girls. Mesmerized by the intense head mistress Madame Duret, they think they have found a place where they can finally flourish academically and artistically. The mystery deepens as they break through layer after layer of misdirection to discover the true, horrifying purpose of the school.

programme.title: Campfire Tales
programme.desc: On a desolate highway, several stranded teenagers pass the time by telling scary stories around a makeshift fire.

programme.title: Dark Ride
programme.desc: Ten years have passed since the brutal murder of two teenage girls by a psychopath named Jonah. He escapes from the mental institution and returns to his old haunt, an amusement park with an attraction called "Dark Ride." Meanwhile, six friends on a road trip board the ride, not knowing of the deadly plans Jonah has in store.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: An unknown killer stalks six friends one year after they played a provocative parlor game.
