programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: A couple and their daughter move to Colombia to take over a family manufacturing plant, only to realize their new home is haunted.

programme.title: Open 24 Hours
programme.desc: A former mental patient lands the graveyard shift at a gas station, where the isolation triggers her condition, bringing gruesome results.

programme.title: Vietnam! Vietnam!
programme.desc: Inspired by a series of articles by Thomas Duggan Goss. Vietnam:The People and the War - The Vietnamese in their normal daily routine. Their lives when having been affected by insurgents. Wives of prisoners of war in Vietnam talking about their incessant activities on behalf of their husband's plights.

programme.title: Skull World
programme.desc: Follows two years in the life of Greg Sommer, aka Skull Man, as he builds the Canadian chapter of Box Wars, an international underground movement of cardboard-based combat.

programme.title: Demons
programme.desc: A young rock band visits a deserted house to record their new album but things take a nightmarish turn when their Satanist manager attempts to open the gates of Hell.

programme.title: White Haired Witch
programme.desc: Based on one of China's most popular novels, the White Haired Witch tells a gripping story of kung fu, fantasy, revenge and death.

programme.title: The Beyond
programme.desc: Astronauts modified with advanced robotics are sent through a newly discovered wormhole. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their groundbreaking interstellar journey.

programme.title: D-Railed
programme.desc: Passengers on a train that crashes into a river must decide whether to risk waiting for help in the wreckage or take their chances in the murky depths below.

programme.title: Playhouse
programme.desc: In a remote Scottish castle, an irreverent writer faces terrifying consequences when his daughter falls prey to an evil curse lurking within the walls.

programme.title: They Look Like People
programme.desc: Suspecting that those around him are actually malevolent shape-shifters, a troubled man questions whether to protect his only friend from an impending war, or from himself.

programme.title: Undergods
programme.desc: An otherworldly journey through a Europe in decline - a collection of darkly humorous, fantasy tales about ill-fated characters and doomed fortune.

programme.title: Killer Therapy
programme.desc: After a series of violent incidents, Brian is moved from failed therapist to failed therapist, maturing into a young man unable to escape his anger issues. Brian blames his therapists, and takes revenge on everyone who ever wronged him.

programme.title: Traded
programme.desc: In the 1880s western "Traded", a father must leave his ranch for Dodge City to save his daughter from an old enemy, putting his reputation as the fastest draw in the west to the test.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: The Boat
programme.desc: A lone sailor is locked inside the head of a sailboat that is underway -- and on autopilot.

programme.title: Bundy and the Green River Killer
programme.desc: A police detective consults with incarcerated madman Ted Bundy to help him catch The Green River Killer.

programme.title: A Conspiracy To Rule: The Illuminati
programme.desc: Investigate how the Global Elite strive relentlessly to form a One World Government, pulling the strings of deception through manipulation of the media and mechanisms that control our very thoughts and actions.

programme.title: Wolf Blood S1 Ep5-Occam's Razor
programme.desc: Maddy and Rhydian are trapped with their school mates on Lindisfarne island on the night of her first full moon transformation.

programme.title: Cape Wrath S1 EP 8
programme.desc: Danny goes to ask Samantha about Cape Wrath, but she is away visiting her dying father, Professor Campbell. He explains to her the Meadowlands experiment and Samantha learns who she really is.

programme.title: Tai Chi Zero
programme.desc: Yang has arrived to learn, only to find that their Tai Chi is forbidden to outsiders. A mysterious man arrives with a fearsome machine, having to put their faith in Yang for help.

programme.title: Love, Hate and Security
programme.desc: Giulietta Di Messina a rich sensual european aristocrat (Romina Di Lella) has an unquenchable desire to be a lounge singer against her powerful banker husband's William Windsor's (Oliver Gruber) wish. Still she rebels against him and his high society family cause she keeps control of Williams black money cash safe code. William calls afterwards New York High level security head hunter Tony (Ralf Moeller). Tony sends his Best man Nick Angelo (Damian Chapa).

programme.title: Harbinger Down
programme.desc: While studying the effects of global warming on a pod of whales, grad students on a crabbing vessel and its crew uncover frozen Soviet space shuttle and unintentionally release a monstrous organism from it.

programme.title: Amber's Descent
programme.desc: After surviving a violent encounter, renowned pianist, Amber Waltz, relocates to a rural farmhouse to complete her latest symphony. When the music mysteriously begins writing itself, Amber slowly discovers that this piece could be her last.

programme.title: To Hell & Back: The Kane Hodder Story
programme.desc: The story of stuntman Kane Hodder who survived a near-death burn accident to eventually become FRIDAY THE 13th's Jason!

programme.title: Cropsey
programme.desc: Realizing the urban legend of their youth has actually come true; two filmmakers delve into the mystery surrounding five missing children and the real-life boogeyman linked to their disappearances.

programme.title: 40 Days And Nights
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.title: Romeo Section 2 - Assassins: Seeds of War
programme.desc: "To his university, Professor Wolfgang McGee (Andrew Airlie - "Fifty Shades of Grey"), is a gifted academic. To his country, he is the spymaster behind the Romeo Section, a secret ring of intelligence operatives that infiltrate some of the world's deadliest criminal networks. In "The Romeo Section: Assassins", Wolfgang is tasked with revealing the truth behind an alleged terrorist attack.

programme.title: War and Peace
programme.desc: Father Liam Riley faces immortal vengeance for his long-ago acts as a British soldier.

programme.title: Wild Game
programme.desc: When a rancher takes a movie star on an illegal elk hunt, it quickly turns into a man hunt.

programme.title: The Chamber
programme.desc: A three-man Special Ops team on a secret recovery mission and a civilian pilot become trapped underwater in a small claustrophobic submersible craft off the coast of North Korea.

programme.title: Dylan's New Nightmare: A Nightmare on Elm Street Fan Film
programme.desc: Dylan's New Nightmare acts as an unofficial sequel to Wes Craven's: A New Nightmare, one of the most unique and high concept installments to the Nightmare on Elm Street Franchise. This short film picks up 25 years after the events of New Nightmare and follows Dylan Porter (Miko Hughes), the young son of Heather Langenkamp, now a grown man trying to make his way in the world his parents raised him in-Hollywood.

programme.title: New Hidden Killers: The Victorian Home
programme.desc: From the food they ate to the clothes they wore, the Victorians were surrounding themselves with killers. What made taking a bath and drinking milk potentially so dangerous? And how did the Victorian woman turn herself into a walking fire hazard?

programme.title: Hunting the KGB Killers
programme.desc: The inside story of Alexander Litvinenko's murder in London and the subsequent international manhunt that led to the Kremlin, told in full for the first time, with exclusive access to key individuals.

programme.title: I'll Follow You Down
programme.desc: After the disappearance of a young scientist on a business trip, his son and wife struggle to cope, only to make a bizarre discovery years later - one that may bring him home.

programme.title: Tai Chi Zero
programme.desc: Yang has arrived to learn, only to find that their Tai Chi is forbidden to outsiders. A mysterious man arrives with a fearsome machine, having to put their faith in Yang for help.

programme.title: D-Day
programme.desc: When an elite group of American soldiers are ordered to take out a series of German machine gun nests, they find themselves blindly venturing into hostile territory.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Having rescued Nick from near death, Bert Myers nurses him back to health. After hearing that Nick was injured while looking for Korda, Amanda goes to settle the score.

programme.title: Passion Play
programme.desc: Lucy discovers that Wilson Geary, the immortal that killed her immortal husband Marco Becker many years ago, is in town, and she decides to take her revenge.

programme.title: Darknet EP 1
programme.desc: A woman on the subway is oblivious to the surrounding terror; a man finds strange objects in some lockers; a medical student believes somebody is getting into her apartment.

programme.title: The Haunting of Molly Bannister
programme.desc: A chilling tale of a family at odds against a sinister evil that they don't understand. The Origin of Molly Bannister is here and its more terrifying than you could have imagined.

programme.title: The Girl in Cabin 13
programme.desc: A group of masked men start taking out their sadistic fantasies on an unsuspecting couple living in a secluded cabin.

programme.title: To Hell & Back: The Kane Hodder Story
programme.desc: The story of stuntman Kane Hodder who survived a near-death burn accident to eventually become FRIDAY THE 13th's Jason!

programme.title: Cobra Against Ninja
programme.desc: Three best friends from the ninja army training school become embroiled in a gambling racket run by the Triads, which involve their former ninja instructor in ever more vicious battles against increasingly more powerful foes. With the law tailing their every move, Gordon and Cobra must fight their ultimate Ninja battle for the honor of the Ninja Empire.

programme.title: The Invincible
programme.desc: The infamous "Red Dragon" and his Mongolian counterparts invade China and massacre countless people. The situation looks terrible but then a hero emerges who wants to defy the Red Dragon; Li Mu-Bai (Wang Yu), the Invincible!

programme.title: 52 Masters: JKD KNIFE GRAPPLING with Burton Richardson
programme.desc: Guro Burton Richardson trains Will in combat self-defense techniques.

programme.title: Thunder Kids 1- Golden Adventure
programme.desc: The race for a treasure becomes and incredible free-for-all! The search for a priceless golden statue draws four groups of people together in an incredible and hilarious race against Ninjas to claim the treasure.

programme.title: Dynamite Shaolin Heroes: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 5
programme.desc: After the fall of the Ming Dynasty, China is thrown into turmoil. The loyalists seek the return of Ming; the government is determined to stay in power. The only difference between the two is one saves lives, while the other takes it away.

programme.title: Bruce Lee against Supermen aka Superdragon vs Superman
programme.desc: Scientist Dr. Ting has invented a secret formula that will help the world's food crisis, but refuses an offer to sell it. When Dr. Ting is kidnapped by a sinister organization, Alice's boyfriend, the renowned crime fighter Kato (Bruce Li) is called in to rescue him. However, Kato realizes he cannot fight alone and enlists the help of his two superhero friends collectively known as "The Green Hornet".

programme.title: Crystal Fist aka Jade Claw
programme.desc: After Wang Chen-Kang, a Kung Fu master of the "Shadow Gate School" is killed, his only son Wang Tsung-Wen (Billy Chong) is accepted as a pupil in the Cheong Hsing Martial Art School, working in the kitchen to pay for his lessons, he finds that the cook, Chang Tien Hsiang (Simon Yuen) is a veteran "Shadow Gate Boxer". His enemies join forces to take revenge on Chang, raid the school and beat up Wang. Chang is impressed by the by the boy's courage and agrees to teach him his Kung Fu skills.

programme.title: Bravest Fist: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 2-WITHDRAWN
programme.desc: After intimidating numerous towns and bullying the residents, Chan Wai Man goes on a fierce attack against the thugs responsible.

programme.title: 8 Strikes of the Wildcat
programme.desc: A superb Wu Tang gem. Hard hitting action! Mouse and Mole, collectively known as the Three Rats, are looking for a two part treasure map and will kill anyone who gets close to them. A young girl named Shao Wa, seeks to avenge the murder of her father, and in order to defeat the Rats, she must learn the "Eight Strikes of the Wild Cat" from an old Kung Fu Master, while trying to evade his amorous assistant, Lee Ta Fa. A kung fu shapes classic!

programme.title: Call Me Dragon
programme.desc: Golden Sand City is filled with brothels and casinos funded by drug lord Yim Kung Ho (evil Mr. Yem) and policed by the iron fist of his henchman Panther (Yasuaki Kurata). Vigilantes Inspector Big Dragon (Bruce Liang), Little Mouse, and Black Cat plan to bring Yum Kung Ho and his evil empire to its knees, but face fierce opposition in the deadly Panther, who has the stolen pearls sought after by Big Dragon and his new ally a deadly China doll named Mei Ling.

programme.title: Ways of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A hapless student (Chi Kuan-Chun) is cast out of the Shaolin Temple after he suffers numerous humiliations at the hands of a deceitful monk. He is left to travel the countryside and along the way encounters a variety of Martial Arts masters. Over time, he masters the Ways of Kung Fu and returns to expose the evil monk. Training and martial arts mayhem follows.

programme.title: Thundering Ninja
programme.desc: A Ninja Organization and the C.I.A. are fighting each other for the plans of a missile.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode Three: Aikido
programme.desc: "The only answer to aggression is love and harmony" he would say. The practice of Aikido continues today with his grandson Moriteru Ueshiba who inherited the title of Doshu. At his morning class which begins at dawn, Doshu teaches Irimi-nage, bringing the founders concepts alive. As the attacker moves forward to strike, he is not stopped. Instead Doshu avoids conflict by entering to his side, and in turning to face the same direction they harmonize.

programme.title: Ninja Operation - Knight and Warrior
programme.desc: Alvin, an anti-narcotic agent for Interpol, is on a mission to nail the key man in an international drugs ring. When his wife is murdered Alvin tracks Rudolf to Hong Kong and is sure to look up his long-time friend Gordon, a hard boiled cop who believes in 'an eye for an eye, violence against violence.' Together they combine their expert combat skills to take on the gangs in a bloody showdown.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 4
programme.desc: "Iemitsu has been instated as Shogun, but there are still forces that want to target him. The Yagyus must now protect him from a ruthless ninja clan known as The Onibis"

programme.title: Shaolin Deadly Kicks
programme.desc: One of Flash Legs Tan's best films! A band of thieves, known as the Eight Dragons, commit murder in the process of a stealing a treasure map. They decide three years is long enough for the heat to die down and allow them to search for their hidden fortune. But none of the thieves trusts any of his brothers-in-crime to keep the map that long. Their leader's solution is to cut the map into eight pieces, one for each bandit. Meanwhile, a pair of relentless lawmen is after them.

programme.title: 52 Masters: MACHIDA KARATE with Chinzo Machida
programme.desc: Sensei Ford takes a class in the Machida style of karate under Chinzo Machida.

programme.title: Buddhist Fist and Tiger Claws
programme.desc: It's all out fists and claws kung fu action! 'Tiger Claws' Lau Fong steals a large quantity of gold bars from the Imperial Court, but a rival gang, The Flash Foxes, headed by 'Buddhist Fist' Kao Pa, vow to grab the gold from Lau's Black Tiger Gang at all costs.

programme.title: Men of the Hour
programme.desc: Shang Li runs away for he's suspected of murder. While the hunters search for him, they think of the murder suspect, and just maybe Shang Li is innocent? Isn't there someone else around with a much better reason to commit that murder? This takes us into the second half of the movie where a lot more kung fu fighting takes place than in the first.

programme.title: Ninja Terminator
programme.desc: The hunt is on to gain the fabulous super-strength of the ninja sorcery, after three top students of the Ninja Empire each steals one of the sections of the Golden Ninja Warrior statuette. On the case is Interpol agent, Jaguar Wong, who must make sure that whoever re-unites the pieces uses the power for doing good and not evil.

programme.title: Boxer's Last Stand
programme.desc: In this gripping tale of double revenge featuring some of the most brutal fighting you've ever seen, only one man, Chai Sing, holds the key to stopping this relentless evil.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Michael Matsuda
programme.desc: This unique biography looks at the founder and president of the Martial Arts History Museum, Michael Matsuda. As a fifty-plus-year veteran of the martial arts, he lived through many historical events in martial arts history. A former publisher of Martial Art Magazine, Matsuda shares what it took to start the museum, what challenges he encounters and the steps he took to create the world's first and only museum dedicated to the martial arts.

programme.title: Ninja of the Magnificence
programme.desc: Ross, Farris and Lee are star pupils of the Ninja Master, but Ross is secretly building his own ninja empire and dealing in the slave trade, headed by two slave masters Old Fox and Kong. When Ross kills the master, the two brothers must battle their way through an army of ninjas to bring the wrongdoers to justice.

programme.title: Ninja in Action
programme.desc: A ninja fighter and his American girlfriend journey to Hong Kong in search of the man who murdered her father.

programme.title: Wild Panther
programme.desc: An action-filled martial arts film in which guerilla fighters and foreign spies clash in kung fu combat when important military secrets are at stake.

programme.title: Buddha Assassinator aka Buddha Killer
programme.desc: Lord Tsoi of the Manchus (Hwang Jang Lee) has used his Buddhist Fist expertise to destroy a great many Ming patriots. While visiting a temple, he is ambushed by a group of Ming freedom fighters, but is rescued by a naive kung fu fanatic, Shao Hai (Meng Hoi). In gratitude, Lord Tsoi makes Shao Hai his personal guard and educates him in the Buddhist Fist. Shao Hai, however, is also the student of his a Ming monk (Chien Yuet San) and disciple of the Buddhist Palm technique.

programme.title: 52 Masters: JINEN KAI with Chad Eagan
programme.desc: Sensei Ford trains with some beach kata, then comes back to the dojo for serious conditioning.

programme.title: Art of the Japanese Sword
programme.desc: The Japanese sword ... prized as much for its exceptional beauty as for its deadly cutting ability. It has endured for a thousand years as the pinnacle of Japanese culture. Now you can enter a world rarely seen by outsiders. To experience the true story of the Art of the Samurai Sword. A story told in the swordsmiths own words that separate the myth from the fact. Follow the swordsmiths dream of creating a masterpiece.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Cynthia Rothrock
programme.desc: Officially named, "Queen of the Martial Arts," Cynthia Rothrock is considered one of the most historic figures in martial arts history, or five consecutive years, she was the undefeated World Champion in the karate tournament circuit. She has graced the cover of over 60 martial arts magazines and was inducted into the prestigious Martial Arts History Museum's Hall of Fame at its inception in 1999.

programme.title: Fist Full of Talons
programme.desc: Qing I-ming (Billy Chong) springs into action to help his friend, who runs into danger while trying to deliver important government documents.

programme.title: 5 Pattern Dragon Claws
programme.desc: The Silver Fox battles untold men with his deadly Thunder Foot technique and rules supreme in the martial arts, until a young fighter develops the Lightning Mantis Strike.

programme.title: Bravest Revenge
programme.desc: After retiring, Chief Constable Shi Yulong planned to enjoy a quiet life, but he is unexpectedly called back into action to capture the escaped criminal Zhao Mutian. Severely wounded in battle, Shi urges his daughter and three disciples to seek revenge and enlist the help of Sword King Tsai Ying-chieh. Despite Tsai's exceptional skills, he is unable to overcome Zhao's divine sword, leading them to seek the "Sun Sword" from the mountain to confront their formidable foe.

programme.title: Black Belt Fury
programme.desc: An enterprising Japanese (Han Ying Chieh The Big Boss) wants to take over some land owned by a Chinese mountain tribe so that he can exploit its natural resources. One of the leaders of the tribe, Ta Lu Ka (Wen Chiang Long) a martial arts expert is there to fend of the Japanese for his tribe.

programme.title: Blind Swordswoman
programme.desc: Two blind swords women come to the aid of a swordsman tracking down a ruthless martial arts master.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode One: Karatedo
programme.desc: Warriors of Budo Episode One: Karatedo begins at the Okinawan dojo of Sensei Morio Higaonna acknowledged as a true Warrior of Budo. A warrior trains his entire life for a moment that may never arrive. As a master of the fighting arts, achieving victory in a fight that may even mean death, can be a simple matter. Yet at the highest level, a Warrior of Budo will choose peace instead of conflict. Sensei Morio Higaonna is a Warrior of Budo.

programme.title: Double Dragon Last Duel aka Double Dragon in Last Duel
programme.desc: You think you've won the final victory, but the most dreadful nightmare is waiting for you! Kir, an expert in the martial arts gets the job of escorting the government's payroll, and is befriended by a seemingly heroic fighter, Wang, who is in fact the leader of a gang of bandits. When the chance comes, Wang kills Kir's family and grabs all his property, but the son escapes. Years later, Dragon seeks revenge for the injustice to his father in a duel to the death.

programme.title: Tiger Over Wall
programme.desc: Hwang Jang Lee portrays a ruthless Police Captain, who will stop at nothing in his quest for power, even framing an innocent man.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 2
programme.desc: "The lone wolf and cub found themselves trapped in an inn as hostages, as a ruthless gang of bandits called The Flying Beasts terrorize the village. The lone wolf must now try to break free and save himself, daigoro, and the other hostages from these bandits"

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Graciela Casillas
programme.desc: Graciela Casillas is considered one of the true pioneers of women's kickboxing. She was not only its first world champion, but she became its most prominent advocate. Starting her professional fighting career in 1976, she spent her time in boxing and kickboxing. In 1979, she became the first World Kickboxing Association's bantamweight champion, and also in 1979, she became the World Women's Boxing Champion, the first athlete to win both titles.

programme.title: Duel in the Desert
programme.desc: The setting for this tale is an inn where people come from all corners of China every five years to witness and participate in a prestigious horse race. But the inn is also swarming with thieves and con-men looking to score. Angela Mao plays the inn-keepers daughter and she sends the villains back to where they came from in a series of great fights. See Angela Mao using the Snake fist!

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 10
programme.desc: When the Kumazo Gang starts shaking down businesses, the Lethal Three can't help but take action along their journey.

programme.title: Bandits, Prostitutes and Silver
programme.desc: A carriage driver, Wang Tao, gets entangled with thieves when he wants to liberate a prostitute. Double dealing and lies befall them all.

programme.title: Dragon's Claws
programme.desc: Jimmy Liu, plays the son of the leader of the Dragon Boxing sect, Lung Chen Tien (Liu Ho Nine). An exiled member of the Dragon Boxing sect, Ling Ko Fung (Hwang Jang Lee), arrives in town to claim leadership of the sect by challenging Lung Chen Tien in a duel. The winner of the duel will receive the sacred golden tablet and become sect leader. Lung Chen Tien dies after the match, and then relinquishes the tablet to Ling Ko Fung.

programme.title: Ninja in the Deadly Trap
programme.desc: During the Ming Dynasty, the Japanese Defense Minister dispatches a team of expert Ninjas to steal the valuable "Summary of Fighting Skills" manual used by the invincible Chinese warriors. Now the Ming General must enlist the help of a Kung Fu master and prevent the document from falling into the hands of the Japanese marauders who have deployed Ninjas to assist them in capturing the document.

programme.title: Surprises
programme.desc: After months working undercover, Andy and Nick's operation goes sideways when Nick - then Andy - go missing.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: On her first day back at 15 Division, Andy must work with Swarek to track down an ex-convict.

programme.title: Different, Not Better
programme.desc: Andy is partnered with Swarek's new girlfriend, Officer Marlo Cruz.

programme.title: The Kids Are Not Alright
programme.desc: A routine highway check leads to the discovery of a teenage boy in the trunk of a car.

programme.title: Poison Pill
programme.desc: After a messy drug arrest, Andy and Marlo are quarantined together.

programme.title: Skeletons
programme.desc: There's a possible connection between a missing woman and one of the division's most distressing cases.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: When human bones found in a ravine open up a 15-year-old case, Swarek reunites with his old training officer.

programme.title: For Better, for Worse
programme.desc: Things get complicated when the team gets called to a hijacked casino bus full of senior citizens.

programme.title: What I Lost
programme.desc: When Chris returns for a visit, his reunion takes a shocking turn when his son, Christian, is abducted.

programme.title: You Are Here
programme.desc: Near the end of a shift, 15 Division busts a marijuana grow-op.

programme.title: Deception
programme.desc: When a pedophile is found beaten, Andy discovers Marlo has been conducting an off-hours "investigation."

programme.title: Under Fire
programme.desc: Someone with a grudge against 15 Division opens fire on Andy and Chloe.

programme.title: You Can See the Stars
programme.desc: The officers have to piece together the truth about a past crime in order to find Oliver Shaw.

programme.title: Blink
programme.desc: Andy and Dov pull themselves together at an all-night diner, but are caught off-guard in a diner hold-up.

programme.title: All By Her Selfie
programme.desc: Oliver gets promoted to Acting Staff Sergeant, and Andy is tasked with training 15 Division's newest rookie.

programme.title: Heart Breakers, Money Makers
programme.desc: Inspector Jarvis sends the officers to seize all "proceeds of crime" - anything purchased with illegal money.

programme.title: Wanting
programme.desc: After the discovery of an executed gang leader, 15 Division must find the killer before a gang war breaks out.

programme.title: Going Under
programme.desc: When 15 Division goes undercover at a club-land bar, Chris's erratic behavior make Dov suspicious.

programme.title: Two Truths and a Lie
programme.desc: As the officers try to hunt down the killer of Brian Gowdy - Andy and Sam go on the road for interviews.

programme.title: Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: Oliver prepares Andy to defend herself at Duncan's dismissal hearing, now happening two hours from now.

programme.title: Exit Strategy
programme.desc: An innocuous call to a middle-class home puts Dov and Chris in the middle of a home invasion investigation.

programme.title: Moving Day
programme.desc: 15 Division works on a program to help tenants move out of a subsidized-housing complex that's being torn down

programme.title: Fragments
programme.desc: Andy's former rookie, Duncan, is back on duty and looking to reconcile - something she's not ready for yet.

programme.title: Everlasting
programme.desc: The officers work to find a bomber. But after catching him, they realize he has more targets set to explode.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: Andy is attacked by an intruder at Traci's place and the Sex Crimes Unit steps in to take over the case.

programme.title: Perfect Family
programme.desc: Andy debates her future with Sam after learning the heart-breaking news that Marlo is pregnant with his baby.

programme.title: Uprising
programme.desc: A riot breaks out at a women's prison while Andy, Juliet, Nick, and Gail are there to transfer prisoners.

programme.title: Letting Go
programme.desc: Nick's estranged older brother emerges with new information on someone from their tragic past.

programme.title: A Real Gentleman
programme.desc: When Traci is a no-show for her first raid, 15 Division fears the gun dealer they're after has kidnapped her.

programme.title: Home Run
programme.desc: After a baseball game erupts in a drive-by shooting, Gail and her brother search for the shooter.

programme.title: Best Man
programme.desc: Andy and Sam are shocked to learn that Oliver is the prime suspect in IA's corruption investigation.

programme.title: Integrity Test
programme.desc: Andy, Dov, Gail, and Nick undertake a risky plan to prove that Commissioner Alonso Santana is corrupt.

programme.title: Ninety Degrees
programme.desc: A heat wave hits and Jarvis opens the division to the public as a cooling station.

programme.title: Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Now that Sam and Marlo's baby girl has arrived, it's clear nothing could have prepared Andy for this moment.

programme.title: 74 Epiphanies
programme.desc: With the 15 Division restructure looming, Andy and Sam's wedding lets the gang celebrate one last hurrah.

programme.title: Fresh Paint
programme.desc: A high-stakes takedown goes awry upon the revelation that rookie cop Andy McNally has busted one of her own.

programme.title: Mercury Retrograde
programme.desc: As the other rookies hunt for an escaped convict, Swarek lets Andy in on his past undercover exploits.

programme.title: Fite Nite
programme.desc: The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at "Fite Nite."

programme.title: Signals Crossed
programme.desc: Andy trades in her uniform for something more risqué when she goes undercover as a prostitute.

programme.title: Broad Daylight
programme.desc: During a home invasion, Andy is left alone and confronted with a hiding thief who is armed and very volatile.

programme.title: Bullet Proof
programme.desc: A fatal traffic collision reveals a shocking truth, and Andy's romance with Det. Callaghan gets complicated.

programme.title: Hot & Bothered
programme.desc: A heat wave has wreaked havoc on the city, multiplied by growing fears of a serial rapist on the loose.

programme.title: Honour Roll
programme.desc: Andy and Chris investigate a nightclub beating, but all clues point to a cop.

programme.title: Girlfriend of the Year
programme.desc: At a highway accident, Chris and Gail stumble upon a car that has a license plate matched to an Amber Alert.

programme.title: Big Nickel
programme.desc: A botched prisoner transport has Andy and Swarek in a cat-and-mouse game to catch the fugitive.

programme.title: To Serve or Protect
programme.desc: Andy's ex-cop father has confessed that he may have committed a crime during an alcohol-induced blackout.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: It's time for performance assessments for the rookies as they find out the fate of their careers.

programme.title: Takedown
programme.desc: When an arrest compromises a drug bust, Andy steps up to salvage the bust by going undercover with Swarek.

programme.title: Butterflies
programme.desc: Andy's world explodes when a student is killed in a shooting, and a bullet hits Andy, lodging in her vest.

programme.title: Might Have Been
programme.desc: Andy and Gail go undercover as cocktail waitresses to clean up a drug-infested club.

programme.title: Bad Moon Rising

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty adds herbaceous perennials to the Jewel Garden. Nick Bailey visits a gardener in Essex for matrix planting. Frances is at a garden in Bradford. A grower in Dorset is dedicated to dahlias, and a gardener in Cambridgeshire planted 35 trees.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nation's most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

programme.title: Wakefield and Swindon
programme.desc: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

programme.title: Corris and Hayling
programme.desc: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

programme.title: Bromley and Dorset
programme.desc: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny backyard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Greece
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Central Spain
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Southern Spain
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Northern Spain
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's full steam ahead at Longmeadow for Monty, who is busy getting the garden summer-ready. He is planning displays bursting with colour and scent, sharing some of his favourite foliage to create a tapestry of texture in shade.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In the cottage garden, Monty is moving a rose which has outgrown its space and in the vegetable garden he gives advice on what to plant now for spring. He also finds out more about the mysterious world of earthworms and discovers why they are vital for the garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.desc: Coasting with Carol at Willow and Mercer; Coasting with Carol at Ophelia Swimwear Grand Boulevard; Coasting with Carol at Ophelia Swimwear Grand Boulevard.

programme.title: Shopping

programme.title: Switch up the Spice
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: Weeknight Dinner
programme.desc: Simple recipes are a must for weeknight dinners, and Lidia always looks for those that that deliver a burst of flavor. In this episode, she will share some of her favorite quick weeknight dinner ideas. She starts with a Sausage Crostini, made of sweet Italian sausage topped with Taleggio cheese. She then prepares a Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce; an iconic creamy Italian American pasta dish and then Arugula Salad with Porcini Mushroom & Shavings of Cheese.

programme.title: Simply Salads
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a colourful summer panzanella with roasted zucchini and onions, and a warm shrimp and squash ribbon salad.

programme.title: Savor The Moment
programme.desc: Citrus and fennel salad; crispy smashed garlic rosemary potatoes; roast pork shoulder.

programme.title: Family Brunch
programme.desc: Today Lidia shares some new show-stopping dishes for the perfect family style brunch that include Crostata with Kale Butternut Squash and Ricotta - made of a flaky dough filled with a creamy colorful mix of ricotta, kale, butternut squash and golden raisins. Carrot and Orange Salad is the next item on the menu-a bright dish that adds color to any meal. Lidia's Potato and Egg Frico - a crispy Asiago cheese crust made with potatoes and eggs is always a winner at the brunch table.

programme.title: More Italian Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American classics have always been favorites at the family table and in this episode, there is reason to celebrate. Today's recipes include the most iconic Italian American dish, Spaghetti and Meatballs; a Broccoli Rabe with Garlic; and a holiday must - Zeppole.

programme.title: Restaurant Inspiration
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Finding the Balance
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: I Love Eggs
programme.desc: Lidia loves eggs, and in this episode, she shares four super simple recipes that feature this amazing ingredient that Lidia recalls fondly from her own grandmother's courtyard in Istria. Oregano Eggs and Anchovy Frittata are delicious appetizers or main courses. The Rustic Salad is a great meal idea with lots of complex textures and flavors. For a sweet finish, Lidia whips up Zabaglione with Fresh Fruit.

programme.title: Fruit Desserts
programme.desc: Fruit desserts have always been an Italian tradition; they are simple, delicious and the perfect way to showcase nature's bounty. In this episode, the Lidia highlights some of her fans' preferred seasonal sweets with: Strawberries with Balsamic Vinegar, a light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Fresh Fruit; juicy Nectarines and Blueberries in Prosecco and a Plum Crostata, a free form Italian tart with juicy plums.

programme.title: Fruits and Sweets
programme.desc: In Lidia's courtyard, the fruit trees would blossom with flowers in spring. In the summer, it was time to play around the trees and wait for the fruit to ripen. Today, Lidia prepares a Fig and Prosciutto Bruschetta, a delicious combination of sweet and salty. She then transforms wafer cookies into Quick & Easy Truffles. Finally, it's time for a light and airy Almond Tart from Andria.

programme.title: Colorful Inspiration
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Italian Taste for Bitter Vegetables
programme.desc: Italy is one big garden with a year round growing season. Vegetables are often the stars of the meal, and today Lidia will highlight the versatility of delicious bitter vegetables like broccoli rabe, radicchio and escarole.

programme.title: Never Enough Pasta
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Chocolate and Dinner
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite chocolate desserts and one deliciously creamy risotto recipe. First, she makes a Chocolate Hazelnut Bread Parfait, a special treat she had growing up. Lidia then makes a soft and creamy spoon dessert, Chocolate Zabaglione. Lastly, she prepares a rich and smooth Risotto with Artichokes, Sunchokes, and Mint.

programme.title: Foraging Adventures
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Seafood Symphony
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic-tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Best of Zucchini
programme.desc: Zucchini sautéed with garlic, anchovies and capers; fried zucchini; orecchiette with clams and zucchini; sweet-and-sour zucchini.

programme.title: Restaurant's Greatest hits
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Keep it Fresh
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: The Fresh Catch
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Soups On
programme.desc: Soups are a delicious and comforting way to warm up especially in the winter months. On the menu today is Spicy Italian Soup, Calabria's version of vegetable soup; The Perfect Simple Salad, a simple and light side that works for any kind of soup; and an easy-to-make Butternut Squash Soup, garnished with crispy crumbled bacon.

programme.title: Bread & Beans
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: My Goats & Ricotta
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: BRAISING
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: Tried & True
programme.desc: Four cheese baked macaroni with asparagus and peas; cider vinegar spritz; spicy vinegar ribs and potatoes.

programme.title: Heartwarming Favorites
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: SEARED STEAK
programme.desc: When talking about a juicy steak, grilling often comes to mind but for Lidia, it's all about the sear. In today's episode, Lidia begins with a crispy Montasio Cheese Frico stuffed with potatoes and onions. She then makes a Seared Steak with a perfectly balanced sauce of rosemary, shallots and mixed mushrooms. Her side dish is a Braised Escarole with olive oil, pepperoncino and garlic -simple and delicious.

programme.title: A Fruitful Meal
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: An Italian Lunchbox
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: My Fruit Trees
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Our Courtyard Cantina
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Craving Fresh
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shows how to mix and balance seasonal flavors from your own garden in order to create new recipes based on what's available.

programme.title: Heartwarming Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Cold Weather Comforts
programme.desc: When it's cold outside, Lidia's kitchen kicks into high gear. The oven is on and the stovetop is always lit. On today's menu, she'll prepare her Turkey Meatloaf with Mushroom Sauce -a real family favorite that is smothered in mushroom sauce. Vin Brulee is a mulled wine infused with warm spices; it's the perfect choice to warm up on a cold night.

programme.title: BRODETTO
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Wheat Harvest and Pasta
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Love Your Vegetables
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Cocktail Party
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Grow In The Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved artichoke, spinach and mortadella salad; mussels, sausage and potatoes in white wine.

programme.title: Memories of the Mountains
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Building Flavor
programme.desc: Winter minestrone; roasted squash and carrot salad with chickpeas and almonds.

programme.title: The 1980s Italian American "Evolution"
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Plan The Menu
programme.desc: Dishes using ricotta, including bruschetta, crespelle manicotti and chocolate chip ricotta cookies.

programme.title: A Summer Shindig
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: A Perfect Roast
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.

programme.title: Party Favorites
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: A Light Summery Meal
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: MORE PASTA
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Elegant Eats
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Brunch Brilliance
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lemony Chicken- A Family Favorite
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Herbs and Spices
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: The Dessert Table
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Symphony of Flavors
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: By the Sea
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Cheese
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Quick and Delicious
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.

programme.title: Pizza Party
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Enough To Share
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Ragu
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Trattoria Favorites
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Sweet & Savory Fruit
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Layering Italian Flavors
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Crispy Favorites
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Home Cooked Restaurant Classics
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: A Seaside Buffet
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Dinnertime Soup Sandwhich
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Can't Go Wrong
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Agrodolce
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Trieste's International Flavors
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday Tables & Traditions
programme.desc: Join Lidia as she shares holiday traditions with four families across America. From New York to San Antonio and San Francisco, celebrate Christmas, Passover, and Chinese New Year with Mo Rocca, Stanley Tucci, Ruth Reichl, and more!

programme.title: A Colorful Party
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Serving up Pasta
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: A Meal for the Grandkids
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Fruits of the Sea
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Northern Italian Comforts
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: Feeding the Family
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Little Effort, Big Flavor
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Cultured Comforts
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Fuel The Soul
programme.desc: Dandelion and chickpea salad; one-pan chicken and aubergine Parmigiana.

programme.title: Pasta Party
programme.desc: Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and today, Lidia prepares three pasta recipes that will become staples in your kitchen. The first dish on the menu is a quick Ziti with Kale Pesto and Crispy Bacon, a delicious way to recycle any kale pesto leftovers in the fridge. She then makes a delicious summertime pasta made with plum tomatoes, Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto, and finally Campanelle with Shrimp and Fennel, made with "little bells" that carry the chunky sauce so well.

programme.title: Good Friends & Good Food
programme.desc: Building the ultimate Italian cheeseboard; skilled sausage and peppers; St. Joseph's zeppole, fried dough filled with vanilla cream topped with Amarena cherries.

programme.title: Start the Day
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Mediterranean Essentials
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes
programme.desc: In this moving special, acclaimed chef and food ambassador Lidia Bastianich pays homage to the men and women of our military and the truly life-saving sacrifices they make daily for our freedom. Lidia meets seven veterans, who share their incredibly inspiring stories.

programme.title: Go-To Cravings
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Update the Classics
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Meet Me At The Table
programme.desc: Mushroom ragu; Moka coffee; Kaiserschmarrn, a light and fluffy eggy pancake topped with jam.

programme.title: Worth Celebrating
programme.desc: Winter panzanella; a mix of warm roasted vegetables tossed with bread and kale; crespelle bar; farina gnocchi.

programme.title: A Roman Interlude
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Italian American Classics
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Acidity
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Cooking with the Nuns
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: PERFECT ROASTED CHICKEN
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: Light Lunches
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: All About Grandma
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: From Italy To Your Table
programme.desc: Mussel bruschetta; a tasting of olive oil; spaghetti in lemon cream sauce.

programme.title: The Best Bar Food
programme.desc: On today's menu, Lidia serves Chicken and Sausage Bites with Apple Cider Vinegar Sauce, made with rosemary, vinegar, and honey. Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Eggs
programme.desc: Eggs were always a favorite at Lidia's home as a kid and they still are. In this episode, she'll prepare Savory Egg Battered Zucchini Roll Ups; a refreshing and simple Fennel, Red Onion and Celery Salad topped with Italian Salami and a luscious Frittata Filled with Ricotta, Tomatoes, Onion and Basil.

programme.title: One Dish, Two Meals
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Italy's Heartland
programme.desc: Lidia loves entertaining and today, she shares recipes that are fit for any Italian dinner party. Bruschetta is a great party appetizer, and Lidia shares one of her favorite toppings: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta. Next on the menu is Beef and Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine, a hearty-one pol meal your guests will love.

programme.title: Childhood Cravings
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Italian Style Salads
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Dress Up Dinner
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: My Favorite Braises
programme.desc: Braising is a preferred technique in Lidia's kitchen and today she prepares one rich braised meat dish, along with two braised vegetable choices for the home cook. Recipes include: Beef Braised in Barolo; a Braised Kale with Bacon; and finally Braised Cauliflower.

programme.title: The Italian Products Have Arrived!
programme.desc: The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavor in the kitchen, as Italians began to grow their produce in America. Lidia makes a Belgian & Red Endive Salad as well as a sweet Cherry Jam Tart wrapped up in an almond crust.

programme.title: The Tomato
programme.desc: The tomato Is not native to Italy, but it made a big impact on Italian cuisine when it arrived centuries ago. From canned to vine ripened, Lidia shares with you several of her favorite tomato dishes including: Stuffed Tomatoes: stuffed with rice, mozzarella and basil; Braised Pork Ribs with Rigatoni: Tender to the bone pork ribs and braising sauce with rigatoni; and Green Beans in Chunky Tomato Sauce: a perfect side of fresh green beans smothered in a fresh chunky tomato sauce.

programme.title: Welcome To My Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia di recco; a quick salad matching salty pecorino Romano cheese with sweet pears and peppery arugula; rigatoni with sausage and cabbage.

programme.title: The Community Table
programme.desc: Cheese crisp bowls filled with a colourful salad; bucatini with broccoli walnut pesto; turkey stuffed peppers.

programme.title: Summer Picnic
programme.desc: Italians love a good picnic, and Lidia shares some of her favorite picnic foods from her childhood. Lidia's Pasta Salad with Tomato, Mozzarella and Green Beans is a hearty pasta salad that is perfect for any picnic.
